@pure_lazy
def _bootstrap_schema_ref(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | LazyResult[PlanEffect],
    fallback: SchemaDdlOperationName | SchemaDdlPhase,
) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    if type(ref_id) is ServerPlanRefId:
        return ref_id
    assert type(ref_id) is LazyResult
    dependency_refs = _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(ref_id)
    if dependency_refs:
        return dependency_refs[-1]
    return ServerPlanRefId(fallback)

@pure_lazy
def _order_models_by_foreign_key_dependencies(
    model_classes: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...],
) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...]:
    """Put referenced table models before models that declare their foreign keys."""
    from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_contract_edge_extraction import (
        extract_bootstrap_foreign_key_tables,
    )

    models = tuple(dict.fromkeys(model_classes))
    if len(models) < 2:
        return models
    models_by_table = {get_table_name(model): model for model in models}
    dependencies: dict[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], set[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]] = {model: set() for model in models}
    for child in models:
        for parent_table in extract_bootstrap_foreign_key_tables(child):
            parent = models_by_table.get(parent_table)
            if parent is not None and parent is not child:
                dependencies[child].add(parent)

    ordered: list[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]] = []
    remaining = {model: set(parents) for model, parents in dependencies.items()}
    while remaining:
        ready = [model for model in models if model in remaining and not remaining[model]]
        if not ready:
            ordered.extend(model for model in models if model in remaining)
            break
        for model in ready:
            ordered.append(model)
            del remaining[model]
        for parents in remaining.values():
            parents.difference_update(ready)
    return tuple(ordered)

def _enqueue_schema_generation_bumps(
    txn: AsyncWriteTransaction,
    *,
    tags: tuple[SchemaGenerationTag, ...],
    existing_by_tag: tuple[tuple[SchemaGenerationTag, CacheGenerationRow], ...],
    now: datetime,
) -> SchemaGenerationBumps:
    """Enqueue schema-generation rows through one bulk insert and update each."""
    rows_by_tag = dict(existing_by_tag)
    inserted_rows: list[CacheGenerationRow] = []
    updated_rows: list[CacheGenerationRow] = []
    bumped: dict[SchemaGenerationTag, int] = {}
    for tag in tags:
        existing = rows_by_tag.get(tag)
        if existing is None:
            inserted_rows.append(CacheGenerationRow(tag=tag, generation=1, updated_at=now))
            bumped[tag] = 1
            continue
        new_generation = int(existing.generation) + 1
        updated_rows.append(
            existing.model_copy(
                update={"generation": new_generation, "updated_at": now},
            ),
        )
        bumped[tag] = new_generation
    rows = (*inserted_rows, *updated_rows)
    if rows:
        txn.upsert_many_lazy(
            CacheGenerationRow,
            LazyResult.of(rows),
            conflict_columns=[typed_field(CacheGenerationRow.tag)],
        )
    return SchemaGenerationBumps(tuple(bumped.items()))

        value = _schema_artifact_attr(stmt, "_log_table")
    elif type_name == "SqlSchedulerTrigger":
        value = _schema_artifact_attr(stmt, "_tick_table")
    elif type_name == "SqlVersionedFkCheckTrigger":

    elif type_name == "SqlVersionedFkReverseTrigger":
        value = _schema_artifact_attr(stmt, "_tip_table")
    elif type_name == "SqlVersionedVvFkCheckTrigger":
        value = _schema_artifact_attr(stmt, "_child_tip_table")

@pure_lazy
def _schema_artifact_fact(
    stmt: SqlRenderable,
    *,
    phase: SchemaDdlPhase | DefaultSchemaDdlPhase,
) -> (
    tuple[
        BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind,
        SqlTableName,
        SchemaArtifactSubject,
        SchemaArtifactFingerprint,
    ]
    | NoSchemaArtifactFact
):
    """Return ``(kind, table, artifact name, fingerprint)`` from typed DDL construction facts."""
    key = _schema_artifact_key(stmt, phase=phase)
    match key:
        case NoSchemaArtifactKey():
            return NoSchemaArtifactFact()
        case BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey(table_name=Unset()):
            return NoSchemaArtifactFact()
        case BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey(table_name=str() as table_name):
            return (
                key.kind,
                SqlTableName(table_name),
                key.object_name,
                _schema_artifact_fingerprint(key, phase=phase),
            )
        case _:
            return NoSchemaArtifactFact()

            return BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey(
                kind=BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.BACKEND,
                table_name=UNSET,
                object_name=SchemaArtifactSubject(f"extension:{extension_name}"),
            )
    if type_name in {
        "SqlEnsureMatchingH14Helpers",
        "SqlEnsureMatchingStringHelpers",
        "SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers",
        "SqlEnsureSqlTableHnswEmbeddingHelpers",
        "SqlPostgresBootstrapHashHelpers",
    }:
        return BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey(
            kind=BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.BACKEND,
            table_name=UNSET,
            object_name=SchemaArtifactSubject(type_name),
        )
    if type_name in {
        "SqlCreateContentStoreTableDescriptorChunks",
        "SqlCreateContentStoreTableDescriptorFts",
    }:
        base_table_name = schema_artifact_identifier_name(_schema_artifact_attr(stmt, "_table_name"))
        if base_table_name is None:
            return NoSchemaArtifactKey()
        suffix = "_chunks" if type_name == "SqlCreateContentStoreTableDescriptorChunks" else "_fts"
        content_table_name = SqlTableName(f"{base_table_name}{suffix}")
        return BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey(
            kind=BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.TABLE,
            table_name=content_table_name,
            object_name=SchemaArtifactSubject(content_table_name),
        )
    if phase == "create_table":
        if type_name in _INDEX_DDL_ARTIFACT_TYPES or type_name in _TRIGGER_DDL_ARTIFACT_TYPES or type_name == "SqlAlterTable":
            pass
        else:
            table_names = tuple(
                table_name for table_name in schema_table_names_from_object(stmt) if nonempty_str(str(table_name)) is not None
            )
            if len(table_names) == 1:
                table_name = table_names[0]
                return BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey(
                    kind=BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.TABLE,
                    table_name=table_name,
                    object_name=SchemaArtifactSubject(table_name),
                )
    if type(stmt) is SqlAlterTable:
        add_column_target = stmt.single_add_column_target()
        if add_column_target is None:
            return NoSchemaArtifactKey()
        table_ident, column_name = add_column_target
        alter_table_name = schema_artifact_identifier_name(table_ident)
        column_artifact_name = schema_artifact_identifier_name(column_name)
        if column_artifact_name is None or alter_table_name is None:
            return NoSchemaArtifactKey()
        return BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey(
            kind=BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.COLUMN,
            table_name=SqlTableName(alter_table_name),
            object_name=SchemaArtifactSubject(column_artifact_name),
        )
    if type_name not in _INDEX_DDL_ARTIFACT_TYPES and type_name not in _TRIGGER_DDL_ARTIFACT_TYPES:
        return NoSchemaArtifactKey()
    artifact_name: SchemaArtifactSubject | None
    if type_name in _INDEX_DDL_ARTIFACT_TYPES or type_name == "SqlCreateTrigger":
        raw_artifact_name = schema_artifact_identifier_name(_schema_artifact_attr(stmt, "_name"))
        artifact_name = SchemaArtifactSubject(raw_artifact_name) if raw_artifact_name is not None else None
    elif type_name == "SqlPolymorphicDiscriminatorGuardTriggerDialectAware":
        artifact_table_name = _schema_artifact_table_name(stmt)
        match artifact_table_name:
            case NoTableName():
                return NoSchemaArtifactKey()
            case SqlTableName():
                pass
        operation = _schema_artifact_attr(stmt, "_operation")
        artifact_name = SchemaArtifactSubject(
            f"{artifact_table_name}_poly_discriminator_guard_{operation}",
        )
    else:
        raw_artifact_name = schema_artifact_identifier_name(
            _schema_artifact_attr(stmt, "_trigger_name"),
        )
        artifact_name = SchemaArtifactSubject(raw_artifact_name) if raw_artifact_name is not None else None
    artifact_table_name = _schema_artifact_table_name(stmt)
    match artifact_table_name:
        case NoTableName():
            return NoSchemaArtifactKey()
        case SqlTableName():
            if artifact_name is None and type_name == "SqlTypeIdImmutabilityTriggerDialectAware":
                artifact_name = SchemaArtifactSubject(f"{artifact_table_name}_type_id_immutable")
    if artifact_name is None:
        return NoSchemaArtifactKey()
    kind = BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.INDEX if type_name in _INDEX_DDL_ARTIFACT_TYPES else BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.TRIGGER
    return BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey(
        kind=kind,
        table_name=SqlTableName(artifact_table_name),
        object_name=artifact_name,
    )


@pure_lazy
def _schema_artifact_fingerprint(
    key: BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey,
    *,
    phase: SchemaDdlPhase | DefaultSchemaDdlPhase,
) -> SchemaArtifactFingerprint:
    if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.TABLE:
        return SchemaArtifactFingerprint(f"schema_ddl:table:{key.object_name}")
    if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.BACKEND:
        return key.fingerprint
    phase_prefix = phase or "schema_ddl"
    table_name = "_backend" if key.table_name is UNSET else key.table_name
    return SchemaArtifactFingerprint(
        f"{phase_prefix}:{key.kind}:{table_name}:{key.object_name}",
    )

@dataclass(slots=True)
class SchemaOperationPlan:
    """Transaction-local builder for one immutable schema execution contract."""

    _operations: tuple[SchemaOperation, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple, init=False, repr=False)
    revision: int = 0
    frozen_for_execution: bool = False
    frozen_execution_plan: FrozenSchemaExecutionPlan | Unset = UNSET
    materialized: bool = False
    terminal_owned: bool = False
    existing_tables: frozenset[SqlTableName] = frozenset()
    planned_create_tables: frozenset[SqlTableName] = frozenset()
    columns_by_table: Mapping[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlColumnName]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    triggers_by_table: Mapping[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlTriggerName]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    indexes_by_table: Mapping[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlIndexName]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    ddl_artifact_fingerprints: frozenset[SchemaArtifactFingerprint] = frozenset()
    duplicate_ddl_source_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()
    bootstrap_metadata_publications: tuple[BootstrapMetadataPublicationPlan, ...] = ()
    bootstrap_metadata_publication_rows: tuple[BootstrapMetadataPublicationRows, ...] = ()
    touched_tables: frozenset[SqlTableName] = frozenset()
    catalog_models: frozenset[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]] = frozenset()

    def __post_init__(self: SchemaOperationPlan) -> None:
        self.columns_by_table = MappingProxyType(
            {key: frozenset(value) for key, value in self.columns_by_table.items()},
        )
        self.triggers_by_table = MappingProxyType(
            {key: frozenset(value) for key, value in self.triggers_by_table.items()},
        )
        self.indexes_by_table = MappingProxyType(
            {key: frozenset(value) for key, value in self.indexes_by_table.items()},
        )

    @property
    def operations(self: SchemaOperationPlan) -> tuple[SchemaOperation, ...]:
        """Return an immutable snapshot of planned schema operations."""
        return self._operations

    @pure_lazy
    def _assert_mutable(self) -> None:
        if self.frozen_for_execution:
            msg = "cannot mutate frozen schema operation plan"
            raise SchemaArchitectureError(msg)

    @pure_lazy
    def freeze_for_execution(self) -> FrozenSchemaExecutionPlan:
        """Validate and freeze the complete artifact graph before lowering."""
        if self.frozen_execution_plan is not UNSET:
            return self.frozen_execution_plan
        artifact_dependencies: dict[SchemaArtifactKey, set[SchemaArtifactKey]] = {}
        table_keys: set[SchemaArtifactKey] = set()
        ordered_operations = tuple(
            sorted(
                self.operations,
                key=lambda operation: (
                    0 if operation.ddl_work_product is not UNSET and operation.ddl_work_product.phase == "schema_reconciliation" else 1
                ),
            )
        )

        def table_key(table_name: SqlTableName) -> SchemaArtifactKey:
            key = SchemaArtifactKey(SchemaArtifactKind.TABLE, SchemaArtifactSubject(table_name))
            table_keys.add(key)
            artifact_dependencies.setdefault(key, set())
            return key

        for table_name in (*sorted(self.existing_tables), *sorted(self.planned_create_tables)):
            table_key(table_name)
        for operation in ordered_operations:
            effects = operation.effects
            for table_name in effects.touched_tables:
                table_key(table_name)
            for table_name, column_names in effects.columns_by_table.items():
                parent = table_key(table_name)
                for column_name in column_names:
                    key = SchemaArtifactKey(
                        SchemaArtifactKind.COLUMN,
                        SchemaArtifactSubject(f"{table_name}.{column_name}"),
                    )
                    artifact_dependencies.setdefault(key, set()).add(parent)
            for table_name, index_names in effects.indexes_by_table.items():
                parent = table_key(table_name)
                for index_name in index_names:
                    key = SchemaArtifactKey(
                        SchemaArtifactKind.INDEX,
                        SchemaArtifactSubject(f"{table_name}.{index_name}"),
                    )
                    artifact_dependencies.setdefault(key, set()).add(parent)
            for table_name, trigger_names in effects.triggers_by_table.items():
                parent = table_key(table_name)
                for trigger_name in trigger_names:
                    key = SchemaArtifactKey(
                        SchemaArtifactKind.TRIGGER,
                        SchemaArtifactSubject(f"{table_name}.{trigger_name}"),
                    )
                    artifact_dependencies.setdefault(key, set()).add(parent)

        declarations = tuple(
            SchemaArtifactDeclaration(
                key=key,
                provides=frozenset({key}),
                requires_declared=frozenset(dependencies),
                requires_materialized=frozenset(dependencies),
            )
            for key, dependencies in sorted(artifact_dependencies.items())
        )
        artifact_graph = SchemaArtifactGraph(declarations=declarations).finalize()
        realization_plan = FrozenRealizationPlan.from_artifact_graph(artifact_graph)
        frozen = FrozenSchemaExecutionPlan(
            operations=ordered_operations,
            artifact_graph=artifact_graph,
            realization_plan=realization_plan,
        )
        self.frozen_for_execution = True
        self.frozen_execution_plan = frozen
        return frozen

    def deferred_ddl_work_count(self) -> int:
        """Return immutable deferred DDL products not owned by a closed terminal."""
        if self.materialized or self.terminal_owned:
            return 0
        return sum(operation.ddl_work_product is not UNSET for operation in self.operations)

    def transfer_to_terminal(self, frozen: FrozenSchemaExecutionPlan) -> None:
        """Transfer the exact frozen operation contract to one closed terminal."""
        if self.frozen_execution_plan is not frozen:
            msg = "cannot transfer a schema execution plan not owned by this transaction"
            raise SchemaArchitectureError(msg)
        self.terminal_owned = True

    def mark_materialized(self, frozen: FrozenSchemaExecutionPlan) -> None:
        """Record successful realization of the exact frozen contract."""
        if self.frozen_execution_plan is not frozen:
            msg = "cannot materialize a schema execution plan not owned by this transaction"
            raise SchemaArchitectureError(msg)
        self.materialized = True

    @pure_lazy
    def bind_catalog_model(self, model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]) -> None:
        """Record a requested schema model even when its physical table already exists."""
        self._assert_mutable()
        if model_cls in self.catalog_models:
            return
        self.catalog_models |= frozenset({model_cls})
        self.revision += 1

    @pure_lazy
    def project_create_table(self, table_name: SqlTableName) -> None:
        """Record a create-table fact in the transaction-local schema projection."""
        self._assert_mutable()
        self.planned_create_tables |= frozenset({table_name})

    @pure_lazy
    def record_table_created(self, table_name: SqlTableName) -> None:
        """Project a table created by an executed schema operation."""
        self._assert_mutable()
        self.existing_tables |= frozenset({table_name})
        self.revision += 1

    @pure_lazy
    def record_table_dropped(self, table_name: SqlTableName) -> None:
        """Remove all projected facts owned by a dropped table."""
        self._assert_mutable()
        self.existing_tables -= frozenset({table_name})
        self.columns_by_table = MappingProxyType(
            {key: value for key, value in self.columns_by_table.items() if key != table_name},
        )
        self.triggers_by_table = MappingProxyType(
            {key: value for key, value in self.triggers_by_table.items() if key != table_name},
        )
        self.indexes_by_table = MappingProxyType(
            {key: value for key, value in self.indexes_by_table.items() if key != table_name},
        )
        self.revision += 1

    @pure_lazy
    def record_column_renamed(
        self,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        old_column_name: SqlColumnName,
        new_column_name: SqlColumnName,
    ) -> None:
        """Replace one projected column identity after a rename."""
        self._assert_mutable()
        columns = self.columns_by_table.get(table_name, frozenset())
        renamed_columns = columns.difference({old_column_name}).union({new_column_name})
        self.columns_by_table = MappingProxyType(
            {**self.columns_by_table, table_name: renamed_columns},
        )
        self.existing_tables |= frozenset({table_name})
        self.touched_tables |= frozenset({table_name})
        self.revision += 1

    @pure_lazy
    def project_indexes(
        self,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        index_names: frozenset[SqlIndexName],
    ) -> None:
        """Project immutable index identities and their artifact fingerprints."""
        self._assert_mutable()
        existing = self.indexes_by_table.get(table_name, frozenset())
        self.indexes_by_table = MappingProxyType(
            {**self.indexes_by_table, table_name: existing.union(index_names)},
        )
        self.ddl_artifact_fingerprints |= frozenset(
            SchemaArtifactFingerprint(f"index:{table_name}:{index_name}") for index_name in index_names
        )
        self.revision += 1

    @pure_lazy
    def install_bootstrap_ddl_plan(self, plan: BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan) -> None:
        """Install immutable bootstrap facts as an explicit schema operation."""
        existing = tuple(
            operation.bootstrap_ddl_plan
            for operation in self.operations
            if operation.kind is SchemaOperationKind.BOOTSTRAP_PROJECTION and operation.bootstrap_ddl_plan is not UNSET
        )
        if existing and existing[-1] != plan:
            msg = "schema operation plan already owns a different bootstrap DDL plan"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        if existing:
            return
        self.add_operation(
            SchemaOperation(
                kind=SchemaOperationKind.BOOTSTRAP_PROJECTION,
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_projection"),
                bootstrap_ddl_plan=plan,
            ),
        )

    def add(self, effects: SchemaOperationEffects) -> None:
        self.add_operation(
            SchemaOperation(
                kind=SchemaOperationKind.DDL_EFFECT,
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("projected_effect"),
                effects=effects,
                idempotent=effects.idempotent,
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def add_operation(self, operation: SchemaOperation) -> None:
        self._assert_mutable()
        effects = operation.effects
        self._operations += (operation,)
        self.revision += 1
        self.touched_tables |= effects.touched_tables
        self.existing_tables |= effects.existing_tables
        self.catalog_models |= effects.catalog_models
        for table_name, column_names in effects.columns_by_table.items():
            existing_columns = self.columns_by_table.get(table_name, frozenset())
            self.columns_by_table = MappingProxyType(
                {
                    **self.columns_by_table,
                    table_name: existing_columns.union(column_names),
                },
            )
        for table_name, trigger_names in effects.triggers_by_table.items():
            existing_triggers = self.triggers_by_table.get(table_name, frozenset())
            self.triggers_by_table = MappingProxyType(
                {
                    **self.triggers_by_table,
                    table_name: existing_triggers.union(trigger_names),
                },
            )
        for table_name, index_names in effects.indexes_by_table.items():
            existing_indexes = self.indexes_by_table.get(table_name, frozenset())
            self.indexes_by_table = MappingProxyType(
                {
                    **self.indexes_by_table,
                    table_name: existing_indexes.union(index_names),
                },
            )
        self.ddl_artifact_fingerprints |= effects.ddl_artifact_fingerprints

    def ingest_bootstrap_schema_plan(self, plan: BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan) -> None:
        """Ingest one nominal bootstrap DDL result into the transaction ledger."""
        projected_tables = frozenset(table_name for table_fact in plan.table_family_facts for table_name in table_fact.family_tables)
        existing_tables = projected_tables.difference(self.existing_tables)
        columns_by_table: dict[SqlTableName, set[SqlColumnName]] = {}
        for column_fact in plan.column_facts:
            if column_fact.column_name not in self.columns_by_table.get(column_fact.table_name, set()):
                columns_by_table.setdefault(column_fact.table_name, set()).add(column_fact.column_name)
        indexes_by_table: dict[SqlTableName, set[SqlIndexName]] = {}
        for index_fact in plan.index_facts:
            if index_fact.index_name not in self.indexes_by_table.get(index_fact.table_name, set()):
                indexes_by_table.setdefault(index_fact.table_name, set()).add(index_fact.index_name)
        if not existing_tables and not columns_by_table and not indexes_by_table:
            return
        self.add_operation(
            SchemaOperation(
                kind=SchemaOperationKind.DDL_EFFECT,
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_schema_facts"),
                effects=SchemaOperationEffects(
                    touched_tables=frozenset(
                        {
                            *existing_tables,
                            *columns_by_table,
                            *indexes_by_table,
                        },
                    ),
                    existing_tables=existing_tables,
                    columns_by_table={table_name: frozenset(column_names) for table_name, column_names in columns_by_table.items()},
                    indexes_by_table={table_name: frozenset(index_names) for table_name, index_names in indexes_by_table.items()},
                    ddl_artifact_fingerprints=frozenset(
                        SchemaArtifactFingerprint(f"index:{fact.table_name}:{fact.index_name}") for fact in plan.index_facts
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )

    def add_duplicate_ddl_source_ref(self, source_ref: ServerPlanRefId) -> None:
        self._assert_mutable()
        self.duplicate_ddl_source_refs |= frozenset({source_ref})

    def has_duplicate_ddl_source_ref(self, source_ref: ServerPlanRefId) -> bool:
        return source_ref in self.duplicate_ddl_source_refs

    def add_bootstrap_metadata_publication(
        self,
        publication: BootstrapMetadataPublicationPlan,
        publication_rows: BootstrapMetadataPublicationRows,
    ) -> None:
        self._assert_mutable()
        self.bootstrap_metadata_publications += (publication,)
        self.bootstrap_metadata_publication_rows += (publication_rows,)

    def latest_bootstrap_metadata_publication_rows(
        self,
    ) -> BootstrapMetadataPublicationRows | NoBootstrapMetadataPublicationRows:
        if not self.bootstrap_metadata_publication_rows:
            return NoBootstrapMetadataPublicationRows()
        return self.bootstrap_metadata_publication_rows[-1]

    def table_exists(self, table_name: SqlTableName) -> SchemaFactPresence:
        if table_name in self.existing_tables:
            return SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        if any(
            operation.kind is SchemaOperationKind.CREATE_TABLE
            and operation.schema_model is not UNSET
            and get_table_name(operation.schema_model) == table_name
            for operation in self.operations
        ):
            return SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        return SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN

    def column_exists(self, table_name: SqlTableName, column_name: SqlColumnName) -> SchemaFactPresence:
        columns = self.columns_by_table.get(table_name)
        if columns is None:
            return SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN
        return SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT if column_name in columns else SchemaFactPresence.ABSENT

    def trigger_exists(self, trigger_name: SqlTriggerName) -> SchemaFactPresence:
        for trigger_names in self.triggers_by_table.values():
            if trigger_name in trigger_names:
                return SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        return SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN

    def index_exists(self, index_name: SqlIndexName) -> SchemaFactPresence:
        for index_names in self.indexes_by_table.values():
            if index_name in index_names:
                return SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        return SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN

@pure_lazy
def _bootstrap_dml_param(value: SqlParameter) -> SqlParameterValue:
    match value:
        case datetime():
            return value.isoformat()
        case list():
            return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True)
        case _:
            return value


@pure_lazy
def _bootstrap_row_work_product_values(
    row: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] | BootstrapRowMutationWorkProduct,
    *,
    mode: Literal["json", "python"],
) -> Mapping[DynamicFieldName, _BootstrapFieldValue]:
    # Both physical rows and mutation work products own the same typed dump
    # contract; schema planning must not rediscover their concrete class.
    dumped = row.model_dump(mode=mode)
    validated = {DynamicFieldName(key): _require_bootstrap_field_value(value) for key, value in dumped.items()}
    return MappingProxyType(validated)


@pure_lazy
def _postgres_bootstrap_proof_scope_upsert_statement(
    rows: tuple[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] | BootstrapRowMutationWorkProduct, ...],
) -> tuple[tuple[SqlRenderable, SqlParamTuple], ...]:
    """Build the bounded-array PostgreSQL proof-scope upsert."""

    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_unnest_insert import (
        SqlBatchUpsertFromUnnest,
    )

    field_names = tuple(
        DynamicFieldName(field_name)
        for field_name in (
            "sys_id",
            "created_at",
            "updated_at",
            "manifest_key",
            "plan_hash",
            "scope_key",
            "proof_hash",
            "payload_json",
        )
    )
    columns = (
        "sys_id",
        "sys_created_at",
        "sys_updated_at",
        "manifest_key",
        "plan_hash",
        "scope_key",
        "proof_hash",
        "payload_json",
    )
    row_values = tuple(
        tuple(_bootstrap_row_work_product_values(row, mode="python").get(field_name) for field_name in field_names) for row in rows
    )
    arrays = tuple(tuple(row[column_index] for row in row_values) for column_index in range(len(columns)))
    statement = SqlBatchUpsertFromUnnest(
        table="sys_bootstrap_proof_scopes",
        columns=columns,
        column_types=("uuid", "timestamptz", "timestamptz", "text", "text", "text", "text", "text"),
        array_params=arrays,
        conflict_columns=("manifest_key", "scope_key"),
        update_columns=("sys_created_at", "sys_updated_at", "plan_hash", "proof_hash", "payload_json"),
    )
    return ((statement, ()),)


@pure_lazy
def _bootstrap_model_rows_upsert_statements(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    rows: tuple[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] | BootstrapRowMutationWorkProduct, ...],
    *,
    conflict_fields: tuple[DynamicFieldName, ...],
    exclude_fields: tuple[DynamicFieldName, ...] = (),
    custom_update: tuple[tuple[DynamicFieldName, SqlRenderable], ...] | Unset = UNSET,
    insert_predicate: SqlRenderable | Unset = UNSET,
) -> tuple[tuple[SqlRenderable, SqlParamTuple], ...]:
    """Build bootstrap upsert DML for schema-transaction ServerPlan lowering."""
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_upsert import SqlBatchUpsertStmt
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
        SqlColumnList,
        SqlPlaceholderRows,
        SqlValuesClause,
        SqlValuesRow,
        SqlValuesSource,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlInsert
    from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import is_database_generated_column, is_derived_column
    from l1050_polymorphism.type_filter_helper import canonical_polymorphic_type_name
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import unwrap_literal_sql_value
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.bootstrap_identity import SqlBootstrapIdentityLookupExpr
    from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import BootstrapRuntimeIdentityRef

    if not rows:
        return ()
    if insert_predicate is not UNSET and (len(rows) != 1 or conflict_fields):
        raise ValueError("Conditional immutable publication requires one insert-only row")

    @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
    class _FieldValueCarrier:
        value: _BootstrapFieldValue

    def _field_value_expr(carrier: _FieldValueCarrier) -> SqlRenderable:
        match carrier.value:
            case BootstrapRuntimeIdentityRef():
                return SqlBootstrapIdentityLookupExpr(
                    carrier.value.table_name,
                    carrier.value.identity_column,
                    carrier.value.key_values,
                    unwrap_literal_sql_value(carrier.value.fallback),
                )
            case _:
                return SqlParam(unwrap_literal_sql_value(carrier.value))

    def _has_runtime_identity(carrier: _FieldValueCarrier) -> bool:
        match carrier.value:
            case BootstrapRuntimeIdentityRef():
                return True
            case _:
                return False

    update_excluded_fields = frozenset(exclude_fields)
    field_names = tuple(
        DynamicFieldName(field_name)
        for field_name, field_info in model_cls.model_fields.items()
        if not is_database_generated_column(field_info) and not is_derived_column(field_info)
    )
    columns = tuple(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in field_names)
    conflict_columns = tuple(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in conflict_fields)
    update_excluded_columns = frozenset(
        get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in update_excluded_fields
    )
    protected_update_columns = {SqlColumnName("sys_id")}
    if is_polymorphic_class(model_cls) and "type_name" in model_cls.model_fields:
        protected_update_columns.add(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("type_name")))
    update_columns = tuple(
        column
        for column in columns
        if column not in conflict_columns and column not in update_excluded_columns and column not in protected_update_columns
    )
    if conflict_fields and not update_columns and custom_update is UNSET:
        return ()

    def _dump_row(
        row: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] | BootstrapRowMutationWorkProduct,
    ) -> Mapping[DynamicFieldName, _BootstrapFieldValue]:
        dumped = dict(_bootstrap_row_work_product_values(row, mode="python"))
        type_name_field = DynamicFieldName("type_name")
        if dumped.get(type_name_field) is None and type_name_field in model_cls.model_fields and is_polymorphic_class(model_cls):
            dumped[type_name_field] = canonical_polymorphic_type_name(model_cls)
        return dumped

    if conflict_fields:
        deduped_rows: dict[
            tuple[_BootstrapFieldValue, ...],
            Mapping[DynamicFieldName, _BootstrapFieldValue],
        ] = {}
        for row in rows:
            dumped = _dump_row(row)
            key = tuple(dumped.get(field_name) for field_name in conflict_fields)
            deduped_rows[key] = dumped
        row_values = tuple(deduped_rows.values())
    else:
        row_values = tuple(_dump_row(row) for row in rows)
    chunk_size = max(1, _BOOTSTRAP_DML_MAX_PARAMETERS_PER_STATEMENT // max(1, len(columns)))
    statements: list[tuple[SqlRenderable, SqlParamTuple]] = []
    for start in range(0, len(row_values), chunk_size):
        chunk = row_values[start : start + chunk_size]
        carrier_chunk = tuple(
            tuple(
                _FieldValueCarrier(
                    _require_bootstrap_field_value(dumped.get(field_name)),
                )
                for field_name in field_names
            )
            for dumped in chunk
        )
        contains_runtime_identity = any(_has_runtime_identity(carrier) for carrier_row in carrier_chunk for carrier in carrier_row)
        params = (
            ()
            if contains_runtime_identity
            else tuple(unwrap_literal_sql_value(dumped.get(field_name)) for dumped in chunk for field_name in field_names)
        )
        values_rows = (
            SqlValuesClause(
                tuple(
                    SqlValuesRow(
                        tuple(_field_value_expr(carrier) for carrier in carrier_row),
                    )
                    for carrier_row in carrier_chunk
                ),
            )
            if contains_runtime_identity
            else SqlPlaceholderRows(columns=len(columns), rows=len(chunk))
        )
        if insert_predicate is not UNSET:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectList
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

            statements.append(
                (
                    SqlInsert(
                        table=get_table_name(model_cls),
                        columns=SqlColumnList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in columns]),
                        source=SqlSelect(
                            select=SqlSelectList(
                                [_field_value_expr(carrier) for carrier in carrier_chunk[0]],
                            ),
                            where=insert_predicate,
                        ),
                        or_ignore=True,
                    ),
                    (),
                )
            )
            continue
        if not conflict_fields:
            statements.append(
                (
                    SqlInsert(
                        table=get_table_name(model_cls),
                        columns=SqlColumnList(
                            [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in columns],
                        ),
                        values=SqlValuesSource(values_rows),
                        or_ignore=True,
                    ),
                    cast(SqlParamTuple, params),
                ),
            )
            continue
        statements.append(
            (
                SqlBatchUpsertStmt(
                    table=get_table_name(model_cls),
                    columns=SqlColumnList(
                        [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in columns],
                    ),
                    placeholder_rows=values_rows,
                    conflict_columns=SqlColumnList(
                        [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in conflict_columns],
                    ),
                    update_columns=SqlColumnList(
                        [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in update_columns],
                    ),
                    custom_update=None if custom_update is UNSET else custom_update,
                ),
                cast(SqlParamTuple, params),
            ),
        )
    return tuple(statements)


class _SchemaPlanningOwner[
    AttributeAuthoritativePlanningCatalogModelsT: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], ...] | None = tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], ...] | None
](Protocol):
    """Connection-owned state required to build immutable planning metadata."""

    @property
    def backend_type(self) -> BackendType: ...

    _authoritative_planning_catalog_models: AttributeAuthoritativePlanningCatalogModelsT
    _authoritative_planning_catalog_evolution_allowed: bool


def _build_schema_planning_catalog_runtime(owner: _SchemaPlanningOwner) -> PlanningCatalog:
    """Resolve planning metadata at the schema transaction runtime boundary."""
    profile = _build_schema_backend_profile_runtime(owner)
    models = owner._authoritative_planning_catalog_models or ()
    model_identity = tuple(sorted(f"{model_cls.__module__}.{model_cls.__qualname__}" for model_cls in models))
    cache_key = (
        backend_fingerprint_from_connection(owner),
        str(profile.backend_type),
        model_identity,
    )
    cache = ensure_runtime_cache(owner, DynamicFieldName("_schema_planning_catalog_runtime_cache"))
    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cast("PlanningCatalog", cached)
    catalog = cast(
        "PlanningCatalog",
        _planning_catalog_module().build_planning_catalog(
            models=models,
            backend_type=profile.backend_type,
            allow_model_evolution=owner._authoritative_planning_catalog_evolution_allowed,
        ),
    )
    cache[cache_key] = catalog
    return catalog


def _build_schema_backend_profile_uncached(target: _SchemaPlanningOwner) -> ServerPlanBackendProfile:
    return cast(
        "ServerPlanBackendProfile",
        _backend_profiles_module().resolve_server_plan_backend_profile(cast(Any, target)),
    )


def _build_schema_backend_profile_runtime(owner: _SchemaPlanningOwner) -> ServerPlanBackendProfile:
    """Resolve backend profile metadata at the schema transaction runtime boundary."""
    cache_key = backend_fingerprint_from_connection(owner)
    cache = ensure_runtime_cache(owner, DynamicFieldName("_schema_backend_profile_runtime_cache"))
    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cast("ServerPlanBackendProfile", cached)
    profile = _build_schema_backend_profile_uncached(owner)
    cache[cache_key] = profile
    return profile


@pure_lazy
def _schema_operation_lazy[T](
    sync_fn: Callable[[], T],
    async_fn: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]] | NoAsyncCallback = NoAsyncCallback(),
    owner: LazySchemaTransaction | NoSchemaOwner = NoSchemaOwner(),
) -> LazyResult[T]:
    return LazyResult(
        LazyOperation(op="ddl_effect"),
        _SchemaOperationLazyContext(sync_fn, async_fn, owner),
    )


@pure_lazy
def _schema_static_value_lazy[T](
    owner: SchemaPlanCompositionOwner,
    value: T,
    *,
    dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
    lifecycle_effects: tuple[PipelineLifecycleEffect, ...] = (),
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | Unset = UNSET,
) -> LazyResult[T]:
    builder = owner.schema_plan_builder()
    normalized_dependency_refs = tuple(str(ref_id) for ref_id in dependency_refs)
    out_ref = str(ref_id) if ref_id is not UNSET else str(builder._next_ref())
    builder.add_step(
        _collect_results_module().StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
            out_ref,
            value,
            list(normalized_dependency_refs),
            lifecycle_effects=tuple(lifecycle_effects),
        ),
    )
    return owner.publish_schema_output_lazy(
        operation=LazyOperation(op="execute"),
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(out_ref),
        expected_type=type(value) if value is not None else UNSET,
        dependency_refs=frozenset(dependency_refs) or frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(out_ref)}),
    )


@pure_lazy
def _publish_schema_static_value_ref(
    owner: LazySchemaTransaction,
    value: BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan | ApplicationQueueTriggerRegistrationFact,
    *,
    dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...],
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    lifecycle_effects: tuple[PipelineLifecycleEffect, ...] = (),
) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    owner.schema_plan_builder().add_step(
        _collect_results_module().StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
            str(ref_id),
            value,
            [str(dependency_ref) for dependency_ref in dependency_refs],
            lifecycle_effects=lifecycle_effects,
        ),
    )
    return ref_id


@pure_lazy
def _schema_static_ddl_plan_lazy(
    owner: LazySchemaTransaction,
    value: BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan,
    *,
    dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
    lifecycle_effects: tuple[PipelineLifecycleEffect, ...] = (),
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | Unset = UNSET,
) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan]:
    """Publish a closed DDL plan after projecting its nominal facts."""
    owner._ingest_bootstrap_schema_plan(value)
    return _schema_static_value_lazy(
        owner,
        value,
        dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
        lifecycle_effects=lifecycle_effects,
        ref_id=ref_id,
    )


@pure_lazy
def _merge_bootstrap_table_family_work_products(
    plan_values: tuple[BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan, ...],
) -> tuple[BootstrapTableFamilyWorkProduct, ...]:
    products_by_model: dict[type[ApplicationObjectRow[Any]], BootstrapTableFamilyWorkProduct] = {}
    for plan in plan_values:
        for product in plan.table_family_work_products:
            existing = products_by_model.get(product.model_cls)
            if existing is not None and existing.fingerprint != product.fingerprint:
                from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_state import BootstrapPlanningError

                model_name = f"{product.model_cls.__module__}.{product.model_cls.__qualname__}"
                msg = f"conflicting closed table-family products for {model_name}"
                raise BootstrapPlanningError(msg)
            products_by_model.setdefault(product.model_cls, product)
    return tuple(products_by_model.values())


@pure_lazy
def _schema_static_ddl_batch_plan_lazy(
    owner: LazySchemaTransaction,
    plan_values: tuple[BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan, ...],
    *,
    dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaBatchPlan]:
    """Publish one typed fact product for a closed bootstrap schema batch."""
    from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan

    normalized_dependency_refs = tuple(dict.fromkeys(dependency_refs))
    if not plan_values:
        empty_plan = BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan()
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            owner,
            BootstrapSchemaBatchPlan(
                schema_plan=empty_plan,
                produced_refs=(),
                dependency_refs=normalized_dependency_refs,
                work_products=(),
            ),
            dependency_refs=normalized_dependency_refs,
        )

    merged_plan = BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan(
        operations=tuple(operation for plan in plan_values for operation in plan.operations),
        table_family_facts=tuple(fact for plan in plan_values for fact in plan.table_family_facts),
        column_facts=tuple(fact for plan in plan_values for fact in plan.column_facts),
        index_facts=tuple(fact for plan in plan_values for fact in plan.index_facts),
        table_family_work_products=_merge_bootstrap_table_family_work_products(plan_values),
        dependency_tail_refs=tuple(dict.fromkeys(ref_id for plan in plan_values for ref_id in plan.dependency_tail_refs)),
    )
    owner._ingest_bootstrap_schema_plan(merged_plan)
    produced_refs = tuple(dict.fromkeys(operation.produced_ref for operation in merged_plan.operations))
    batch_plan = BootstrapSchemaBatchPlan(
        schema_plan=merged_plan,
        produced_refs=produced_refs,
        dependency_refs=normalized_dependency_refs,
        work_products=merged_plan.table_family_work_products,
    )
    return _schema_static_value_lazy(
        owner,
        batch_plan,
        dependency_refs=normalized_dependency_refs,
    )


@pure_lazy
def _schema_plan_lazy_from_effect_refs(
    owner: LazySchemaTransaction,
    effect_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...],
    *,
    name: SchemaDdlOperationName | AnonymousSchemaDdlOperation,
    phase: SchemaDdlPhase | DefaultSchemaDdlPhase,

) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan]:
    plan_value = _bootstrap_schema_plan_from_refs(

@pure_lazy
def _schema_plan_lazy_from_ddl_statements(
    owner: LazySchemaTransaction,
    statements: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...],
    *,
    name: SchemaDdlOperationName,
    phase: SchemaDdlPhase,
    produced_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
    table_facts: tuple["BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact", ...] = (),
    column_facts: tuple["BootstrapSchemaColumnFact", ...] = (),
    index_facts: tuple["BootstrapSchemaIndexFact", ...] = (),
) -> LazyResult["BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan"]:
    """Lower explicit artifact DDL into a closed bootstrap schema plan."""
    from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import BootstrapSchemaDdlKind, BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan

    ddl_result = owner._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(statements, name=name, phase=phase) if statements else None
    ddl_dependency_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(ddl_result.dependencies())) if ddl_result is not None else ()
    operation = _bootstrap_schema_operation(
        kind=BootstrapSchemaDdlKind.CREATE_INDEX if phase != "create_table" else BootstrapSchemaDdlKind.CREATE_TABLE,
        name=name,
        phase=SchemaDdlPhase(phase),
        ref_id=produced_ref,
        dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
    )
    plan_value = BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan(
        operations=(operation,),
        table_family_facts=table_facts,
        column_facts=column_facts,
        index_facts=index_facts,
        dependency_tail_refs=(operation.produced_ref,),
    )
    return _schema_static_ddl_plan_lazy(
        owner,
        plan_value,
        dependency_refs=tuple(dict.fromkeys((*dependency_refs, *ddl_dependency_refs))),
    )

# The prefixes a ServerPlan uses for the refs it allocates (see the plan's ref allocator).
# A dependency naming one of these is on a step; anything else is a result label or another
# non-step name that no step will ever publish.
_PLAN_REF_PREFIXES = ("step_", "seed_", "out_")


@pure_lazy
def _bootstrap_dml_merge_has_unsettled_dependency(
    dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...],
    *,
    position_by_ref: tuple[tuple[ServerPlanRefId, int], ...],
    merge_index: int,
    step_count: int,
) -> bool:
    """Report whether merging two DML products would relocate work past a dependency.

    A merge moves the later product's statements back to where the earlier one sits and
    discards the later step, so the surviving step must be runnable at that position: every
    ref either product depends on has to be produced before it. Two kinds of dependency
    break that, and both have to be rejected here rather than discovered later.

    The first is a ref produced after the merge point. The second is a ref with no producing
    step in the plan *yet*: bootstrap hands out a result ref and enqueues work that depends
    on it before adding the step that publishes it, so an unknown ref is a forward edge, not
    an absent one. Treating unknown as harmless is what allowed unsafe merges, and their
    cost was not local -- a later merge folded the relocated work into a still earlier
    product, and the contradiction surfaced only when the terminal batch was ordered, as a
    dependency cycle over refs that named neither merge.

    Both products are checked, not just the one being absorbed: a target that already
    carries a forward dependency cannot host relocated work either, which is precisely the
    case that kept the cycle alive after only the absorbed side was screened.
    """
    positions = dict(position_by_ref)
    return any(
        positions.get(dependency_ref, step_count) > merge_index
        for dependency_ref in dependency_refs
        if dependency_ref.startswith(_PLAN_REF_PREFIXES)
    )

class BootstrapRevisionUuid(str):
    """Deterministic UUID text reserved for one bootstrap revision."""


class BootstrapRevisionSeed(str):
    """Digest text used to derive one deterministic bootstrap revision."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BootstrapVersioningDomainIds:
    """Deterministic IDs produced by bootstrap for a versioning domain branch."""

    revision_id: RevisionId
    branch_id: BranchId
    staged_commit_id: StagedCommitId
    revision_branch_index_id: SysId


@pure_lazy
def deterministic_bootstrap_revision_uuid(seed: BootstrapRevisionSeed) -> BootstrapRevisionUuid:
    """Derive a bootstrap revision UUID that sorts before every committed revision.

    Revision visibility predicates compare revision ids lexicographically, which is
    sound for the time-ordered UUIDv7 ids minted at commit time. Bootstrap revisions
    are hash-derived, so their timestamp field is zeroed to keep the derived id below
    every revision committed afterwards.
    """
    digest = str(seed)
    return BootstrapRevisionUuid(f"00000000-0000-7{digest[13:16]}-8{digest[17:20]}-{digest[20:32]}")


@pure_lazy
def deterministic_bootstrap_versioning_domain_ids(
    *,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    branch_name: BranchName,
    workspace_id: WorkspaceId,
) -> BootstrapVersioningDomainIds:
    """Derive the same genesis IDs used by ``ensure_bootstrap_versioning_domain_lazy``."""

    from l1200_versioned_ids import BranchId, RevisionId, StagedCommitId

    branch_hash = _bootstrap_branch_hash(domain.branch_model, branch_name, workspace_id)
    seed = _bootstrap_fact_hash("versioning_genesis_revision", branch_hash)
    revision_uuid = deterministic_bootstrap_revision_uuid(BootstrapRevisionSeed(str(seed)))
    branch_uuid = (
        f"{str(branch_hash)[:8]}-{str(branch_hash)[8:12]}-7{str(branch_hash)[13:16]}-8{str(branch_hash)[17:20]}-{str(branch_hash)[20:32]}"
    )
    staged_hash = _bootstrap_fact_hash(
        "versioning_staged_commit",
        get_table_name(domain.staged_commit_model),
        seed,
    )
    staged_uuid = (
        f"{str(staged_hash)[:8]}-{str(staged_hash)[8:12]}-7{str(staged_hash)[13:16]}-8{str(staged_hash)[17:20]}-{str(staged_hash)[20:32]}"
    )
    return BootstrapVersioningDomainIds(
        revision_id=RevisionId(revision_uuid),
        branch_id=BranchId(branch_uuid),
        staged_commit_id=StagedCommitId(staged_uuid),
        revision_branch_index_id=_bootstrap_revision_branch_index_id(
            revision_id=RevisionId(revision_uuid),
            branch_id=BranchId(branch_uuid),
        ),
    )


_IDENTIFIER_DERIVATION_PROBE_BRANCH_NAME = BranchName("bootstrap-identifier-derivation-probe")
_IDENTIFIER_DERIVATION_PROBE_WORKSPACE_ID = WorkspaceId("00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001")


def bootstrap_identifier_derivation_fingerprint() -> BootstrapFactsHash:
    """Fingerprint the deterministic bootstrap genesis identifier algorithm."""
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import DefaultDomain

    identifiers = deterministic_bootstrap_versioning_domain_ids(
        domain=DefaultDomain,
        branch_name=_IDENTIFIER_DERIVATION_PROBE_BRANCH_NAME,
        workspace_id=_IDENTIFIER_DERIVATION_PROBE_WORKSPACE_ID,
    )
    payload = "|".join(
        str(identifier)
        for identifier in (
            identifiers.revision_id,
            identifiers.branch_id,
            identifiers.staged_commit_id,
            identifiers.revision_branch_index_id,
        )
    )
    return BootstrapFactsHash(hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()[:16])

@pure_lazy
def _cached_replay_table_name(expression: sqlglot_exp.Expression) -> SqlTableName:
    """Return a table name from a parsed DDL subject."""
    match expression:
        case sqlglot_exp.Schema():
            subject = expression.this
        case _:
            subject = expression
    match subject:
        case sqlglot_exp.Table():
            return SqlTableName(subject.name)
        case _:
            return SqlTableName("")


@pure_lazy
def _cached_replay_parsed_statements(sql_text: RawSqlText) -> tuple[sqlglot_exp.Expression, ...]:
    """Parse a cached table-DDL slice for structural replay validation."""
    try:
        statements = parse_sql(sql_text)
    except SqlParseError:
        return ()
    validated: list[sqlglot_exp.Expression] = []
    for statement in statements:
        match statement:
            case None:
                return ()
            case _:
                validated.append(statement)
    return tuple(validated)


@pure_lazy
def _cached_schema_replay_is_self_contained(
    effects: tuple[CachedDdlEffect, ...],
    *,
    existing_tables: tuple[SqlTableName, ...],
    planned_created_tables: tuple[SqlTableName, ...] = (),
) -> bool:
    """Pure preflight for cached DDL that depends on tables created by the replay slice."""
    created_tables = {str(table_name) for table_name in existing_tables}
    created_tables.update(str(table_name) for table_name in planned_created_tables)
    created_columns_by_table: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for effect in effects:
        parsed_statements = _cached_replay_parsed_statements(RawSqlText(effect.sql.strip()))
        if not parsed_statements:
            return False
        for statement in parsed_statements:
            match statement:
                case sqlglot_exp.Create() if statement.args.get("kind") == "TABLE":
                    table_name = _cached_replay_table_name(statement.this)
                    if not table_name:
                        return False
                    created_tables.add(table_name)
                    schema = statement.this
                    match schema:
                        case sqlglot_exp.Schema():
                            created_columns_by_table[table_name] = {
                                column.name for column in schema.expressions if type(column) is sqlglot_exp.ColumnDef
                            }
                        case _:
                            pass
                    for reference in statement.find_all(sqlglot_exp.Reference):
                        target_name = _cached_replay_table_name(reference.this)
                        if not target_name or target_name not in created_tables:
                            return False
                    continue
                case sqlglot_exp.Alter() if statement.args.get("kind") == "TABLE":
                    table_name = _cached_replay_table_name(statement.this)
                    if not table_name or table_name not in created_tables:
                        return False
                    known_columns = created_columns_by_table.get(table_name)
                    for action in statement.args.get("actions") or ():
                        if type(action) is not sqlglot_exp.ColumnDef or known_columns is None:
                            continue
                        if action.name in known_columns and not action.args.get("exists"):
                            return False
                        known_columns.add(action.name)
                    continue
                case _:
                    pass
            sql_text = statement.sql()
            index_match = re.match(_CACHED_REPLAY_CREATE_INDEX_PATTERN, sql_text, re.IGNORECASE)
            if index_match is not None:
                index_table_name = _cached_replay_identifier_name(SchemaObjectName(index_match.group("table")))
                if index_table_name not in created_tables:
                    return False
    return True

class LazySchemaTransaction[
    ConnT: _LazyConnectionBase = _LazyConnectionBase,
](SchemaReconciliationOwner):
    __transaction_surface_mode__ = "lazy"
    """Schema transaction context for schema operations.

    Schema transactions provide a transaction-like context for executing schema operations
    (DDL - Data Definition Language) such as creating tables, indexes, triggers, views,
    and other database structure modifications. Schema transactions are separate from
    data transactions (read/write) and cannot be nested with them.

    **Key Characteristics:**

    - **Non-nestable**: Schema transactions cannot be nested with data transactions
      (read, write, versioned_write) or with other schema transactions.
    - **Session-aware**: Currently only supports SessionId.schema() for system-level operations.
    - **Backend-specific atomicity**: Atomicity is NOT guaranteed across all backends.
      SQLite and PostgreSQL support transactional DDL. MariaDB can implicitly commit DDL.
      Do not assume that a backend can roll back every schema operation.
    - **Failure rollback**: Exceptions roll back transaction-owned changes where the
      backend supports them. Implicitly committed DDL requires explicit compensation.

    **Schema Operations Requiring Schema Transactions:**

    All schema operations must be performed within a schema transaction:

    - ``create_table_from_schema()``: Create tables from Pydantic models
    - ``create_versioned_table()``: Create versioned tables with history tracking
    - ``create_index_from_introspection()``: Create indexes
    - ``create_trigger_from_introspection()``: Create database triggers
    - ``create_view_from_sql()``: Create database views
    - ``create_fts_index()``: Create full-text search indexes
    - ``drop_table()``, ``drop_index()``, ``drop_trigger()``, ``drop_view()``: Drop operations
        - ``create_log_table()``: Create log tables for audit logging

    **Usage Example:**

    Basic schema operations::

        >>> with conn.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema_txn:
        ...     # Create table
        ...     schema_txn.create_table_from_schema(Product)
        _legacy_delegate_stub()
        ...     # Create index
        ...     from data_layer.schema import Index
        ...     idx = Index(name="idx_products_sku_uniq", columns=["sku"], unique=True)
        ...     schema_txn.create_index_from_introspection(idx)
        _legacy_delegate_stub()
        ...     # Create versioned table
        ...     schema_txn.create_versioned_table(VersionedProduct)

    Multiple operations in one transaction::

        >>> with conn.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema_txn:
        ...     schema_txn.create_table_from_schema(User)
        ...     schema_txn.create_table_from_schema(Product)
        ...     schema_txn.create_table_from_schema(Order)
        ...     # All operations execute in the same schema transaction context

    **Non-Nesting Rules:**

    Schema transactions cannot be nested with data transactions::

        >>> # ❌ This will raise ProgrammingError
        >>> def write_fn(txn):
        ...     with conn.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema_txn:
        ...         schema_txn.create_table_from_schema(Product)
        ...
        >>> conn.session(SessionId.system()).write(fn=write_fn)
        ProgrammingError: Schema transactions cannot be nested with data transactions

        >>> # ❌ This will also raise ProgrammingError
        >>> with conn.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema_txn1:
        ...     with conn.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema_txn2:
        ...         pass
        ProgrammingError: Nested schema transactions are not supported

    **Backend-Specific Behavior:**

    - **SQLite, MariaDB, DoltDB**: Auto-commit schema operations immediately.
      Each operation commits as it executes. No rollback support.
    - **PostgreSQL, Neo4j**: Support transactional DDL. Operations can be grouped
      in a transaction, but rollback is not exposed in the API for portability.
    - **MongoDB**: Partial transactional support. Collection creation happens
      outside transactions, but index creation can be transactional in replica sets.

    **Atomicity and Retry Strategy:**

    Since atomicity is not guaranteed across all backends, applications should
    structure schema operations into retryable blocks. Each schema operation
    terminates a conceptual block on auto-commit backends, allowing for retry
    of subsequent operations if needed.

    **Error Handling:**

    Exceptions within a schema transaction context are handled gracefully::

        >>> try:
        ...     with conn.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema_txn:
        ...         schema_txn.create_table_from_schema(Product)
        ...         schema_txn.create_table_from_schema(Product)  # Duplicate
        ... except ProgrammingError as e:
        ...     # On auto-commit backends, first table may already be created
        ...     # Flag is always cleared, allowing retry
        ...     pass

    The schema transaction flag is always cleared on exit, even if an exception
    occurs, allowing for retry logic.

    **See Also:**
        - :meth:`SyncDatabaseConnection.schema_transaction`: Create a schema transaction
        - :class:`SyncDatabaseConnection`: Base connection class
        - :ref:`schema-transactions`: Schema transaction documentation
    """

    @pure_lazy
    def publish_schema_output_lazy[T](
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *,
        operation: LazyOperation[T],

        expected_type: type[T] | Unset = UNSET,
        dependency_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] | Unset = UNSET,
    ) -> LazyResult[T]:
        """Bind one semantic schema output to the runtime plan scope."""
        plan = self._schema_plan
        if plan is None:
            msg = "schema output binding requires an active runtime plan"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return LazyResult.published_ref(
            operation=operation,
            context=plan._flush_ctx,
            ref_id=ref_id,
            expected_type=None if expected_type is UNSET else expected_type,
            dependency_refs=None if dependency_refs is UNSET else dependency_refs,

        if plan is None:
            msg = "schema plan scope has no active runtime binding"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)

    def begin_bootstrap_application_plan(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Start the application terminal without replaying interrogation steps."""
        if self._schema_plan is None:
            msg = "bootstrap interrogation plan must exist before application planning"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        generation = self._schema_plan_generation
        self._schema_plan_generation += 1
        self._schema_operation_plan = SchemaOperationPlan()
        self._schema_plan_builder = _schema_plan_generation_for_planning(generation)
        self._schema_plan = _base_server_plan_module().BaseServerPlan(
            self,
            session_id=self._session_id,
            backend_profile=self.backend_profile,
            semantic_plan_builder=self._schema_plan_builder,
        )
        self._last_schema_ddl_ref_id = None

        self: LazySchemaTransaction,

    ) -> None:

        publish_bootstrap_extension_observation(self._conn, extensions)
        self._backend_profile = _build_schema_backend_profile_runtime(self._conn)

    def record_bootstrap_generation_receipt(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        entries: SchemaGenerationRows,
    ) -> None:

        self._bootstrap_generation_receipt = SchemaGenerationBumps.from_atomic_receipt(
            self._bootstrap_generation_receipt_tags,
            entries,
        )

    def complete_bootstrap_application_plan(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *,
        transaction_committed: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        """Retire an application request after successful plan materialization."""
        if self._schema_plan is None:
            msg = "bootstrap application plan must exist before completion"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        receipt = self._bootstrap_generation_receipt
        if self._bootstrap_generation_receipt_tags and receipt is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Bootstrap application completed without a schema generation receipt")
        self._last_schema_ddl_ref_id = None
        self._bootstrap_application_transaction_completed = transaction_committed
        self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps = receipt if receipt is not None else SchemaGenerationBumps()
        self._schema_plan = None
        publish_bootstrap_hash_helpers_installed(self._conn)

        generation = self._schema_plan_generation

        self._schema_plan_builder = _schema_plan_generation_for_planning(generation)
        self._schema_plan = _base_server_plan_module().BaseServerPlan(

    @pure_lazy
    def bootstrap_projected_columns(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> frozenset[SqlColumnName] | NoColumnSnapshot:
        """Return closed projected columns without consulting runtime metadata."""
        normalized_table_name = SqlTableName(table_name)
        if self.bulk_physical_table_exists(normalized_table_name) is not SchemaFactPresence.ABSENT:
            proof_columns = self._bootstrap_column_proof_snapshot(normalized_table_name)
            if type(proof_columns) is not NoColumnSnapshot:
                return frozenset(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in proof_columns)
            observed_columns = self._schema_reconciliation_column_snapshot(
                normalized_table_name,
            )
            if type(observed_columns) is not NoColumnSnapshot:
                return frozenset(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in observed_columns)
        plan = next(
            (
                operation.bootstrap_ddl_plan
                for operation in reversed(self._schema_operation_plan.operations)
                if operation.kind is SchemaOperationKind.BOOTSTRAP_PROJECTION and operation.bootstrap_ddl_plan is not UNSET
            ),
            None,
        )
        if plan is None:
            from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_physical_contract import physical_schema_contract_for_model

            for model_cls in get_registered_tables():
                contract = physical_schema_contract_for_model(model_cls)
                declared_columns = contract.required_columns_by_table.get(normalized_table_name)
                if declared_columns is not None:
                    return frozenset(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in declared_columns)
            return NoColumnSnapshot()
        owns_table = any(normalized_table_name in table_fact.family_tables for table_fact in plan.table_family_facts)
        columns = frozenset(fact.column_name for fact in plan.column_facts if fact.table_name == normalized_table_name)
        if not owns_table and not columns:
            return NoColumnSnapshot()
        return columns
