            physical_contract_work_products=physical_contract_work_products,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_versioned_table_schema_plan_value_for_planning[ModelT](
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type[ModelT],
        *,
        family_tables: tuple[SqlTableName, ...],
        produced_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
        work_product: BootstrapVersionedFamilyWorkProduct,
    ) -> BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan:
        """Build the per-family schema plan value from a prebuilt work product."""
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import (
            BootstrapSchemaColumnFact,
            BootstrapSchemaDdlKind,
            BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan,
            BootstrapSchemaIndexFact,
            BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact,
        )

        raw_table_name = self._get_model_table_name(cast("Any", model_cls)) or model_cls.__name__
        table_name = SqlTableName(raw_table_name)
        typed_work_product = cast("Any", work_product)
        contract = typed_work_product.physical_contract
        resolved_family_tables = (
            family_tables
            or typed_work_product.family_tables
            or tuple(SqlTableName(table.table_name) for table in contract.tables)
            or (table_name,)
        )
        operation = _bootstrap_schema_operation(
            kind=BootstrapSchemaDdlKind.CREATE_VERSIONED_TABLE_FAMILY,
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"create_versioned_table_family:{table_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_versioned_table_family"),
            ref_id=produced_ref,
            dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
        )
        column_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaColumnFact] = []
        index_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaIndexFact] = []
        column_fact_keys = typed_work_product.column_fact_keys
        if not column_fact_keys:
            column_fact_keys = tuple(
                (SqlTableName(table_contract.table_name), SqlColumnName(column_name))
                for table_contract in contract.tables
                for column_name in table_contract.required_columns
            )
        index_fact_keys = typed_work_product.index_fact_keys
        if not index_fact_keys:
            index_fact_keys = tuple(
                (SqlTableName(table_contract.table_name), SqlIndexName(index_name))
                for table_contract in contract.tables
                for index_name in table_contract.required_indexes
            )
        for fact_table_name, column_name in column_fact_keys:
            source_ref = produced_ref if fact_table_name == table_name else ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:{fact_table_name}")
            column_facts.append(
                BootstrapSchemaColumnFact(
                    table_name=fact_table_name,
                    column_name=column_name,
                    source_ref=source_ref,
                ),
            )
        for fact_table_name, index_name in index_fact_keys:
            source_ref = produced_ref if fact_table_name == table_name else ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:{fact_table_name}")
            index_facts.append(
                BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(
                    table_name=fact_table_name,
                    index_name=index_name,
                    source_ref=source_ref,
                ),
            )
        plan_value = BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan(
            operations=(operation,),
            table_family_facts=(
                BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                    primary_table=table_name,
                    family_tables=resolved_family_tables,
                    schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(contract.facts_hash()[:32]),
                    source_ref=produced_ref,
                ),
            ),
            column_facts=tuple(column_facts),
            index_facts=tuple(index_facts),
            dependency_tail_refs=(produced_ref,),
        )
        return plan_value

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_versioned_table_schema_plan_lazy[ModelT](
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type[ModelT],
        *,
        family_tables: tuple[SqlTableName, ...],
        produced_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan]:
        """Build the closed versioned-table-family work product for bootstrap."""
        from impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.registry import versioned_backend_registry

        raw_table_name = self._get_model_table_name(cast("Any", model_cls)) or model_cls.__name__
        table_name = SqlTableName(raw_table_name)
        dialect = self._conn.get_dialect()
        backend = versioned_backend_registry.get("sparse", self)
        typed_model_cls = cast("type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]]", model_cls)
        backend._apply_table_family_rename_lazy(self, typed_model_cls)
        work_product = backend.build_bootstrap_versioned_family_work_product_for_planning(typed_model_cls, dialect=dialect)
        table_statements = cast("tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]", work_product.ddl.table_statements)
        index_statements = cast("tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]", work_product.ddl.index_statements)
        from l1000_schema.table_registry import get_table_config

        table_config = get_table_config(typed_model_cls)
        reconciliation_snapshot = self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
        if table_config.renamed_from and reconciliation_snapshot is not None:
            new_plural = table_config.plural or get_table_name(typed_model_cls)

            def _rename_supplies_create(target: SqlTableName) -> bool:
                if not str(target).startswith(new_plural):
                    return False
                old_target = SqlTableName(f"{table_config.renamed_from}{str(target)[len(new_plural) :]}")
                return reconciliation_snapshot.table_exists(old_target) is True

            table_statements = tuple(
                statement
                for target, statement in zip(
                    work_product.ddl.family_tables,
                    table_statements,
                    strict=True,
                )
                if not _rename_supplies_create(target)
            )
        ddl_result = self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (*table_statements, *index_statements),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"bootstrap_versioned_table_family:{table_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_versioned_table_family"),
        )
        plan_value = self._bootstrap_versioned_table_schema_plan_value_for_planning(
            model_cls,
            family_tables=family_tables,
            produced_ref=produced_ref,
            dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
            work_product=work_product,
        )
        return _schema_static_ddl_plan_lazy(
            self,
            plan_value,
            dependency_refs=tuple(
                dict.fromkeys(
                    (
                        *dependency_refs,
                        *(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(ddl_result.dependencies())),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def bootstrap_versioned_table_schema_plans_batch_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        contracts: Sequence[_BootstrapSchemaBatchContract],
        *,
        physical_contract_work_products: Sequence["BootstrapPhysicalContractWorkProduct"] = (),
        versioned_family_batch_work_product: "BootstrapVersionedFamilyBatchWorkProduct | NoBootstrapVersionedFamilyBatchWorkProduct" = NoBootstrapVersionedFamilyBatchWorkProduct(),
        strict_products: bool = False,
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaBatchPlan]:
        """Install versioned-table-family schema primitives with one DDL bundle."""
        contracts = tuple(contracts)
        physical_contract_work_products = tuple(physical_contract_work_products)
        if not contracts:
            return _schema_static_ddl_batch_plan_lazy(self, ())
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import BootstrapVersionedTableFamilyPrimitivePayload
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_state import BootstrapPlanningError
        from impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.generic_sparse import (
            BootstrapVersionedFamilyWorkProduct,
            _bootstrap_versioned_family_work_product_cache_key,
        )

        payloads: list[BootstrapVersionedTableFamilyPrimitivePayload] = []
        for contract in contracts:
            payload = contract.payload
            if type(payload) is not BootstrapVersionedTableFamilyPrimitivePayload:
                msg = "versioned table schema batch received a non-versioned-family contract"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            payloads.append(payload)
        from impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.registry import versioned_backend_registry

        backend: GenericSparseVersionedBackend[Any] = cast(
            "GenericSparseVersionedBackend[Any]",
            versioned_backend_registry.get("sparse", self),
        )
        for payload in payloads:
            backend._apply_table_family_rename_lazy(self, payload.model_cls)
        match versioned_family_batch_work_product:
            case NoBootstrapVersionedFamilyBatchWorkProduct():
                batch_was_supplied = False
                if strict_products:
                    msg = "strict bootstrap versioned batch is missing a closed versioned-family work product"
                    raise BootstrapPlanningError(msg)
                batch_work = backend.build_bootstrap_versioned_family_work_products_for_planning(
                    cast("tuple[Any, ...]", tuple(payload.model_cls for payload in payloads)),
                    dialect=self._conn.get_dialect(),
                    physical_contract_work_products=physical_contract_work_products,
                )
            case supplied_batch_work:
                batch_was_supplied = True
                batch_work = supplied_batch_work
        dialect = self._conn.get_dialect()
        diagnostics = batch_work.diagnostics
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
            DiagnosticLabel("versioned_family_batch_diagnostics"),
            DiagnosticLabel("model_count"),
            diagnostics.model_count,
        )
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
            DiagnosticLabel("versioned_family_batch_diagnostics"),
            DiagnosticLabel("physical_family_count"),
            diagnostics.physical_family_count,
        )
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
            DiagnosticLabel("versioned_family_batch_diagnostics"),
            DiagnosticLabel("cache_hits"),
            diagnostics.cache_hits,
        )
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
            DiagnosticLabel("versioned_family_batch_diagnostics"),
            DiagnosticLabel("rebuilt_families"),
            diagnostics.rebuilt_families,
        )
        work_products: list[BootstrapVersionedFamilyWorkProduct] = []
        table_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        table_source_refs: list[str] = []
        index_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        index_source_refs: list[str] = []
        emitted_work_product_keys: set[object] = set()
        emitted_work_products: list[tuple[BootstrapVersionedFamilyWorkProduct, ServerPlanRefId]] = []
        for contract, payload in zip(contracts, payloads, strict=True):
            cache_key = _bootstrap_versioned_family_work_product_cache_key(
                payload.model_cls,
                dialect,
            )
            work_product = batch_work.work_product_for_key(cache_key)
            work_products.append(work_product)
            produced_ref = contract.produced_ref
            if cache_key in emitted_work_product_keys:
                self._schema_operation_plan.add_duplicate_ddl_source_ref(produced_ref)
                continue
            emitted_work_product_keys.add(cache_key)
            emitted_work_products.append((work_product, produced_ref))
            family_table_statements = work_product.ddl.table_statements
            from l1000_schema.table_registry import get_table_config

            table_config = get_table_config(payload.model_cls)
            reconciliation_snapshot = self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
            if table_config.renamed_from and reconciliation_snapshot is not None:
                snapshot = reconciliation_snapshot
                new_plural = table_config.plural or get_table_name(payload.model_cls)

                def _rename_supplies_create(target: SqlTableName) -> bool:
                    if not str(target).startswith(new_plural):
                        return False
                    old_target = SqlTableName(f"{table_config.renamed_from}{str(target)[len(new_plural) :]}")
                    return snapshot.table_exists(old_target) is True

                family_table_statements = tuple(
                    statement
                    for target, statement in zip(
                        work_product.ddl.family_tables,
                        family_table_statements,
                        strict=True,
                    )
                    if not _rename_supplies_create(target)
                )
            table_statements.extend(family_table_statements)
            table_source_refs.extend(str(produced_ref) for _statement in family_table_statements)
            # Keep each trigger after its physical table in the same ordered DDL bundle.
            replacement_statements = _managed_trigger_replacement_statements(
                payload.trigger_artifacts,
            )
            table_statements.extend(replacement_statements)
            table_source_refs.extend(str(produced_ref) for _statement in replacement_statements)
        ddl_result = self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            tuple(table_statements),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_versioned_table_family_tables"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_versioned_table_family"),
            logical_source_refs=tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in table_source_refs),
        )
        ddl_dependency_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(str(ref_id)) for ref_id in sorted(ddl_result.dependencies()))
        plan_values: list[BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan] = []
        all_dependency_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        for payload in payloads:
            if batch_was_supplied:
                from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_table_info import VersionedBaseTableName, derive_versioned_table_names

                reconciliation_snapshot = self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
                sparse_table_name = SqlTableName(
                    derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(get_table_name(payload.model_cls)))).sparse
                )
                if reconciliation_snapshot is None or reconciliation_snapshot.table_exists(sparse_table_name) is not True:
                    continue
            if backend is None:
                from impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.registry import versioned_backend_registry

                backend = cast("GenericSparseVersionedBackend[Any]", versioned_backend_registry.get("sparse", self))
            reconcile_result = backend.ensure_auxiliary_tables_lazy(payload.model_cls, self)
            log_reconcile_result = backend._evolve_versioned_log_table_schema_lazy(
                self,
                payload.model_cls,
            )
            ddl_dependency_refs = tuple(
                dict.fromkeys(
                    (
                        *ddl_dependency_refs,
                        *_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(reconcile_result),
                        *_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(log_reconcile_result),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        for work_product, produced_ref in emitted_work_products:
            family_index_statements = work_product.ddl.index_statements
            index_statements.extend(family_index_statements)
            index_source_refs.extend(str(produced_ref) for _statement in family_index_statements)
            for table_name in work_product.family_tables:
                self._schema_operation_plan.project_create_table(table_name)
                self._project_table_exists_lazy(table_name)
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
            DiagnosticLabel("versioned_family_batch_diagnostics"),
            DiagnosticLabel("emitted_statement_count"),
            len(table_statements) + len(index_statements),
        )
        index_ddl_result = self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            tuple(index_statements),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_versioned_table_family_indexes"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_versioned_table_family_indexes"),
            logical_source_refs=tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in index_source_refs),
        )
        ddl_dependency_refs = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *ddl_dependency_refs,
                    *(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(index_ddl_result.dependencies())),
                ),
            ),
        )
        from impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.sql_schema_services import (
            _persist_large_column_metadata_impl_lazy,
        )
        from impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.versioned_fk_triggers import (
            create_retroactive_versioned_fk_triggers_batch_lazy,
            create_vv_fk_triggers_lazy,
        )

        versioned_models = tuple(dict.fromkeys(payload.model_cls for payload in payloads))
        retroactive_fk_plan = create_retroactive_versioned_fk_triggers_batch_lazy(self, versioned_models)
        ddl_dependency_refs = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *ddl_dependency_refs,
                    *_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(retroactive_fk_plan),
                ),
            ),
        )
        persisted_metadata_models: set[type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]]] = set()
        for model_cls in versioned_models:
            if model_cls in persisted_metadata_models:
                continue
            persisted_metadata_models.add(model_cls)
            _persist_large_column_metadata_impl_lazy(self, model_cls)
            vv_fk_plan = create_vv_fk_triggers_lazy(self, model_cls)
            ddl_dependency_refs = tuple(
                dict.fromkeys(
                    (
                        *ddl_dependency_refs,
                        *_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(vv_fk_plan),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        for contract, payload, work_product in zip(contracts, payloads, work_products, strict=True):
            dependency_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in contract.dependency_refs)
            produced_ref = contract.produced_ref
            plan_values.append(
                self._bootstrap_versioned_table_schema_plan_value_for_planning(
                    payload.model_cls,
                    family_tables=payload.family_tables,
                    produced_ref=produced_ref,
                    dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
                    work_product=work_product,
                )
            )
            all_dependency_refs.extend(dependency_refs)
        return _schema_static_ddl_batch_plan_lazy(
            self,
            tuple(plan_values),
            dependency_refs=tuple(dict.fromkeys((*all_dependency_refs, *ddl_dependency_refs))),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_queue_schema_batch_item_for_planning(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        payload: BootstrapQueuePrimitivePayload,
        *,
        produced_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
    ) -> BootstrapQueueSchemaBatchItem:
        """Build queue storage table and index work without enqueueing DDL."""
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import BootstrapQueuePrimitivePayload
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import (
            BootstrapSchemaDdlKind,
            BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan,
            BootstrapSchemaIndexFact,
            BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact,
        )
        from l4100_queue.queue_definition import QueueDefinition, _build_sql_queue_indexes_for_planning

        if type(payload) is not BootstrapQueuePrimitivePayload:
            msg = "ENSURE_QUEUE requires a queue primitive payload"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        if type(payload.value) is not QueueDefinition:
            msg = "ENSURE_QUEUE requires a QueueDefinition payload value"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        table_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:tables")
        index_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:indexes")
        table_item = self._bootstrap_table_schema_batch_item_for_planning(
            _require_database_row_models(cast("tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...]", payload.storage_models)),
            produced_ref=table_ref,
            dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
        )
        queue_definition = payload.value
        index_statements = _build_sql_queue_indexes_for_planning(
            queue_definition,
            is_mysql_family=self._conn.backend_type.is_mysql_family,
        )
        queue_table = SqlTableName("sys_queue_messages")
        operations = (
            _bootstrap_schema_operation(
                kind=BootstrapSchemaDdlKind.CREATE_TABLE,
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"queue_tables:{payload.queue_name}"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("queue_storage"),
                ref_id=table_ref,
                dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
            ),
            _bootstrap_schema_operation(
                kind=BootstrapSchemaDdlKind.CREATE_INDEX,
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"queue_indexes:{payload.queue_name}"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("queue_index"),
                ref_id=index_ref,
                dependency_refs=(table_ref,),
            ),
        )
        plan_value = BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan(
            operations=operations,
            table_family_facts=(
                BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                    primary_table=queue_table,
                    family_tables=payload.storage_tables,
                    schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(
                        hashlib.sha256("|".join(str(table_name) for table_name in payload.storage_tables).encode()).hexdigest()[:32],
                    ),
                    source_ref=table_ref,
                ),
            ),
            index_facts=tuple(
                BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(
                    table_name=queue_table,
                    index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                    source_ref=index_ref,
                )
                for index_name in payload.index_names
            ),
            dependency_tail_refs=(table_ref, index_ref),
        )
        return BootstrapQueueSchemaBatchItem(
            produced_ref=produced_ref,
            table_ref=table_ref,
            index_ref=index_ref,
            table_item=table_item,
            index_statements=tuple(index_statements),
            index_source_refs=tuple(index_ref for _statement in index_statements),
            plan_value=plan_value,
        )

                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_content_addressable_tables"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table"),
                logical_source_refs=tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in table_source_refs),
            )
            ddl_dependency_refs.extend(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(table_result.dependencies()))
        if index_statements:
            index_result = self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                tuple(index_statements),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_content_addressable_indexes"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_content_addressable:indexes"),
                logical_source_refs=tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in index_source_refs),
            )
            ddl_dependency_refs.extend(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(index_result.dependencies()))
        if backend_statements:
            backend_result = self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                tuple(backend_statements),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_content_addressable_backend_helpers"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
                logical_source_refs=tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in backend_source_refs),
            )
            ddl_dependency_refs.extend(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(backend_result.dependencies()))
        shared_dependency_refs = tuple(dict.fromkeys(ddl_dependency_refs))
        published_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        for contract, plan_value in per_contract:
            produced_ref = contract.produced_ref
            source_refs = (
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:tables"),
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:indexes"),
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:backend_helpers"),
            )
            alias_dependency_refs = self._bootstrap_ddl_duplicate_proof_dependency_refs(
                source_refs,
                canonical_dependency_refs=shared_dependency_refs,
            )
            self._ingest_bootstrap_schema_plan(plan_value)
            published_refs.append(
                _publish_schema_static_value_ref(
                    self,
                    plan_value,
                    dependency_refs=tuple(
                        dict.fromkeys(
                            (
                                *(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in contract.dependency_refs),
                                *shared_dependency_refs,
                                *alias_dependency_refs,
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                    ref_id=produced_ref,
                ),
            )
        return _schema_static_ddl_batch_plan_lazy(
            self,
            tuple(plan_value for _contract, plan_value in per_contract),
            dependency_refs=tuple(published_refs),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_large_column_schema_batch_item_for_planning(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        payload: BootstrapLargeColumnSchemaPrimitivePayload,
        *,
        produced_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
    ) -> BootstrapTableSchemaBatchItem:
        """Build the large-column metadata table as a table-schema batch item."""
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.content_store import SqlCreateLargeColumnsMetaTable
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import BootstrapLargeColumnSchemaPrimitivePayload
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import BootstrapSchemaDdlKind, BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan, BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact

        if type(payload) is not BootstrapLargeColumnSchemaPrimitivePayload:
            msg = "large-column schema batch requires a large-column schema payload"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        operation = _bootstrap_schema_operation(
            kind=BootstrapSchemaDdlKind.CREATE_TABLE,
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"large_column_metadata:{payload.table_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table"),
            ref_id=produced_ref,
            dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
        )
        plan_value = BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan(
            operations=(operation,),
            table_family_facts=(
                BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                    primary_table=payload.table_name,
                    family_tables=(payload.table_name,),
                    schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(hashlib.sha256(str(payload.table_name).encode()).hexdigest()[:32]),
                    source_ref=produced_ref,
                ),
            ),
            dependency_tail_refs=(produced_ref,),
        )
        return BootstrapTableSchemaBatchItem(
            produced_ref=produced_ref,
            dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
            statements=(SqlCreateLargeColumnsMetaTable(),),
            logical_source_refs=(produced_ref,),
            plan_value=plan_value,
        )

                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            items.append(
                self._bootstrap_large_column_schema_batch_item_for_planning(
                    payload,
                    produced_ref=contract.produced_ref,
                    dependency_refs=tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in contract.dependency_refs),

            )
        all_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        all_source_refs: list[str] = []
        for item in items:

            all_source_refs.extend(item.logical_source_refs)
        ddl_dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = ()
        if all_statements:
            ddl_result = self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(

    @pure_lazy
    def bootstrap_search_config_schema_plans_batch_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        contracts: Sequence[_BootstrapSchemaBatchContract],
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan]:
        """Install FTS/vector config tables and publish one data-plan batch."""
        contracts = tuple(contracts)
        if not contracts:
            return _bootstrap_data_plan_lazy(
                self,
                _merge_bootstrap_data_primitive_plans(()),
                dependency_refs=(),
            )
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import BootstrapConfigMetadataPrimitivePayload, BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan
        from l3200_metadata.hashing import compute_fts_config_hash, compute_vector_config_hash

        fts_record_model = _get_fts_index_config_record_model()
        vector_record_model = _get_vector_index_config_record_model()
        table_items_by_kind: dict[str, BootstrapTableSchemaBatchItem] = {}
        payloads_by_contract: list[tuple[_BootstrapSchemaBatchContract, BootstrapConfigMetadataPrimitivePayload]] = []
        for contract in contracts:
            payload = contract.payload
            if type(payload) is not BootstrapConfigMetadataPrimitivePayload or payload.config_kind not in {"fts", "vector"}:
                msg = "search config schema batch requires FTS or vector config payloads"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            payloads_by_contract.append((contract, payload))
            if payload.config_kind in table_items_by_kind:
                continue
            produced_ref = contract.produced_ref
            dependency_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in contract.dependency_refs)
            record_model = fts_record_model if payload.config_kind == "fts" else vector_record_model
            table_items_by_kind[payload.config_kind] = self._bootstrap_table_schema_batch_item_for_planning(
                _require_database_row_models((record_model,)),
                produced_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:schema"),
                dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
            )

        all_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        all_source_refs: list[str] = []
        for item in table_items_by_kind.values():
            all_statements.extend(item.statements)
            all_source_refs.extend(item.logical_source_refs)
        ddl_dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = ()
        if all_statements:
            ddl_result = self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                tuple(all_statements),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_search_config_tables"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table"),
                logical_source_refs=tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in all_source_refs),
            )
            ddl_dependency_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(ddl_result.dependencies()))

        plan_values = _BootstrapPlanningList[BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan]()
        published_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        for contract, payload in payloads_by_contract:
            produced_ref = contract.produced_ref
            dependency_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in contract.dependency_refs)
            if payload.config_kind == "fts":
                model_cls = cast("type[Any]", payload.model_cls)
                fts_config_module = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l5100_fts.fts_config"))
                config = fts_config_module.get_fts_config(model_cls)
                if config is None:
                    msg = "ENSURE_FTS_CONFIG_METADATA requires an FTS-configured model"
                    raise RuntimeError(msg)
                fts_naming_module = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l5100_fts.fts_naming"))
                table_name = str(get_table_name(model_cls))
                index_name = str(fts_naming_module.fts_index_name(table_name))
                config_hash = SchemaFingerprintHash(
                    compute_fts_config_hash(
                        fields=list(config.fields),
                        tokenizer=str(config.tokenizer),
                        tokenizer_config=dict(config.tokenizer_config),
                        languages=list(config.languages),
                        min_term_length=config.min_term_length,
                        max_term_length=config.max_term_length,
                        prefix_indexes=list(config.prefix_indexes),
                        strategy=str(config.strategy.value),
                        index_policy_scope=config.index_policy.scope.value,
                        index_policy_maintenance=config.index_policy.maintenance.value,
                        content_hash_index=config.index_policy.content_hash_index,
                        native_index=config.index_policy.native_index,
                    )
                )
                row = fts_record_model(
                    table_name=table_name,
                    index_name=index_name,
                    indexed_fields=list(config.fields),
                    languages=list(config.languages),
                    tokenizer=str(config.tokenizer),
                    tokenizer_config=dict(config.tokenizer_config),
                    min_term_length=config.min_term_length,
                    max_term_length=config.max_term_length,
                    strategy=str(config.strategy.value),
                    prefix_indexes=list(config.prefix_indexes),
                    index_policy_scope=config.index_policy.scope.value,
                    index_policy_maintenance=config.index_policy.maintenance.value,
                    content_hash_index=config.index_policy.content_hash_index,
                    native_index=config.index_policy.native_index,
                    config_hash=config_hash,
                )
                self.upsert_bootstrap_rows_lazy(
                        cast("Any", fts_record_model),
                        (row,),
                        conflict_fields=(DynamicFieldName("table_name"),),
                        exclude_fields=(DynamicFieldName("sys_id"),),
                        dependency_refs=tuple(
                            dict.fromkeys(
                                (
                                    *dependency_refs,
                                    *ddl_dependency_refs,
                                    *self._bootstrap_ddl_duplicate_proof_dependency_refs(
                                        (ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:schema"),),
                                        canonical_dependency_refs=ddl_dependency_refs,
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                        ),
                        produced_refs=(produced_ref,),
                        planning_values=plan_values,
                    )
                published_refs.append(produced_ref)
                continue

            model_cls = cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", payload.model_cls)
            from l5200_vector_index.index_resolution import resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind
            from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import get_vector_indexes

            configs = get_vector_indexes(model_cls)
            if not configs:
                msg = "ENSURE_VECTOR_CONFIG_METADATA requires a vector-configured model"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            table_name = str(get_table_name(model_cls))
            rows: list[ApplicationObjectRow[SysId] | BootstrapRowMutationWorkProduct] = []
            for config in configs.values():
                backend_kind_value = _vector_bootstrap_backend_kind_value(
                    self._conn,
                    config,
                    VectorIndexTableName(table_name),
                    resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind,
                )
                index_policy = config.resolved_index_policy
                requested_implementation = index_policy.requested_implementation
                effective_implementation = VectorIndexEffectiveImplementation(backend_kind_value)
                artifact_format_version = CURRENT_VECTOR_ARTIFACT_FORMATS[effective_implementation]
                dimensions = config.dimensions
                index_name = str(config.index_name)
                metric = config.metric.value
                strategy = str(config.strategy.value)
                storage_precision = config.precision_hint.value if config.precision_hint is not None else None
                config_hash = SchemaFingerprintHash(
                    compute_vector_config_hash(
                        index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                        metric=metric,
                        strategy=strategy,
                        dimensions=dimensions,
                        storage_precision=storage_precision,
                        target_dimensions=config.target_dimensions,
                        hnsw_m=config.m,
                        hnsw_ef_construction=config.ef_construction,
                        hnsw_ef_search=config.ef_search,
                        index_policy_scope=index_policy.scope.value,
                        index_policy_maintenance=index_policy.maintenance.value,
                        native_index=index_policy.native_index,
                        approximate_index=index_policy.approximate_index,
                        batch_size=config.batch_size,
                        requested_implementation=requested_implementation,
                        effective_implementation=effective_implementation,
                        artifact_format_version=artifact_format_version,
                    )
                )
                rows.append(
                    vector_record_model(
                        table_name=table_name,
                        index_name=index_name,
                        requested_implementation=requested_implementation,
                        backend_kind=effective_implementation,
                        artifact_format_version=artifact_format_version,
                        metric=metric,
                        strategy=strategy,
                        dimensions=dimensions,
                        target_dimensions=config.target_dimensions,
                        storage_precision=storage_precision,
                        hnsw_m=config.m,
                        hnsw_ef_construction=config.ef_construction,
                        hnsw_ef_search=config.ef_search,
                        batch_size=config.batch_size,
                        index_policy_scope=index_policy.scope.value,
                        index_policy_maintenance=index_policy.maintenance.value,
                        native_index=index_policy.native_index,
                        approximate_index=index_policy.approximate_index,
                        searchable_row_schema_version=1,
                        config_hash=config_hash,
                    ),
                )
            self.upsert_bootstrap_rows_lazy(
                    cast("Any", vector_record_model),
                    tuple(rows),
                    conflict_fields=(DynamicFieldName("table_name"), DynamicFieldName("index_name")),
                    # Ordinary bootstrap cannot publish a new implementation. Preserve the
                    # active selection until an explicit migration atomically switches it.
                    # See docs/design/VECTOR_INDEX_IMPLEMENTATION_SELECTION.rst.
                    exclude_fields=(
                        DynamicFieldName("sys_id"),
                        DynamicFieldName("requested_implementation"),
                        DynamicFieldName("backend_kind"),
                        DynamicFieldName("artifact_format_version"),
                        DynamicFieldName("config_hash"),
                    ),
                    dependency_refs=tuple(
                        dict.fromkeys(
                            (
                                *dependency_refs,
                                *ddl_dependency_refs,
                                *self._bootstrap_ddl_duplicate_proof_dependency_refs(
                                    (ServerPlanRefId(f"{produced_ref}:schema"),),
                                    canonical_dependency_refs=ddl_dependency_refs,
                                ),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                    produced_refs=(produced_ref,),
                    planning_values=plan_values,
                )
            published_refs.append(produced_ref)
        return _bootstrap_data_plan_lazy(
            self,
            _merge_bootstrap_data_primitive_plans(tuple(plan_values)),
            dependency_refs=tuple(published_refs),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_fts_index_work_product_for_planning(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        payload: BootstrapFtsIndexPrimitivePayload,
        produced_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> BootstrapFtsIndexWorkProduct:
        """Build backend-native FTS DDL work products without enqueueing schema DDL."""
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import BootstrapFtsIndexPrimitivePayload

        if type(payload) is not BootstrapFtsIndexPrimitivePayload:
            msg = "FTS work-product builder received an unsupported payload"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        fts_config_module = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l5100_fts.fts_config"))
        config = fts_config_module.get_fts_config(payload.model_cls)
        if config is None:
            msg = f"ENSURE_FTS_INDEX requires an FTS configuration for {payload.model_cls.__name__}"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        manager = self._conn.get_fts_manager()

        return manager._build_bootstrap_fts_work_product(payload, config, produced_ref)

    @pure_lazy
    def bootstrap_search_vector_ddl_work_products_batch_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        contracts: Sequence[_BootstrapSchemaBatchContract],
        *,
        result_dependency_refs: _BootstrapPlanningSink[ServerPlanRefId] = _DISCARD_BOOTSTRAP_DEPENDENCY_REFS,
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaBatchPlan]:
        """Install FTS, vector, and dynamic-search DDL work products by phase."""
        contracts = tuple(contracts)
        if not contracts:
            return _schema_static_ddl_batch_plan_lazy(self, ())
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import (
            BootstrapDynamicSearchSchemaPrimitivePayload,
            BootstrapFtsIndexPrimitivePayload,
            BootstrapVectorIndexPrimitivePayload,
        )
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import (
            BootstrapSchemaColumnFact,
            BootstrapSchemaIndexFact,
            BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact,
        )

        from l5100_fts.fts_config import FTSIndexImplementation, get_fts_config

        direct_dependency_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        items: list[tuple[ServerPlanRefId, BootstrapDdlWorkProduct, tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]]] = []
        for contract in contracts:
            payload = contract.payload
            produced_ref = contract.produced_ref
            dependency_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in contract.dependency_refs)
            if type(payload) is BootstrapDynamicSearchSchemaPrimitivePayload:
                items.append(
                    (
                        produced_ref,
                        BootstrapDynamicSearchSchemaWorkProduct(
                            name=SchemaDdlOperationName("dynamic_search_schema"),
                            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("dynamic_search_schema"),
                            statements=payload.statements,
                        ),
                        dependency_refs,
                    ),
                )
                continue
            if type(payload) is BootstrapFtsIndexPrimitivePayload:
                config = get_fts_config(payload.model_cls)
                explicit_polyfill = config is not None and config.implementation is FTSIndexImplementation.POLYFILL
                if explicit_polyfill:
                    direct_result = self.create_polyfill_fts_artifacts_lazy(payload.model_cls)
                    direct_refs = _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(direct_result)
                    direct_dependency_refs.extend(direct_refs)
                    result_dependency_refs.extend(direct_refs)
                else:
                    items.append(
                        (
                            produced_ref,
                            self._bootstrap_fts_index_work_product_for_planning(payload, produced_ref),
                            dependency_refs,
                        ),
                    )
                continue
            if type(payload) is not BootstrapVectorIndexPrimitivePayload:
                msg = "search/vector DDL batch received an unsupported payload"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            from l5200_vector_index.index_resolution import resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind
            from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import (
                get_vector_config,
                get_vector_indexes,
                resolve_vector_index_policy,
            )

            index_artifact_kind = IndexArtifactKind
            index_workload = IndexWorkload
            model_cls = cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", payload.model_cls)
            indexes = get_vector_indexes(model_cls)
            if not indexes:
                msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} does not have a vector index configured. Use @vector_indexed decorator."
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            vector_config = get_vector_config(model_cls, str(payload.index_name))
            if vector_config is None:
                msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} has no vector index '{payload.index_name}'"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            backend_kind_value = _vector_bootstrap_backend_kind_value(
                self._conn,
                vector_config,
                VectorIndexTableName(str(get_table_name(model_cls))),
                resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind,
            )
            vector_decision = resolve_vector_index_policy(
                vector_config,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                workload=index_workload.SCHEMA_BOOTSTRAP,
                backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
            )
            statements = []
            artifact_table_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact] = []
            artifact_column_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaColumnFact] = []
            artifact_index_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaIndexFact] = []
            if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and index_artifact_kind.EXACT_VECTOR_STORAGE in vector_decision.artifact_kinds:
                statements.append(_pgvector_extension_grammar())
                projection_statements, embedding_table, index_names = self._bootstrap_pgvector_projection_statements(
                    model_cls,
                    vector_config,
                    dimensions=(payload.dimensions if payload.dimensions is not None else UnknownVectorDimensions()),
                )
                statements.extend(projection_statements)
                artifact_table_facts.append(
                    BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                        primary_table=embedding_table,
                        family_tables=(embedding_table,),
                        schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(
                            hashlib.sha256(
                                f"vector:{payload.table_name}:{payload.index_name}:{payload.config_fingerprint}".encode(),
                            ).hexdigest()[:32],
                        ),
                        source_ref=produced_ref,
                    ),
                )
                artifact_index_facts.extend(
                    BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(
                        table_name=embedding_table,
                        index_name=index_name,
                        source_ref=produced_ref,
                    )
                    for index_name in index_names
                )
            elif backend_kind_value == "usearch":
                if self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE and not _usearch_requires_cumulative_storage(model_cls):
                    source_table = SqlTableName(str(get_table_name(model_cls)))
                    native_table = SqlTableName(f"sys_{source_table}_{vector_config.index_name!s}_usearch")
                    statements.append(
                        _sqlite_native_usearch_grammar(
                            source_table,
                            vector_config,
                            payload.dimensions if payload.dimensions is not None else UnknownVectorDimensions(),
                        )
                    )
                    artifact_table_facts.append(
                        BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                            primary_table=native_table,
                            family_tables=(native_table,),
                            schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(
                                hashlib.sha256(f"native-usearch:{source_table}:{vector_config.index_name!s}".encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
                            ),
                            source_ref=produced_ref,
                        )
                    )
                else:
                    from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_table_family_work_product import (
                        build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product,
                    )
                    from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import create_usearch_index_class

                    statements.append(_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers_grammar())
                    usearch_model = create_usearch_index_class(get_table_name(model_cls))
                    usearch_product = build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product(
                        usearch_model,
                        dialect=self._conn.get_dialect(),
                        fts_nonce=None,
                        json_schema_check_available=None,
                        content_store_table_name=None,
                    )
                    statements.extend(usearch_product.statements)
                    artifact_table_facts.append(
                        BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                            primary_table=usearch_product.table_name,
                            family_tables=usearch_product.family_tables,
                            schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(usearch_product.fingerprint[:32]),
                            source_ref=produced_ref,
                        )
                    )
                    artifact_column_facts.extend(
                        BootstrapSchemaColumnFact(table_name=name, column_name=column_name, source_ref=produced_ref)
                        for name, column_name in usearch_product.column_fact_keys
                    )
                    artifact_index_facts.extend(
                        BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(table_name=name, index_name=name_index, source_ref=produced_ref)
                        for name, name_index in usearch_product.index_fact_keys
                    )
            elif backend_kind_value == "sql_table_hnsw":
                from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_table_family_work_product import build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product
                from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import (
                    create_hnsw_content_edge_class,
                    create_hnsw_content_node_class,
                    create_hnsw_edge_class,
                    create_hnsw_metadata_class,
                    create_hnsw_node_class,
                )

                if self._conn.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
                    statements.append(_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers_grammar())
                    source_table_name = str(payload.table_name)
                    hnsw_models: tuple[type, ...] = (
                        create_hnsw_node_class(source_table_name),
                        create_hnsw_edge_class(source_table_name),
                        create_hnsw_content_node_class(source_table_name),
                        create_hnsw_content_edge_class(source_table_name),
                        create_hnsw_metadata_class(source_table_name),
                    )
                    # Declared MariaDB models already own their physical helper closure.
                    # Runtime dynamic models are not part of that run-scoped bootstrap set.
                    if self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.MARIADB and not is_dynamic_type(model_cls):
                        hnsw_models = ()
                    for hnsw_model in hnsw_models:
                        hnsw_product = build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product(
                            hnsw_model,
                            dialect=self._conn.get_dialect(),
                            fts_nonce=None,
                            json_schema_check_available=None,
                            content_store_table_name=None,
                        )
                        statements.extend(hnsw_product.statements)
                        artifact_table_facts.append(
                            BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                                primary_table=hnsw_product.table_name,
                                family_tables=hnsw_product.family_tables,
                                schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(hnsw_product.fingerprint[:32]),
                                source_ref=produced_ref,
                            )
                        )
                        artifact_column_facts.extend(
                            BootstrapSchemaColumnFact(
                                table_name=table_name,
                                column_name=column_name,
                                source_ref=produced_ref,
                            )
                            for table_name, column_name in hnsw_product.column_fact_keys
                        )
                        artifact_index_facts.extend(
                            BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(
                                table_name=table_name,
                                index_name=index_name,
                                source_ref=produced_ref,
                            )
                            for table_name, index_name in hnsw_product.index_fact_keys
                        )
                elif self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE:
                    from impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.schema_builder import (
                        create_table_grammar_if_not_exists,
                        generate_create_index_grammar,
                        generate_create_table_grammar,
                    )
                    from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import (
                        create_hnsw_content_edge_class,
                        create_hnsw_content_node_class,
                        create_hnsw_edge_class,
                        create_hnsw_metadata_class,
                        create_hnsw_node_class,
                    )

                    source_table_name = str(payload.table_name)
                    for aux_model in (
                        create_hnsw_node_class(source_table_name),
                        create_hnsw_edge_class(source_table_name),
                        create_hnsw_content_node_class(source_table_name),
                        create_hnsw_content_edge_class(source_table_name),
                        create_hnsw_metadata_class(source_table_name),
                    ):
                        create_table = generate_create_table_grammar(
                            aux_model,
                            self._conn.get_dialect(),
                            fts_nonce=None,
                            json_schema_check_available=None,
                        )
                        statements.append(create_table_grammar_if_not_exists(create_table))
                        statements.extend(generate_create_index_grammar(aux_model, self._conn.get_dialect()))
                else:
                    msg = f"ENSURE_VECTOR_INDEX has no pure builder for backend vector kind {backend_kind_value!r}"
                    raise RuntimeError(msg)
            elif index_artifact_kind.NATIVE_SEARCH in vector_decision.artifact_kinds:
                msg = f"ENSURE_VECTOR_INDEX has no pure builder for backend vector kind {backend_kind_value!r}"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            if backend_kind_value != "sql_table_hnsw" and is_dynamic_type(model_cls):
                from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_table_family_work_product import build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product
                from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import (
                    create_hnsw_edge_class,
                    create_hnsw_metadata_class,
                    create_hnsw_node_class,
                )

                if self._conn.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
                    statements.append(_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers_grammar())
                for hnsw_model in (
                    create_hnsw_node_class(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                    create_hnsw_edge_class(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                    create_hnsw_metadata_class(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                ):
                    hnsw_product = build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product(
                        hnsw_model,
                        dialect=self._conn.get_dialect(),
                        fts_nonce=None,
                        json_schema_check_available=None,
                        content_store_table_name=None,
                    )
                    statements.extend(hnsw_product.statements)
                    artifact_table_facts.append(
                        BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                            primary_table=hnsw_product.table_name,
                            family_tables=hnsw_product.family_tables,
                            schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(hnsw_product.fingerprint[:32]),
                            source_ref=produced_ref,
                        )
                    )
                    artifact_column_facts.extend(
                        BootstrapSchemaColumnFact(
                            table_name=table_name,
                            column_name=column_name,
                            source_ref=produced_ref,
                        )
                        for table_name, column_name in hnsw_product.column_fact_keys
                    )
                    artifact_index_facts.extend(
                        BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(
                            table_name=table_name,
                            index_name=index_name,
                            source_ref=produced_ref,
                        )
                        for table_name, index_name in hnsw_product.index_fact_keys
                    )
            if not statements and backend_kind_value not in {"sql_table_hnsw", "usearch"}:
                msg = "ENSURE_VECTOR_INDEX produced no vector artifact DDL"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            items.append(
                (
                    produced_ref,
                    BootstrapVectorIndexWorkProduct(
                        name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_index:{payload.table_name}:{payload.index_name}"),
                        phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_projection"),
                        statements=tuple(statements),
                        table_facts=tuple(artifact_table_facts),
                        column_facts=tuple(artifact_column_facts),
                        index_facts=tuple(artifact_index_facts),
                    ),
                    dependency_refs,
                ),
            )
        return self.bootstrap_ddl_work_products_batch_lazy(
            tuple(items),
            batch_name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_search_vector_ddl"),
            additional_dependency_refs=tuple(direct_dependency_refs),
            result_dependency_refs=result_dependency_refs,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def bootstrap_ddl_work_products_batch_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        items: Sequence[tuple[ServerPlanRefId, BootstrapDdlWorkProduct, tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]]],
        *,
        batch_name: SchemaDdlOperationName,
        additional_dependency_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId] = (),
        result_dependency_refs: _BootstrapPlanningSink[ServerPlanRefId] = _DISCARD_BOOTSTRAP_DEPENDENCY_REFS,
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaBatchPlan]:
        """Install typed DDL work products with one bundle per ordering phase."""
        items = tuple(items)
        if not items:
            return _schema_static_ddl_batch_plan_lazy(self, ())
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import BootstrapSchemaDdlKind, BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan

        statements_by_phase: dict[str, list[SqlRenderable]] = {}
        source_refs_by_phase: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for produced_ref, work_product, _dependency_refs in items:
            statements_by_phase.setdefault(work_product.phase, []).extend(work_product.statements)
            source_refs_by_phase.setdefault(work_product.phase, []).extend(str(produced_ref) for _statement in work_product.statements)

        dependency_refs_by_phase: dict[str, tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]] = {}
        for phase, statements in statements_by_phase.items():
            if not statements:
                dependency_refs_by_phase[phase] = ()
                continue
            ddl_result = self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                tuple(statements),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"{batch_name}:{phase}"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase(phase),
                logical_source_refs=tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in source_refs_by_phase[phase]),
            )
            from l2070_batching.server_ref import inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning

            ddl_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                ddl_result,
                site=f"bootstrap DDL bundle {batch_name}:{phase}",
            )
            dependency_refs_by_phase[phase] = tuple(
                dict.fromkeys(
                    (
                        *((ddl_shape.symbolic_ref_id,) if ddl_shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None else ()),
                        *(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(ddl_shape.dependency_refs)),
                    ),
                ),
            )

        plan_values: list[BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan] = []
        batch_dependency_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        for produced_ref, work_product, dependency_refs in items:
            operation = _bootstrap_schema_operation(
                kind=BootstrapSchemaDdlKind.CREATE_TABLE if work_product.phase == "create_table" else BootstrapSchemaDdlKind.CREATE_INDEX,
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(work_product.name),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase(work_product.phase),
                ref_id=produced_ref,
                dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
            )
            plan_value = BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan(
                operations=(operation,),
                table_family_facts=work_product.table_facts,
                column_facts=work_product.column_facts,
                index_facts=work_product.index_facts,
                dependency_tail_refs=(operation.produced_ref,),
            )
            plan_values.append(plan_value)
            batch_dependency_refs.extend(dependency_refs)
            batch_dependency_refs.extend(dependency_refs_by_phase[work_product.phase])
        result = _schema_static_ddl_batch_plan_lazy(
            self,
            tuple(plan_values),
            dependency_refs=tuple(dict.fromkeys((*additional_dependency_refs, *batch_dependency_refs))),
        )
        result_dependency_refs.extend(_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(result))
        return result

    @pure_lazy
    def bootstrap_search_indexes_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        fts_model_types: Sequence[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]],
        vector_index_targets: Sequence[tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], VectorIndexName]],
    ) -> LazyResult[int]:
        """Compose content-addressable, FTS, and vector work products into one lazy result."""
        fts_model_types = tuple(fts_model_types)
        vector_index_targets = tuple(vector_index_targets)
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import (
            BootstrapContentAddressableEmbeddingSchemaPrimitivePayload,
            BootstrapFtsIndexPrimitivePayload,
            BootstrapVectorIndexPrimitivePayload,
        )
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_state import BootstrapPrimitiveState
        from l1400_types.type_surface_contracts import BootstrapPrimitiveContributorKey
        from l5100_fts.fts_config import get_fts_config
        from l5100_fts.fts_naming import fts_index_name
        from l5100_fts.fts_planning import fts_bootstrap_planning_targets
        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import get_vector_config

        processed = len(fts_model_types) + len(vector_index_targets)
        if processed == 0:
            return _schema_static_value_lazy(self, 0)

        fts_manager = self._conn.get_fts_manager()
        for model_type in fts_model_types:
            if fts_manager._uses_polyfill(model_type):
                fts_polyfill_module = load_connection_module(
                    ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l5150_fts_polyfill.manager"),
                )
                fts_polyfill_module.FTSPolyfillManager()._create_fts_index_for_schema_impl(
                    self,
                    model_type,
                )

        state = BootstrapPrimitiveState(dialect=self._conn.get_dialect())
        state.ensure_content_addressable_embedding_schema(
            BootstrapPrimitiveContributorKey("dynamic-search-indexes"),
        )
        content_payload = state.desired_primitives[0].payload
        if type(content_payload) is not BootstrapContentAddressableEmbeddingSchemaPrimitivePayload:
            msg = "content-addressable bootstrap contributor produced an invalid payload"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)

        content_ref = ServerPlanRefId(self.plan()._next_ref())
        content_result = self.ensure_bootstrap_content_addressable_embedding_schema_lazy(
            content_payload,
            produced_ref=content_ref,
        )
        content_dependencies = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(content_result.dependencies()))

        contracts: list[BootstrapSingleSchemaBatchContract] = []
        for model_type in fts_model_types:
            fts_config = get_fts_config(model_type)
            if fts_config is None:
                msg = f"{model_type.__name__} is not configured for FTS"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_type))
            contracts.append(
                BootstrapSingleSchemaBatchContract(
                    BootstrapFtsIndexPrimitivePayload(
                        model_cls=model_type,
                        table_name=table_name,
                        index_name=SqlIndexName(fts_index_name(str(table_name))),
                        indexed_fields=tuple(str(field_name) for field_name in fts_config.fields),
                        config_fingerprint=fts_config.bootstrap_fingerprint(),
                        physical_targets=fts_bootstrap_planning_targets(
                            model_type,
                            fts_config,
                            dialect=self._conn.get_dialect(),
                        ),
                    ),
                    ServerPlanRefId(self.plan()._next_ref()),
                    content_dependencies,
                ),
            )

        for model_type, index_name in vector_index_targets:
            vector_config = get_vector_config(model_type, index_name)
            if vector_config is None:
                msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has no vector index {index_name!r}"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_type))
            contracts.append(
                BootstrapSingleSchemaBatchContract(
                    BootstrapVectorIndexPrimitivePayload(
                        model_cls=model_type,
                        table_name=table_name,
                        index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                        dimensions=vector_config.dimensions,
                        metric=str(vector_config.metric.value),
                        strategy=str(vector_config.strategy.value),
                        config_fingerprint=vector_config.index_policy_fingerprint(),
                    ),
                    ServerPlanRefId(self.plan()._next_ref()),
                    content_dependencies,
                ),
            )

        search_dependency_refs = _BootstrapPlanningList[ServerPlanRefId]()
        self.bootstrap_search_vector_ddl_work_products_batch_lazy(
            cast("tuple[_BootstrapSchemaBatchContract, ...]", tuple(contracts)),
            result_dependency_refs=search_dependency_refs,
        )
        completion_dependencies = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *content_dependencies,
                    *search_dependency_refs,
                ),
            ),
        )
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            self,
            processed,
            dependency_refs=completion_dependencies,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_trigger_work_product_for_planning(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        payload: (
            BootstrapTableEventTriggerPrimitivePayload | BootstrapCommitTriggersPrimitivePayload | BootstrapTriggerDdlPrimitivePayload
        ),
        *,
        primitive_name: BootstrapPrimitiveName | Unset = UNSET,
    ) -> BootstrapTriggerWorkProduct:
        """Build closed trigger DDL or application-registration work."""
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import (
            BootstrapCommitTriggersPrimitivePayload,
            BootstrapTableEventTriggerPrimitivePayload,
            BootstrapTriggerDdlPrimitivePayload,
        )

        if type(payload) is BootstrapTableEventTriggerPrimitivePayload:
            from l4100_queue.triggers import TableEventTrigger
            from l4100_queue.triggers import build_table_trigger_bootstrap_work_product_for_planning

            trigger = cast(TableEventTrigger, payload.trigger)
            table_trigger_work = build_table_trigger_bootstrap_work_product_for_planning(
                trigger,
                backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
            )
            return BootstrapTriggerWorkProduct(
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("table_event_triggers"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("trigger"),
                statements=table_trigger_work.statements,
                primitive_name=BootstrapPrimitiveName("ENSURE_TABLE_EVENT_TRIGGER"),
                trigger_names=(SqlTriggerName(payload.trigger_name),),
                target_tables=(payload.table_name,),
                internal_objects=(BootstrapInternalObjectName(f"queue:{payload.queue_name}"),),
                application_registration=(
                    table_trigger_work.application_registration if table_trigger_work.application_registration is not None else UNSET
                ),
            )
        if type(payload) is BootstrapCommitTriggersPrimitivePayload:
            statements = tuple(
                payload.registry.build_bootstrap_trigger_ddl_for_planning(
                    backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
                ),
            )
            if not statements:
                msg = (
                    "ENSURE_COMMIT_TRIGGERS requires producer-owned trigger DDL; "
                    f"scope={payload.scope!r} fingerprint={payload.fingerprint!r}"
                )
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            return BootstrapTriggerWorkProduct(
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("commit_triggers"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("trigger"),
                statements=statements,
                primitive_name=BootstrapPrimitiveName("ENSURE_COMMIT_TRIGGERS"),
                internal_objects=(BootstrapInternalObjectName(f"commit_scope:{payload.scope}:{payload.fingerprint}"),),
            )
        if type(payload) is not BootstrapTriggerDdlPrimitivePayload:
            msg = "trigger batch requires a trigger primitive payload"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        if primitive_name is not UNSET and payload.primitive_name != primitive_name:
            msg = f"{primitive_name} received trigger payload for {payload.primitive_name}"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        if not payload.statements:
            msg = f"{payload.primitive_name} requires a non-empty trigger payload"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        phase = "staged_trigger_materialized" if payload.primitive_name == "ENSURE_STAGED_TABLE_TRIGGERS" else "trigger"
        return BootstrapTriggerWorkProduct(
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(payload.primitive_name.lower()),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase(phase),
            statements=payload.statements,
            primitive_name=payload.primitive_name,
            internal_objects=(BootstrapInternalObjectName(f"{payload.primitive_name}:{payload.fingerprint}"),),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def bootstrap_trigger_work_products_batch_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        contracts: Sequence[
            _BootstrapSchemaBatchContract[
                BootstrapTableEventTriggerPrimitivePayload | BootstrapCommitTriggersPrimitivePayload | BootstrapTriggerDdlPrimitivePayload
            ]
        ],
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaBatchPlan]:
        """Install trigger work products with one DDL bundle per trigger phase."""
        contracts = tuple(contracts)
        items: list[tuple[ServerPlanRefId, BootstrapDdlWorkProduct, tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]]] = []
        application_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        for contract in contracts:
            payload = contract.payload
            produced_ref = contract.produced_ref
            dependency_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in contract.dependency_refs)
            work_product = self._bootstrap_trigger_work_product_for_planning(payload)
            registration = work_product.application_registration
            if registration is UNSET:
                items.append(
                    (
                        produced_ref,
                        work_product,
                        dependency_refs,
                    ),
                )
                continue
            from l4100_queue.triggers import RegisterApplicationQueueTriggerEffect

            application_refs.append(
                _publish_schema_static_value_ref(
                    self,
                    registration,
                    dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
                    ref_id=produced_ref,
                    lifecycle_effects=(RegisterApplicationQueueTriggerEffect(registration),),
                ),
            )
        return self.bootstrap_ddl_work_products_batch_lazy(
            tuple(items),
            batch_name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_triggers"),
            additional_dependency_refs=tuple(application_refs),
        )

    def drop_table_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        *,
        if_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaDdlOperation]:
        """Record a table drop for schema flush materialization."""
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import BootstrapSchemaDdlKind

        self._build_ddl_effect_lazy(
            SqlDropObject(
                kind=DropKind.TABLE,
                name=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name)),

                table_name=SqlTableName(table_name),
                idempotent=if_exists,
            ),
        )
        self._record_table_dropped(SqlTableName(table_name))
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            self,
            _bootstrap_schema_operation(
                kind=BootstrapSchemaDdlKind.CREATE_TABLE,
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"drop_table:{table_name}"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("drop_table"),
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"schema-drop-table:{table_name}"),
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _project_static_naming_metadata_dependencies_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
    ) -> None:
        """Project naming metadata DDL before materializing dependent schema operations."""
        if not any(
            operation.schema_model is not UNSET
            and operation.kind is SchemaOperationKind.CREATE_TABLE
            and model_participates_in_static_naming_metadata(operation.schema_model)
            for operation in self._schema_operation_plan.operations
        ):
            return
        from l3200_metadata.api_name_binding_metadata import ApiNameBindingMetadata
        from l3200_metadata.semantic_object_metadata import SemanticObjectMetadata

        self._project_materializable_schema_model(
            cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", SemanticObjectMetadata),
