    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_vector_index_schema_artifacts_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        *,
        index_name: VectorIndexName | Unset = UNSET,
        dimensions: int | UnknownVectorDimensions = UnknownVectorDimensions(),
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Lower vector schema artifacts without config persistence side effects."""
        from l5200_vector_index.index_resolution import resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind
        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import (
            get_vector_config,
            get_vector_indexes,
            resolve_vector_index_policy,
        )

        index_artifact_kind = IndexArtifactKind
        index_workload = IndexWorkload

        indexes = get_vector_indexes(model_type)
        if not indexes:
            msg = f"{model_type.__name__} does not have a vector index configured. Use @vector_indexed decorator."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if index_name is UNSET:
            if len(indexes) == 1:
                index_name = VectorIndexName(next(iter(indexes.keys())))
            else:
                index_names = ", ".join(sorted(indexes.keys()))
                msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has multiple vector indexes ({index_names}). Specify which one with index_name='name'."
                raise ValueError(msg)

        config = get_vector_config(model_type, index_name)
        if config is None:
            msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has no vector index '{index_name}'"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        self._ensure_shared_vector_embedding_schema()
        backend_kind_value = _vector_bootstrap_backend_kind_value(
            self._conn,
            config,
            VectorIndexTableName(str(get_table_name(model_type))),
            resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind,
        )
        if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.POSTGRES:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.pgvector.pgvector import (
                SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers,
            )

            self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                (
                    _pgvector_extension_grammar(),
                    SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers(),
                ),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("vector_backend:pgvector_extension"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
            )
            _clear_capabilities_cache(self._conn)
        vector_decision = resolve_vector_index_policy(
            config,
            model_cls=model_type,
            workload=index_workload.SCHEMA_BOOTSTRAP,
            backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
        )
        if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and index_artifact_kind.EXACT_VECTOR_STORAGE in vector_decision.artifact_kinds:
            self._bootstrap_pgvector_projection_schema(
                model_type,
                config,
                dimensions=dimensions,
            )
        elif backend_kind_value in {"sql_table_hnsw", "usearch"}:
            if self._conn.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
                self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                    tuple((_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers_grammar(),)),
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName("vector_backend:sql_table_hnsw_helpers"),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
                )
            if backend_kind_value == "sql_table_hnsw":
                self._schema_backend._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(self, model_type)
            elif self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE and not _usearch_requires_cumulative_storage(model_type):
                source_table = SqlTableName(str(get_table_name(model_type)))
                self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                    (_sqlite_native_usearch_grammar(source_table, config, dimensions),),
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_backend:native_usearch:{source_table}:{config.index_name!s}"),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
                )
                self._record_schema_change(SqlTableName(f"sys_{source_table}_{config.index_name!s}_usearch"))
            else:
                from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import create_usearch_index_class

                self._schema_backend._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(
                    self,
                    create_usearch_index_class(str(get_table_name(model_type))),
                    if_not_exists=True,
                )
        # Non-SQL-table vector backends own their search artifacts outside SQL
        # schema planning; this transaction records schema dependencies only.
        self._record_schema_change(self._get_model_table_name(model_type))
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            self,
            None,
            dependency_refs=self._schema_ddl_dependency_refs(),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _persist_direct_vector_config_metadata_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: VectorIndexConfig,
        backend_kind_value: VectorBackendKind,
        *,
        dimensions: int | UnknownVectorDimensions,
    ) -> None:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
            SqlColumnList,
            SqlOnConflict,
            SqlValuesClause,
            SqlValuesRow,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import ConflictAction
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlInlineLiteral
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlInsert
        from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name

        vector_record_model = _get_vector_index_config_record_model()
        index_policy = config.resolved_index_policy
        requested_implementation = index_policy.requested_implementation
        effective_implementation = VectorIndexEffectiveImplementation(backend_kind_value)
        artifact_format_version = CURRENT_VECTOR_ARTIFACT_FORMATS[effective_implementation]
        table_name = str(get_table_name(model_type))
        index_name = str(config.index_name)
        metric = config.metric.value
        strategy = str(config.strategy.value)
        storage_precision = config.precision_hint.value if config.precision_hint is not None else None
        match dimensions:
            case UnknownVectorDimensions():
                requested_dimensions = None
            case int() as concrete_dimensions:
                requested_dimensions = concrete_dimensions
        persisted_dimensions = config.dimensions if config.dimensions is not None else requested_dimensions
        from l3200_metadata.hashing import compute_vector_config_hash

        config_hash = SchemaFingerprintHash(
            compute_vector_config_hash(
                index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                metric=metric,
                strategy=strategy,
                dimensions=persisted_dimensions,
                storage_precision=storage_precision,
                target_dimensions=config.target_dimensions,
                hnsw_m=config.m,
                hnsw_ef_construction=config.ef_construction,
                hnsw_ef_search=config.ef_search,
                index_policy_scope=index_policy.scope.value,
                index_policy_maintenance=index_policy.maintenance.value,
                native_index=index_policy.native_index,
                approximate_index=index_policy.approximate_index,
                batch_size=config.batch_size,
                requested_implementation=requested_implementation,
                effective_implementation=effective_implementation,
                artifact_format_version=artifact_format_version,
            )
        )
        values_by_field: dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None] = {
            "sys_id": str(SysId.new()),
            "table_name": table_name,
            "index_name": index_name,
            "requested_implementation": requested_implementation.value,
            "backend_kind": effective_implementation.value,
            "artifact_format_version": int(artifact_format_version),
            "metric": metric,
            "strategy": strategy,
            "dimensions": persisted_dimensions,
            "target_dimensions": config.target_dimensions,
            "storage_precision": storage_precision,
            "hnsw_m": config.m,
            "hnsw_ef_construction": config.ef_construction,
            "hnsw_ef_search": config.ef_search,
            "batch_size": config.batch_size,
            "index_policy_scope": index_policy.scope.value,
            "index_policy_maintenance": index_policy.maintenance.value,
            "native_index": index_policy.native_index,
            "approximate_index": index_policy.approximate_index,
            "searchable_row_schema_version": 1,
            "config_hash": config_hash,
        }
        field_names = tuple(values_by_field)
        db_columns = tuple(get_db_column_name(vector_record_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in field_names)
        conflict_columns = (
            SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(vector_record_model, DynamicFieldName("table_name"))),
            SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(vector_record_model, DynamicFieldName("index_name"))),
        )
        immutable_selection_columns = {
            "sys_id",
            "table_name",
            "index_name",
            "requested_implementation",
            "backend_kind",
            "artifact_format_version",
            "config_hash",
        }
        update_columns = tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in db_columns if column not in immutable_selection_columns)
        statement = SqlInsert(
            SqlTableName(get_table_name(vector_record_model)),
            columns=SqlColumnList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in db_columns]),
            values=SqlValuesClause(
                [
                    SqlValuesRow(
                        [SqlParam(values_by_field[field_name]) for field_name in field_names],
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            on_conflict=SqlOnConflict(
                conflict_columns,
                ConflictAction.DO_UPDATE,
                update_columns=update_columns,
            ),
        )
        self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (statement,),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_config_metadata:{table_name}:{index_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_config_metadata"),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def create_vector_index_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        *,
        index_name: VectorIndexName | Unset = UNSET,
        dimensions: int | UnknownVectorDimensions = UnknownVectorDimensions(),
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Create vector index for a model with @vector_indexed decorator.

        This creates the embedding storage table and configures the appropriate
        vector index for the backend:

        - PostgreSQL: Uses pgvector HNSW index
        - MongoDB: Uses Atlas Vector Search (requires Atlas M10+)
        - Neo4j: Uses native vector indexes (5.11+)
        - SQLite, MariaDB, DoltDB: Uses HNSW polyfill

        Design reference:
            ``docs/design/HNSW_SERVERPLAN_MAINTENANCE_REARCHITECTURE.md``

        Args:
            model_type: Model class with @vector_indexed decorator
            index_name: Name of the index (required if multiple, optional if single)
            dimensions: Embedding dimensions (required for Neo4j, optional for others)

        Raises:
            ValueError: If model doesn't have vector configuration
            RuntimeError: If backend doesn't support vector indexes

        Example::

            @vector_indexed("content")
            class Document(ApplicationObjectRow):
                content: str

            with conn.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema_txn:
                schema_txn.create_table_from_schema(Document)
                schema_txn.create_vector_index(Document, dimensions=1536)
        """
        from l5200_vector_index.index_resolution import resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind
        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import (
            get_vector_config,
            get_vector_indexes,
            resolve_vector_index_policy,
        )

        index_artifact_kind = IndexArtifactKind
        index_workload = IndexWorkload

        indexes = get_vector_indexes(model_type)
        if not indexes:
            msg = f"{model_type.__name__} does not have a vector index configured. Use @vector_indexed decorator."
            raise ValueError(msg)

        # Auto-select if single index
        if index_name is UNSET:
            if len(indexes) == 1:
                index_name = VectorIndexName(next(iter(indexes.keys())))
            else:
                index_names = ", ".join(sorted(indexes.keys()))
                msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has multiple vector indexes ({index_names}). Specify which one with index_name='name'."
                raise ValueError(msg)

        config = get_vector_config(model_type, index_name)
        if config is None:
            msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has no vector index '{index_name}'"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        vector_index_config_record = _get_vector_index_config_record_model()
        vector_config_table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(vector_index_config_record))
        if self.projected_or_cached_table_exists(vector_config_table_name) is not SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT:
            with self._schema_table_exists_cache_mutation_scope():
                self._schema_backend._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(
                    self,
                    vector_index_config_record,
                    if_not_exists=True,
                )

        # Bootstrap the shared vector schema explicitly inside the active schema
        # transaction rather than relying on a nested helper transaction.
        self._ensure_shared_vector_embedding_schema()

        backend_kind_value = _vector_bootstrap_backend_kind_value(
            self._conn,
            config,
            VectorIndexTableName(str(get_table_name(model_type))),
            resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind,
        )
        if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.POSTGRES:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.pgvector.pgvector import (
                SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers,
            )

            self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                (
                    _pgvector_extension_grammar(),
                    SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers(),
                ),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("vector_backend:pgvector_extension"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
            )
            _clear_capabilities_cache(self._conn)
        vector_decision = resolve_vector_index_policy(
            config,
            model_cls=model_type,
            workload=index_workload.SCHEMA_BOOTSTRAP,
            backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
        )
        if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and index_artifact_kind.EXACT_VECTOR_STORAGE in vector_decision.artifact_kinds:
            self._bootstrap_pgvector_projection_schema(
                model_type,
                config,
                dimensions=dimensions,
            )
        elif backend_kind_value in {"sql_table_hnsw", "usearch"}:
            if self._conn.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
                self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                    tuple((_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers_grammar(),)),
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName("vector_backend:sql_table_hnsw_helpers"),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
                )
            if backend_kind_value == "sql_table_hnsw":
                self._schema_backend._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(self, model_type)
            elif self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE and not _usearch_requires_cumulative_storage(model_type):
                source_table = SqlTableName(str(get_table_name(model_type)))
                self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                    (_sqlite_native_usearch_grammar(source_table, config, dimensions),),
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_backend:native_usearch:{source_table}:{config.index_name!s}"),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
                )
                self._record_schema_change(SqlTableName(f"sys_{source_table}_{config.index_name!s}_usearch"))
            else:
                from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import create_usearch_index_class

                self._schema_backend._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(
                    self,
                    create_usearch_index_class(str(get_table_name(model_type))),
                    if_not_exists=True,
                )

        # Non-SQL-table vector backends own their search artifacts outside SQL
        # schema planning; this transaction persists their configuration only.
        self._persist_direct_vector_config_metadata_lazy(
            model_type,
            config,
            backend_kind_value,
            dimensions=dimensions,
        )
        self._record_schema_change(self._get_model_table_name(model_type))
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            self,
            None,
            dependency_refs=self._schema_ddl_dependency_refs(),
        )

            operation="SyncSchemaTransaction.flush_schema_plan()",

        pending_count = self._pending_schema_ddl_work_count()
        if pending_count == 0:
            _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush_skipped"), DiagnosticLabel("sync_empty"))
            return
        reason = "schema_phases" if run_callbacks else "pre_phase_boundary"
        if pending_count >= _MAX_BULK_SCHEMA_DDL_EFFECTS_PER_FLUSH:

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.pgvector.pgvector import (

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.sql_table_hnsw.sql_table_hnsw import (

        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import resolve_vector_column_spec

        sql_ensure_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers = SqlEnsureSqlTableHnswEmbeddingHelpers
        sql_create_vector_embedding_table = SqlCreateVectorEmbeddingTable
        sql_create_vector_scope_index = SqlCreateVectorScopeIndex
        sql_create_vector_source_id_index = SqlCreateVectorSourceIdIndex

        table_name = get_table_name(model_type)
        embedding_table = f"{table_name}_{config.index_name}_embeddings"
        column_spec = resolve_vector_column_spec(model_type, config)
        match dimensions:
            case UnknownVectorDimensions():
                requested_dimensions = None
            case int() as requested_dimensions:
                pass
        resolved_dimensions = requested_dimensions if column_spec is None or column_spec.dimensions is None else column_spec.dimensions
        metric_to_ops_class = {
            "cosine": "vector_cosine_ops",
            "euclidean": "vector_l2_ops",
            "dot_product": "vector_ip_ops",
        }

        ddl_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            sql_ensure_pgvector_embedding_helpers(),
            sql_ensure_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers(),
            sql_create_vector_embedding_table(
                sql_table_name(embedding_table),
                dimensions=resolved_dimensions,
                binary_dimensions=config.native_binary_dimensions,
            ),
            sql_create_vector_source_id_index(
                index_name=SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_source_id")),
                table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
            ),
            sql_create_vector_scope_index(
                index_name=SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_branch_revision")),
                table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
            ),
        ]
        self._record_schema_change(SqlTableName(embedding_table))

        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import resolve_vector_index_policy

        index_artifact_kind = IndexArtifactKind
        index_workload = IndexWorkload
        decision = resolve_vector_index_policy(
            config,
            model_cls=model_type,
            workload=index_workload.SCHEMA_BOOTSTRAP,
            backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
        )
        if resolved_dimensions is None or index_artifact_kind.APPROXIMATE_VECTOR not in decision.artifact_kinds:
            self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                tuple(ddl_statements),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_projection:{embedding_table}"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_projection"),
            )
            return
        if not config.resolved_index_policy.approximate_index:
            self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                tuple(ddl_statements),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_projection:{embedding_table}"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_projection"),
            )
            return

        ddl_statements.append(
            sql_create_hnsw_index(
                index_name=SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_embedding_hnsw")),
                table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
                column=sql_column_name("embedding"),
                ops_class=grammar_vector_metric(metric_to_ops_class[config.metric.value]),
                m=config.m,
                ef_construction=config.ef_construction,
            ),
        )
        if config.native_binary_dimensions is not None:
            ddl_statements.append(
                sql_create_hnsw_index(
                    index_name=SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_embedding_binary_hamming_hnsw")),
                    table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
                    column=sql_column_name("embedding_binary"),
                    ops_class=grammar_vector_metric("bit_hamming_ops"),
                    m=config.m,
                    ef_construction=config.ef_construction,

            )
        self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(

            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_projection:{embedding_table}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_projection"),

class AsyncSchemaTransaction(
    AsyncSchemaTransactionContextMixin,
    SyncSchemaTransactionContextMixin,
    LazySchemaTransaction,
):
    """Async schema transaction for native async DDL execution paths."""

    @external_io_boundary
    def _exit_sync(
        self,
        exception_state: SchemaExitExceptionState,
    ) -> None:
        del exception_state
        msg = "Use 'async with conn.schema_transaction_async(...)' for async schema work."
        raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _enter_async(self) -> AsyncSchemaTransaction:
        if self._entered or self._exited:
            msg = "Schema transaction context manager can only be entered once"
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

        authority_context = explicit_execution_authority()
        authority_context.__enter__()
        self._explicit_authority_context = authority_context
        try:
            conn = self._prepare_schema_enter_common(operation=ConnectionOperationName("async schema transaction"))
            if not in_bootstrap_schema_write_boundary() and not _is_admin_session():
                lockdown_mode = await get_lockdown_mode_async(
                    cast("AsyncDatabaseConnection", self._conn),
                    session_id=self._session_id,
                )
                if lockdown_mode is not LockdownMode.UNLOCKED:
                    raise DDLLockdownError(lockdown_mode)
            self._activate_enter_state(conn)
            await self._finish_enter_after_lockdown_async(log_label=DiagnosticLabel("__aenter__"))
            return self
        except BaseException:
            self._exit_explicit_authority_context()
            raise

    async def __aenter__(self) -> AsyncSchemaTransaction:
        record_profile_counter(ProfileCounterName("schema_transaction_enter_async"))
        return await self._enter_async()

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _cleanup_failed_enter_async(self, *, log_label: DiagnosticLabel) -> None:
        """Clean up partially opened async schema work without swallowing failures."""
        await super()._cleanup_failed_enter_async(log_label=log_label)

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _exit_async(
        self,
        exception_state: SchemaExitExceptionState,
    ) -> None:
        try:
            with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.finalize_exit_async")):
                committed, cleanup_errors = await self._finalize_exit_async(
                    exception_state,
                    mode_label=DiagnosticLabel("async"),
                    cleanup_label=DiagnosticLabel("async cleanup"),
                    commit=self._commit_schema_transaction_async,
                    rollback=self._rollback_schema_transaction_async,
                )
            post_commit_error: Exception | None = None
            if committed:
                try:
                    with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit_steps_async")):
                        await self._run_post_commit_steps_async(
                            invalidate=self._post_commit_schema_invalidation_async,
                        )
                except Exception as exc:
                    post_commit_error = exc
            original_error: BaseException | Unset
            match exception_state.exception_value:
                case NoExceptionValue():
                    original_error = UNSET
                case BaseException() as concrete_error:
                    original_error = concrete_error
            self._raise_deferred_exit_errors(
                cleanup_label=DiagnosticLabel("async cleanup"),
                cleanup_errors=tuple(cleanup_errors),
                post_commit_error=UNSET if post_commit_error is None else post_commit_error,
                original_error=original_error,
            )
        finally:
            self._exit_explicit_authority_context()

    @asynccontextmanager
    @external_io_boundary
    async def bulk_schema_context_async(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> AsyncGenerator[None]:
        """Async counterpart of :meth:`bulk_schema_context`."""
        from l2055_lazy_result.purity import intent_build_context_lazy

        outermost = self._bulk_schema_depth == 0
        self._bulk_schema_depth += 1
        should_flush = False
        try:
            if outermost:
                proven_tables = self._proven_existing_table_names_from_connection()
                observed_tables = (
                    proven_tables
                    if proven_tables is not None and type(proven_tables) is not NoTableSnapshot
                    else frozenset(SqlTableName(str(table_name)) for table_name in await self._conn._list_tables_under_authority_async())
                )
                self._bulk_table_names_snapshot = frozenset(SqlTableName(str(table_name)) for table_name in observed_tables)
                table_info_by_name: dict[SqlTableName, tuple[TableInfoRow, ...]] = {}
                for table_name in self._bulk_table_names_snapshot:
                    normalized_table_name = SqlTableName(table_name)
                    table_info_by_name[normalized_table_name] = tuple(
                        await self._conn._backend_schema_service.get_table_info_async(
                            normalized_table_name,
                        ),
                    )
                self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot = self._build_bulk_observation_snapshot(
                    tuple(table_info_by_name.items()),
                )
            with intent_build_context_lazy():
                yield
            should_flush = True
        finally:
            self._bulk_schema_depth -= 1
            if self._bulk_schema_depth == 0:
                try:
                    if should_flush:
                        with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("bulk_schema_context_async.flush_schema_plan")):
                            await self.flush_schema_plan_async()
                finally:
                    self._bulk_backend_executors.clear()
                    self._bulk_table_names_snapshot = None
                    self._bulk_column_snapshots.clear()

            return
        reason = "schema_phases" if run_callbacks else "pre_phase_boundary"
        if pending_count >= _MAX_BULK_SCHEMA_DDL_EFFECTS_PER_FLUSH:

        elif self._bulk_schema_mode_active():

        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush"), DiagnosticLabel("async"))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush_reason"), DiagnosticLabel(f"async:{reason}"))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush_pending_effects"), DiagnosticLabel("async"), pending_count)
        with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(

@pure_lazy
def _ensure_shared_table_subclass_columns_lazy(
    schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    shared_table_base: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    table_name: SqlTableName,
) -> None:
    """Ensure STI subclass-only columns exist on the shared physical table."""
    base_field_names = set(cached_model_fields(shared_table_base))
    model_fields = cached_model_fields(model_cls)
    snapshot = schema_txn._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
    for field_name, field_info in model_fields.items():
        if field_name in base_field_names:
            continue
        db_col_name = SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(str(field_name))))
        _call_schema_add_column_if_missing_lazy(
            schema_txn,
            table_name,
            db_col_name,
            field_info,
            resolved_annotation=field_info.annotation,
            force_nullable=True,
            snapshot=snapshot,
        )

@pure_lazy
def _collect_large_column_metadata_for_planning(
    model_cls: type,
) -> tuple[LargeColumnMetadataSnapshot, ...]:
    """Collect immutable metadata from a versioned model declaration."""
    if not is_versioned_object_model(model_cls) or not has_table_config(model_cls):
        return ()
    large_columns = get_table_config(model_cls).large_columns
    if not large_columns:
        return ()

    metadata: list[LargeColumnMetadataSnapshot] = []
    for config in large_columns:
        large_column_config = object_of_type_or_none(config, LargeColumnConfig)
        config_mapping = mapping_or_none(config)
        if large_column_config is not None:
            compression_policy = large_column_config.compression_policy
            application_compression = large_column_application_compression_enabled(
                parse_column_compression_policy(compression_policy),
            )
            metadata.append(
                LargeColumnMetadataSnapshot.model_validate(
                    {
                        "column": SqlColumnName(str(large_column_config.column)),
                        "spill_threshold_bytes": large_column_config.spill_threshold_bytes,
                        "content_type": large_column_config.content_type,
                        "compression_policy": compression_policy,
                        "resolved_compression": "application_zstd" if application_compression else None,
                        "compression_algorithm": "zstd" if application_compression else None,
                        "compression_level": 6 if application_compression else None,
                        "native_compression_applied": False if application_compression else None,
                    },
                ),
            )
            continue
        if config_mapping is None:
            continue
        column_name = config_mapping.get("column")
        if not column_name:
            continue
        compression_policy_text = str(config_mapping.get("compression_policy", "default"))
        application_compression = large_column_application_compression_enabled(
            parse_column_compression_policy(compression_policy_text),
        )
        metadata.append(
            LargeColumnMetadataSnapshot.model_validate(
                {
                    "column": SqlColumnName(str(column_name)),
                    "spill_threshold_bytes": config_mapping.get("spill_threshold_bytes"),
                    "content_type": config_mapping.get("content_type"),
                    "compression_policy": compression_policy_text,
                    "resolved_compression": "application_zstd" if application_compression else None,
                    "compression_algorithm": "zstd" if application_compression else None,
                    "compression_level": 6 if application_compression else None,
                    "native_compression_applied": False if application_compression else None,
                },
            ),
        )
    return tuple(metadata)


@pure_lazy
def _persist_large_column_metadata_impl_lazy(
    schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
    model_cls: type,
) -> LazyResult[SqlSchemaServiceEffectResult]:
    metadata = _collect_large_column_metadata_for_planning(model_cls)
    if not metadata:
        return LazyResult.of(None)

    ensure_large_column_metadata_table_lazy(schema_txn)
    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    timestamp = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    metadata_json = json.dumps(
        [snapshot.model_dump(mode="json") for snapshot in metadata],
        sort_keys=True,
    )

    delete_stmt = SqlDelete(
        SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("versioned_large_columns")),
        where=SQL_TABLE_NAME_EQ,
    )
    insert_stmt = _large_column_metadata_insert_stmt()
    schema_txn.enqueue_bootstrap_dml_statements_lazy(
        (
            (delete_stmt, cast(SqlParamTuple, (table_name,))),
            (insert_stmt, cast(SqlParamTuple, (table_name, metadata_json, timestamp))),
        ),
        table_name=SqlTableName("versioned_large_columns"),
        mutation_kind=BootstrapMutationKind("large_column_metadata"),
    )
    return LazyResult.of(None)

@pure_lazy

    owner: _SqlSchemaCreationMixin,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    table_config: TableConfig,
) -> bool:
    if table_name == "sys_branches" or table_config.source_versioned_model is not None:
        return True
    if _is_polymorphic_model(model_cls) and not owner._defer_polymorphic_check_reconciliation:
        return True
    get_fts_config = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l5100_fts.fts_config")).get_fts_config
    if get_fts_config(model_cls) is not None:
        return True
    get_large_column_configs = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l1000_schema.large_column")).get_large_column_configs
    return bool(get_large_column_configs(model_cls))

) -> bool:
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import returnable_db_columns

    expected_columns = set(returnable_db_columns(model_cls)) | set(

) -> bool:

@pure_lazy
def _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(
    schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
) -> bool | None:
    snapshot = schema_txn._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
    if snapshot is None:
        return None
    for fact in reversed(cast(Any, snapshot).table_facts):
        if fact.table_name == SqlTableName(table_name):
            return bool(fact.exists)
    return None

        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_ensure_unified_polymorphic_metadata_table`."""
        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning, _schema_static_value_lazy

        if self._schema_ensure_once_lazy(schema_txn, CacheKeyText("table:sys_polymorphic_types")):
            self._ensure_unified_polymorphic_metadata_indexes_lazy(schema_txn, if_not_exists=True)

        if self._system_table_columns_usable(
            schema_txn,

        ):
            self._ensure_unified_polymorphic_metadata_indexes_lazy(schema_txn, if_not_exists=True)
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        effect = schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (SqlCreateUnifiedPolymorphicTypesTable(),),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName("unified_polymorphic_metadata_table"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table"),
        )
        existing_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in schema_txn._polymorphic_metadata_table_dependency_refs)
        dependency_refs = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*existing_refs, *(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in effect.dependencies()))))
        schema_txn._polymorphic_metadata_table_dependency_refs = dependency_refs
        self._ensure_unified_polymorphic_metadata_indexes_lazy(schema_txn, if_not_exists=True)
        schema_txn._record_table_created(SqlTableName("sys_polymorphic_types"))
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(schema_txn, None, dependency_refs=_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(effect))

    @external_io_boundary
    def _ensure_polymorphic_columns_exist_impl[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        _model_cls: type[T],
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> None:
        """Ensure polymorphic discriminator columns match the current schema.

        This handles schema evolution for polymorphic types when the table
        was created by an older version that lacked ``type_name`` or still
        carried the legacy ``type_id`` column.

        The modern schema requires ``type_name`` and no longer persists
        ``type_id`` on application tables. This method adds ``type_name`` if
        missing, removes stale triggers that reference ``type_id``, and drops
        the old ``type_id`` column when present.

        This method is public so it can be called by the sparse versioned backend
        to ensure auxiliary tables (sparse, tip, staged) have the type_name column,
        even though those models themselves are not marked polymorphic.

        Args:
            model_cls: The polymorphic model class (base model, not the auxiliary model)
            table_name: Name of the existing table to update
        """

        dialect = _require_schema_composition_owner_lazy(self).get_dialect()

        # List of columns that should exist on all polymorphic tables
        # type_name was added in schema evolution - add if missing
        polymorphic_columns = [
            ("type_name", "VARCHAR(128)", ColumnConstraintKind.NULL),
        ]

        for col_name, sql_type, constraint_kind in polymorphic_columns:
            use_if_not_exists = dialect.supports_if_not_exists_on_add_column()

            # Backends without IF NOT EXISTS need a manual column_exists check
            if not use_if_not_exists:
                known_exists = schema_txn.projected_or_cached_column_exists(table_name, SqlColumnName(col_name))
                if known_exists is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT:
                    continue  # Column already exists, skip

            col_def = SqlColumnDef(
                SqlColumnName(col_name),
                SqlTypeName(sql_type),
                constraints=(SqlColumnConstraint(constraint_kind),),
            )

            stmt = SqlAlterTable(
                SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name)),
                [
                    SqlAlterAction(
                        AlterActionKind.ADD_COLUMN,
                        column_def=col_def,
                        if_not_exists=use_if_not_exists,
                    ),
                ],
            )

            schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                (stmt,),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"polymorphic_column:{table_name}.{col_name}"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("schema_reconciliation"),
            )
            self._invalidate_column_cache(table_name)

        if (
            schema_txn.projected_table_exists(table_name) is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            and schema_txn.bulk_physical_table_exists(table_name) is SchemaFactPresence.ABSENT
        ):
            return
        column_facts = schema_txn.reconciliation_column_facts(table_name)
        if column_facts is None:
            msg = f"No closed reconciliation column facts are available for {table_name}"
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)
        if "type_id" not in column_facts:
            return

        self._drop_legacy_polymorphic_triggers_lazy(schema_txn, table_name)
        self._drop_legacy_polymorphic_type_id_column_lazy(schema_txn, table_name)

        """Lazy variant of :meth:`ensure_polymorphic_columns_exist`."""

                if known_exists is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT:

            col_def = SqlColumnDef(

                SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name)),

            and schema_txn.bulk_physical_table_exists(table_name) is SchemaFactPresence.ABSENT
        ):
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        column_facts = schema_txn.reconciliation_column_facts(table_name)
        if column_facts is None:
            msg = f"No closed reconciliation column facts are available for {table_name}"
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)
        if "type_id" not in column_facts:
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        self._drop_legacy_polymorphic_triggers_lazy(schema_txn, table_name)
        self._drop_legacy_polymorphic_type_id_column_lazy(schema_txn, table_name)
        return LazyResult.of(None)

    @external_io_boundary
    def _schema_create_table_from_schema_impl[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type[T],
        *,
        if_not_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Create a table/view and its indexes from a Pydantic schema.

        This is the consolidated implementation used by all SQL backends.
        Backend-specific behavior is handled through hook methods:
        - _prepare_table_creation(): Pre-creation setup (e.g., vector extension)
        - _post_table_creation(): Post-creation actions (e.g., permissions)

        For polymorphic types, automatically creates and populates the type metadata table.

        Args:
            model_cls: The Pydantic model class representing the table schema.
            if_not_exists: If True, skip creation if table already exists.

        Raises:
            AttributeError: If the model lacks required SqlTable metadata.
            ProgrammingError: If called inside an explicit user transaction.
        """
        _sb_create = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.schema_builder"))
        generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap = (
            _sb_create.generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap
        )
        generate_type_id_immutability_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap = (
            _sb_create.generate_type_id_immutability_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap
        )
        generate_create_index_grammar = _sb_create.generate_create_index_grammar
        generate_create_table_grammar = _sb_create.generate_create_table_grammar
        generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar = _sb_create.generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar

        # Schema operations must be performed inside schema transactions
        owner = _require_schema_composition_owner_lazy(self)
        owner._check_in_schema_transaction(ConnectionOperationName("CREATE TABLE"))
        if is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
            model_name = model_cls.__name__
            msg = f"Cannot call create_table_from_schema() for versioned model {model_name}. Use create_versioned_table() instead."
            raise TypeError(msg)

        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        dialect = _require_schema_composition_owner_lazy(self).get_dialect()
        is_polymorphic = _is_polymorphic_model(model_cls)
        effective_if_not_exists = if_not_exists or self._is_vector_index_aux_model(model_cls)

        # Hook for backend-specific pre-creation setup
        owner._prepare_table_creation_lazy(model_cls)

        # For polymorphic types, create type metadata table first.
        # This must happen BEFORE the skip check so subclasses get registered.
        if is_polymorphic:
            self.register_polymorphic_metadata_for_schema_update_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)

        shared_table_base = self._shared_table_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls)
        if shared_table_base is not None and effective_if_not_exists:
            base_table_name = get_table_name(shared_table_base)
            base_table_state = schema_txn.projected_or_cached_table_exists(SqlTableName(base_table_name))
            if base_table_state is SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN:
                snapshot_base_exists = _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(
                    schema_txn,
                    SqlTableName(base_table_name),
                )
                base_table_exists = snapshot_base_exists is True
            else:
                base_table_exists = base_table_state is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            if not base_table_exists:
                self._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(schema_txn, shared_table_base, if_not_exists=True)
            _ensure_shared_table_subclass_columns_lazy(
                schema_txn,
                model_cls,
                shared_table_base,
                SqlTableName(table_name),
            )
        elif self._should_skip_polymorphic_subclass(schema_txn, model_cls):
            return

        table_exists = False
        if effective_if_not_exists:
            projected_exists = schema_txn.projected_or_cached_table_exists(SqlTableName(table_name))
            snapshot_exists = _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name))
            table_exists = (
                bool_value(snapshot_exists) or False
                if projected_exists is SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN
                else projected_exists is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            )
            self._record_table_exists_result(SqlTableName(table_name), table_exists)

        projected_table_exists = schema_txn.projected_table_exists
        bulk_physical_table_exists = schema_txn.bulk_physical_table_exists
        planned_new = (
            callable(projected_table_exists)
            and callable(bulk_physical_table_exists)
            and projected_table_exists(SqlTableName(table_name)) is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            and _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name)) is not True
        )
        if effective_if_not_exists and table_exists and planned_new:
            table_exists = False
        if effective_if_not_exists and table_exists and not planned_new:
            backend_before_existing = self._backend_before_existing_table_schema_reconciliation
            backend_after_create = self._backend_after_schema_create_table_from_schema
            if callable(backend_before_existing):
                backend_before_existing(model_cls, table_name)
            reconciliation_succeeded = False
            try:
                # Table exists - reconcile schema: add missing nullable columns and indexes.
                # This handles schema evolution when models gain new fields between versions.
                self._reconcile_existing_table_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, SqlTableName(table_name))
                # For polymorphic types, also ensure type_name column exists
                if is_polymorphic:
                    self.ensure_polymorphic_columns_exist_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, SqlTableName(table_name))
                    discriminator_guard_grammars = generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar(
                        model_cls,
                        allow_type_transition=is_versioned_object_model(model_cls),
                    )
                    if discriminator_guard_grammars:
                        _execute_schema_ddl_sequence_lazy(schema_txn, discriminator_guard_grammars).resolve_lazy()
                if get_table_config(model_cls).view is None:
                    owner._post_existing_table_reconciliation_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, table_name)
                    if not is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
                        self._ensure_large_column_content_table_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)
                self._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)
                self._project_schema_model_columns(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name), model_cls)
                reconciliation_succeeded = True
            finally:
                if callable(backend_after_create):
                    backend_after_create(
                        model_cls,
                        table_name,
                        table_already_exists=True,
                        reconciliation_succeeded=reconciliation_succeeded,
                        schema_txn=schema_txn,
                    )
            return

        # Get FTS nonce if model has FTS V2 fields (for database-computed hashes)
        fts_nonce = owner._get_fts_nonce_for_model(model_cls)

        # Check if JSON Schema CHECK constraints are available for this backend
        json_schema_check_available = owner._is_json_schema_check_available()

        # Generate and execute CREATE TABLE or CREATE VIEW statement
        create_table_stmt = generate_create_table_grammar(
            model_cls,
            dialect,
            fts_nonce=fts_nonce,
            json_schema_check_available=json_schema_check_available,
        )
        if effective_if_not_exists:
            create_table_stmt = self._prefer_create_table_if_not_exists(create_table_stmt)
        schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (create_table_stmt,),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"table_schema:{table_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table"),
        )
        self._reconcile_table_native_compression(model_cls, SqlTableName(table_name))

        # The active schema transaction owns the created-table fact. Connection
        # caches are updated only after that transaction commits.
        schema_txn._record_table_created(SqlTableName(table_name))
        self._project_schema_model_columns(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name), model_cls)

        # Yield to event loop after table creation (for WASM environments)
        _maybe_yield()

        # Only create indexes for tables, not views
        table_config = get_table_config(model_cls)
        is_view = table_config.view is not None

        if not is_view:
            # Generate and execute CREATE INDEX statements using grammar objects
            create_index_grammars = _filter_projected_schema_ddl_artifacts(
                schema_txn,
                generate_create_index_grammar(model_cls, dialect),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table_index"),
            )
            if _defer_create_index_ddl_batch_lazy(schema_txn, create_index_grammars):
                _maybe_yield()
            else:
                _execute_schema_ddl_sequence_lazy(
                    schema_txn, create_index_grammars, phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table_index")
                ).resolve_lazy()
                _maybe_yield()

            # Hook for backend-specific post-creation actions
            owner._post_table_creation_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, table_name)

            # Apply trust-default triggers for models with TrustConfig
            self._apply_trust_triggers(schema_txn, model_cls, table_name)

            # Store constraint metadata for schema drift detection
            self._store_constraint_metadata(schema_txn, model_cls, SqlTableName(table_name))

            # Store graph config metadata for GraphEdge types (Issue #1239)
            owner = _require_schema_composition_owner_lazy(self)
            owner._store_graph_config_metadata_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, table_name)

            # Create large column content store table if needed (for non-versioned tables)
            # Versioned tables handle this in create_versioned_table()
            if not is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
                self._ensure_large_column_content_table_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)

            if is_polymorphic:
                trigger_grammar_list = _filter_projected_schema_ddl_artifacts(
                    schema_txn,
                    generate_type_id_immutability_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap(
                        model_cls,
                        backend_type=dialect.backend_type,
                        cold_create=True,
                    ),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("polymorphic_type_id_trigger"),
                )
                discriminator_guard_grammars = _filter_projected_schema_ddl_artifacts(
                    schema_txn,
                    generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap(
                        model_cls,
                        allow_type_transition=is_versioned_object_model(model_cls),
                        backend_type=dialect.backend_type,
                        cold_create=True,
                    ),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("polymorphic_discriminator_guard"),
                )
                if trigger_grammar_list:
                    _execute_schema_ddl_sequence_lazy(schema_txn, trigger_grammar_list).resolve_lazy()
                    _maybe_yield()  # Yield after trigger creation
                if discriminator_guard_grammars:
                    _execute_schema_ddl_sequence_lazy(schema_txn, discriminator_guard_grammars).resolve_lazy()
                    _maybe_yield()

            # Create versioned FK triggers for unversioned tables
            # (Unversioned -> Versioned integrity via BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE)
            if not is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
                _vfk = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.versioned_fk_triggers"))
                _vfk.create_versioned_fk_triggers(schema_txn, model_cls)

        self._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)
        backend_after_create = self._backend_after_schema_create_table_from_schema
        if callable(backend_after_create):
            backend_after_create(model_cls, table_name, table_already_exists=False, schema_txn=schema_txn)

    def create_tables_from_schema[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_classes: Sequence[type[T]],
        *,
        if_not_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Create many non-versioned schema tables through one schema entry point."""
        models = tuple(model_classes)
        if not models:
            return
        for model_cls in models:
            self._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, if_not_exists=if_not_exists)

    @pure_lazy
    def _schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type[T],
        *,
        if_not_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlSchemaServiceEffectResult]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`create_table_from_schema`.

        Uses async grammar execution for DDL. When ``if_not_exists=True`` and the
        table already exists, runs the same reconciliation as the sync path
        (missing columns, polymorphic CHECK constraints, indexes, polymorphic
        column repair, trigger refresh, vector aux tables). Table metadata for
        reconciliation is read via synchronous :meth:`introspect_table`.
        """
        _sb_create = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.schema_builder"))
        generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap = (
            _sb_create.generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap
        )
        generate_type_id_immutability_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap = (
            _sb_create.generate_type_id_immutability_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap
        )
        generate_create_index_grammar = _sb_create.generate_create_index_grammar
        generate_create_table_grammar = _sb_create.generate_create_table_grammar
        generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar = _sb_create.generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar

        owner = _require_table_creation_planning_owner_lazy(self)
        owner._check_in_schema_transaction(ConnectionOperationName("CREATE TABLE"))
        if is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
            model_name = model_cls.__name__
            msg = (
                f"Cannot call create_table_from_schema_async() for versioned model {model_name}. "
                "Use create_versioned_table_async() instead."
            )
            raise TypeError(msg)

        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        dialect = owner.get_dialect()
        is_polymorphic = _is_polymorphic_model(model_cls)
        effective_if_not_exists = if_not_exists or self._is_vector_index_aux_model(model_cls)

        owner._prepare_table_creation_lazy(model_cls)

        if is_polymorphic:
            self.register_polymorphic_metadata_for_schema_update_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)

        shared_table_base = self._shared_table_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls)
        if shared_table_base is not None and effective_if_not_exists:
            base_table_name = get_table_name(shared_table_base)
            base_state = schema_txn.projected_or_cached_table_exists(SqlTableName(base_table_name))
            if base_state is SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN:
                snapshot_base_exists = _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(
                    schema_txn,
                    SqlTableName(base_table_name),
                )
                base_exists = snapshot_base_exists is True
            else:
                base_exists = base_state is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            if not base_exists:
                self._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(schema_txn, shared_table_base, if_not_exists=True)
            _ensure_shared_table_subclass_columns_lazy(
                schema_txn,
                model_cls,
                shared_table_base,
                SqlTableName(table_name),
            )
        elif self._should_skip_polymorphic_subclass(schema_txn, model_cls):
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        deferred_state = schema_txn._deferred_table_creation_state
        table_creation_seen = schema_txn._schema_table_creation_seen
        deferred_state.schema_table_creation_seen = table_creation_seen
        table_creation_key = str(table_name)
        if effective_if_not_exists and table_creation_key in table_creation_seen:
            table_creation_is_proven = _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name)) is True
            if table_creation_is_proven:
                return LazyResult.of(None)
        else:
            table_creation_seen.add(table_creation_key)

        table_exists = False
        if effective_if_not_exists:
            projected_exists = schema_txn.projected_or_cached_table_exists(SqlTableName(table_name))
            snapshot_exists = _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name))
            table_exists = (
                bool_value(snapshot_exists) or False
                if projected_exists is SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN
                else projected_exists is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            )
            self._record_table_exists_result(SqlTableName(table_name), table_exists)

        bootstrap_run_active = int(self._bootstrap_coordinator_run_depth) > 0 or in_bootstrap_plan_active_context()
        if (
            effective_if_not_exists
            and table_exists
            and schema_txn.projected_table_exists(SqlTableName(table_name)) is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            and _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name)) is not True
        ):
            table_exists = False
        if (
            effective_if_not_exists
            and table_exists
            and schema_txn._schema_reconciliation_snapshot is None
            and schema_txn.projected_table_exists(SqlTableName(table_name)) is not SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        ):
            table_exists = False
        if effective_if_not_exists and table_exists:
            if str(table_name) == "sys_polymorphic_types" and bootstrap_run_active:
                return LazyResult.of(None)
            projected_table_exists = schema_txn.projected_table_exists
            bulk_physical_table_exists = schema_txn.bulk_physical_table_exists
            created_in_this_schema_batch = schema_batch_created_table(
                schema_txn._known_table_exists_after_commit,
                schema_txn._last_bulk_table_names_snapshot,
                SqlTableName(table_name),
            )
            planned_new = created_in_this_schema_batch or (
                schema_txn.projected_table_exists(SqlTableName(table_name)) is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
                and _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name)) is not True
            )
            backend_before_existing = self._backend_before_existing_table_schema_reconciliation
            backend_after_create = self._backend_after_schema_create_table_from_schema
            if callable(backend_before_existing):
                backend_before_existing(model_cls, table_name)
            reconciliation_succeeded = False
            try:
                if not planned_new:
                    self._reconcile_existing_table_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, SqlTableName(table_name))
                if is_polymorphic:
                    self.ensure_polymorphic_columns_exist_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, SqlTableName(table_name))
                    discriminator_guard_grammars = generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar(
                        model_cls,
                        allow_type_transition=is_versioned_object_model(model_cls),
                    )
                    if discriminator_guard_grammars:
                        _execute_schema_ddl_sequence_lazy(schema_txn, discriminator_guard_grammars)
                if not planned_new and get_table_config(model_cls).view is None:
                    owner._post_existing_table_reconciliation_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, table_name)
                    if not is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
                        self._ensure_large_column_content_table_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)
                self._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)
                self._project_schema_model_columns(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name), model_cls)
                reconciliation_succeeded = True
            finally:
                if callable(backend_after_create):
                    backend_after_create(
                        model_cls,
                        table_name,
                        table_already_exists=True,
                        reconciliation_succeeded=reconciliation_succeeded,
                        schema_txn=schema_txn,
                    )
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        fts_nonce = owner._get_fts_nonce_for_model(model_cls)
        json_schema_check_available = owner._is_json_schema_check_available()
        create_table_stmt = generate_create_table_grammar(
            model_cls,
            dialect,
            fts_nonce=fts_nonce,
            json_schema_check_available=json_schema_check_available,
        )
        if effective_if_not_exists:
            create_table_stmt = self._prefer_create_table_if_not_exists(create_table_stmt)
        schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (create_table_stmt,),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"table_schema:{table_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table"),
        )
        if bootstrap_run_active or in_lazy_context():
            schema_txn._record_table_created(SqlTableName(table_name))
        else:
            self._mark_table_created(table_name)
        self._project_schema_model_columns(schema_txn, SqlTableName(table_name), model_cls)
        _maybe_yield()

        table_config = get_table_config(model_cls)
        is_view = table_config.view is not None
        if is_view:
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        create_index_grammars = _filter_projected_schema_ddl_artifacts(
            schema_txn,
            generate_create_index_grammar(model_cls, dialect),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table_index"),
        )
        if _defer_create_index_ddl_batch_lazy(schema_txn, create_index_grammars):
            _maybe_yield()
        else:
            _execute_schema_ddl_sequence_lazy(schema_txn, create_index_grammars, phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table_index"))
            _maybe_yield()

        owner._post_table_creation_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, table_name)
        self._apply_trust_triggers(schema_txn, model_cls, table_name)
        self._store_constraint_metadata(schema_txn, model_cls, SqlTableName(table_name))
        owner._store_graph_config_metadata_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls, SqlTableName(table_name))

        if not is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
            self._ensure_large_column_content_table_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)

        if is_polymorphic:
            trigger_grammar_list = _filter_projected_schema_ddl_artifacts(
                schema_txn,
                generate_type_id_immutability_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap(
                    model_cls,
                    backend_type=dialect.backend_type,
                    cold_create=True,
                ),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("polymorphic_type_id_trigger"),
            )
            discriminator_guard_grammars = _filter_projected_schema_ddl_artifacts(
                schema_txn,
                generate_polymorphic_discriminator_guard_trigger_grammar_for_bootstrap(
                    model_cls,
                    allow_type_transition=is_versioned_object_model(model_cls),
                    backend_type=dialect.backend_type,
                    cold_create=True,
                ),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("polymorphic_discriminator_guard"),
            )
            if trigger_grammar_list:
                _execute_schema_ddl_sequence_lazy(schema_txn, trigger_grammar_list)
                _maybe_yield()
            if discriminator_guard_grammars:
                _execute_schema_ddl_sequence_lazy(schema_txn, discriminator_guard_grammars)
                _maybe_yield()

        if not is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
            _vfk = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.versioned_fk_triggers"))
            _vfk.create_versioned_fk_triggers_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)

        self._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)
        backend_after_create = self._backend_after_schema_create_table_from_schema
        if callable(backend_after_create):
            backend_after_create(model_cls, table_name, table_already_exists=False, schema_txn=schema_txn)
        return LazyResult.of(None)

    def _schema_create_versioned_table_impl(
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type,
        *,
        enable_logging: bool = True,
        if_not_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Create a versioned table with automatic LoggedTable setup if needed.

        This is the consolidated implementation used by all SQL backends.
        Backend-specific behavior is handled through hook methods:
        - _create_versioned_table_indexes(): For backend-specific indexes
        - _get_logged_table_class(): Returns backend's LoggedTable class
        - _post_versioned_table_creation(): For backend-specific post-creation

        On backends with PARTIAL_MATERIALIZATION capability, this automatically
        sets up LoggedTable triggers to enable history replay after cleanup.

        Args:
            model_cls: VersionedObjectRow subclass representing the versioned table
            enable_logging: Whether to enable LoggedTable (default True).

        Raises:
            AttributeError: If the model lacks required SqlTable metadata.
            TypeError: If model_cls is not a VersionedObjectRow subclass.
        """

        # Schema operations must be performed inside schema transactions
        owner = _require_schema_composition_owner_lazy(self)
        owner._check_in_schema_transaction(ConnectionOperationName("CREATE VERSIONED TABLE"))

        # Validate model_cls
        if not is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
            msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} must extend VersionedObjectRow"
            raise TypeError(msg)

        # For polymorphic types, ensure type metadata table exists first
        # This must happen BEFORE the early return check, so subclasses get registered
        is_polymorphic = _is_polymorphic_model(model_cls)
        if is_polymorphic:
            self.register_polymorphic_metadata_for_schema_update_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)

        # For polymorphic hierarchies with single-table inheritance:
        # Only create the table for the FIRST class in the hierarchy with SqlTable
        if self._should_skip_versioned_polymorphic_subclass(model_cls):
            self._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(schema_txn, model_cls)
            return

        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        current_schema_txn = schema_txn
        from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_table_info import VersionedBaseTableName, derive_versioned_table_names

        sparse_table_name = derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(table_name))).sparse
        sparse_exists = False
        if if_not_exists:
            projected_sparse_exists = current_schema_txn.projected_or_cached_table_exists(SqlTableName(sparse_table_name))
            projected_sparse_value = (
                None if projected_sparse_exists is SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN else projected_sparse_exists is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            )
            sparse_exists = (
                projected_sparse_value
                if projected_sparse_value is not None
                else bool_value(
                    _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_table_exists(
                        current_schema_txn,
                        SqlTableName(sparse_table_name),
                    )
                )
                or False
            )
        if if_not_exists and sparse_exists:
            self._reconcile_existing_versioned_auxiliary_tables_lazy(
                current_schema_txn,
                model_cls,
                enable_logging=enable_logging,
            )
            _vfk = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.versioned_fk_triggers"))
            _vfk.create_versioned_fk_triggers_lazy(current_schema_txn, model_cls)
            self._persist_large_column_metadata_lazy(current_schema_txn, model_cls)
            self._ensure_large_column_content_table_lazy(current_schema_txn, model_cls)
            return
        disabled_logging_tables = ensure_string_set(self, DynamicFieldName("_versioned_tables_with_logging_disabled"))
        if not enable_logging:
            disabled_logging_tables.add(table_name)
        effective_enable_logging = enable_logging and table_name not in disabled_logging_tables

        # Versioned models need the same backend-specific preflight as unversioned tables.
        owner._prepare_table_creation_lazy(model_cls)

        # NOTE: Sparse backend (the only backend) no longer creates the base table.
        # All versioned data is stored in auxiliary tables (_sparse, _tip, _staged).
        # The base table schema (sys_id, revision_id, etc.) is not needed.
        # See issue #949 for rationale.

        # Hook for any additional backend-specific post-creation actions
        self._post_versioned_table_creation(model_cls)

        # Persist large column metadata for spillover-aware storage
        self._persist_large_column_metadata_lazy(current_schema_txn, model_cls)

        # All versioned tables use sparse storage - create auxiliary tables (_sparse, _tip, _staged)
        _vreg_cv = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.registry"))
        versioned_backend_registry = _vreg_cv.versioned_backend_registry

        backend: GenericSparseVersionedBackend[Any] = versioned_backend_registry.get(
            "sparse",
            current_schema_txn,
        )
        backend.ensure_auxiliary_tables_lazy(
            model_cls,
            current_schema_txn,
            enable_logging=effective_enable_logging,
        )
        owner = _require_schema_composition_owner_lazy(self)
        owner._store_graph_config_metadata_lazy(current_schema_txn, model_cls, SqlTableName(table_name))
        # Create large-column stores after auxiliary-family renames so the old
        # store can move before a new empty store is materialized.
        self._ensure_large_column_content_table_lazy(current_schema_txn, model_cls)
        # Create or evolve audit-log tables after auxiliary-family renames so
        # ``renamed_from`` can move existing log/delta tables before the new
        # names are materialized.
        logged_table_cls = owner._get_logged_table_class()
        if effective_enable_logging and logged_table_cls is not None:
            logged_table = logged_table_cls(owner, model_cls)
            logged_table._create_log_table(current_schema_txn)
            table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
            from l1000_schema.table_utils import logged_table_name

            self._record_table_exists_result(logged_table_name(table_name), True)
            self._record_table_exists_result(
                SqlTableName(get_table_name(logged_table.field_delta_model())),
                True,
            )
            # NOTE: _create_triggers() is NOT called here because:
            # 1. The base table no longer exists (sparse backend only)
            # 2. Triggers are created on _staged table by sparse backend
        self._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(current_schema_txn, model_cls)

        # Retroactively create UV->V FK triggers for unversioned tables
        # that were created before this versioned table's tip existed
        _vfk_retro = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.versioned_fk_triggers"))
        _vfk_retro.create_retroactive_versioned_fk_triggers(current_schema_txn, model_cls)

        *,

        known_absent_tables = schema_txn._known_absent_tables_for_schema_batch

                schema_txn,

            return LazyResult.of(None)

        for model_cls in tuple(model_classes):
            model_name = model_cls.__name__
            with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(
                "create_versioned_tables_async.model",

        from vector_types import has_vector_indexes

        if not has_vector_indexes(model_cls):
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        _hnsw_aux = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models"))
        create_hnsw_node_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_node_class
        create_hnsw_edge_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_edge_class
        create_hnsw_metadata_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_metadata_class
        create_hnsw_content_node_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_content_node_class
        create_hnsw_content_edge_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_content_edge_class
        _vcfg = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l5200_vector_index.vector_config"))
        get_vector_indexes = _vcfg.get_vector_indexes

        vector_indexes = get_vector_indexes(model_cls)
        from importlib.util import find_spec

        if (
            _require_schema_composition_owner_lazy(self).get_dialect().backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE
            and find_spec("sqlite_vec") is not None
        ):
            from l5200_vector_index.content_addressable_models import EmbeddingVector
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.sql_table_hnsw.sql_table_hnsw import SqlEnsureSqlTableHnswEmbeddingHelpers

            self._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(schema_txn, EmbeddingVector, if_not_exists=True)
            schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                (SqlEnsureSqlTableHnswEmbeddingHelpers(),),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("vector_backend:normalized_scoring_projection"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
            )
        if not any(config.resolved_index_policy.approximate_index for config in vector_indexes.values()):
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        for aux_model in (
            create_hnsw_node_class(table_name),
            create_hnsw_edge_class(table_name),
            create_hnsw_content_node_class(table_name),
            create_hnsw_content_edge_class(table_name),
            create_hnsw_metadata_class(table_name),
        ):
            self._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(schema_txn, aux_model, if_not_exists=True)
        return LazyResult.of(None)
