def sql_table_exists_many_compiled_step(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    known_results: Mapping[SqlTableName, bool],
    unknown_names: Sequence[SqlTableName],
) -> CompiledStep[dict[str, bool]]:
    _require_parallel_sources(source_refs, unknown_names)
    items: list[tuple[Any, str]] = []
    result_columns: list[str] = []
    auxiliary_ctes: list[list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None] = []
    for index, source_ref in enumerate(source_refs):
        expr, source_auxiliary_ctes = _require_single_column_scalar_subquery(source_ref, ctx=ctx)
        column = f"exists_{index}"
        items.append((expr, column))
        result_columns.append(column)
        auxiliary_ctes.append(source_auxiliary_ctes)
    __opa002_grammar_250 = SqlSelectExpressions(items)
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column, role="table_exists_many") for column in result_columns))
    column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset(result_columns))
    return CompiledStep(
        output_shape=output_shape,
        grammar=__opa002_grammar_250,
        needs_returning=True,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        auxiliary_ctes=_merge_auxiliary_ctes(*auxiliary_ctes),
        closed_post_op=table_exists_many_post_op(
            known_results=known_results,
            unknown_names=unknown_names,
            result_columns=result_columns,
        ),
    )


def sql_first_scalar_item_compiled_step(
    source_ref: str,
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    result_ref_id: str,
    scalar_coercion: ScalarCoercionKind = ScalarCoercionKind.NONE,
) -> CompiledStep[object | None]:
    source_cte = _require_single_column_cte(
        ctx,
        source_ref,
        operation_name=ConnectionOperationName("First-item scalar reduction"),
        runtime_fallback_name="runtime-ref first-item reduction",
    )
    source_column = source_cte.columns[0]
    if scalar_coercion is ScalarCoercionKind.NONE and source_column == "user_id":
        scalar_coercion = ScalarCoercionKind.USER_ID
    stmt = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
        SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id),
        columns=[SqlColumnName(source_column)],
        limit=1,
    )
    auxiliary_ctes = [(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else None
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape((synthetic_output_field(source_column),))
    column_type_hints = (
        source_cte.column_type_hints.rename_column(source_column, source_column) if source_cte.column_type_hints is not None else None
    )
    result_relation = DeclaredResultRelation(
        (
            DeclaredResultColumn(
                output_name=source_column,
                output_column=source_column,
                kind="scalar_ref",
                scalar_ref_id=result_ref_id,
                terminal_output_name=source_column,
            ),
        ),
        terminal_materialization_shape=(source_column,),
    )
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=stmt,
        needs_returning=True,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=result_relation,
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(source_column, scalar_coercion=scalar_coercion),
    )


def _validated_relation_ctes(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    operation_name: ConnectionOperationName,
    runtime_fallback_name: str,
) -> tuple[list[Any], tuple[str, ...]]:
    def _source_cte(source_ref: str) -> CteReference | None:
        for candidate_ref in (source_ref, f"{source_ref}.raw"):
            candidate = ctx.cte_refs.get(candidate_ref)
            if isinstance(candidate, CteReference):
                return candidate
        return None

    if not source_refs:
        msg = f"{operation_name} requires at least one SQL-visible source relation."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    cte_refs: list[CteReference] = []
    for source_ref in source_refs:
        source_cte = _source_cte(source_ref)
        if source_cte is None:
            msg = (
                f"{operation_name} requires SQL-visible ServerPlan relations for "
                f"all sources; {source_ref!r} is not a CTE and {runtime_fallback_name} "
                "is not an allowed fallback."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        if not source_cte.columns:
            msg = f"{operation_name} requires {source_ref!r} to declare CTE columns."
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        cte_refs.append(source_cte)
    columns = cte_refs[0].columns
    assert columns is not None
    for source_ref, source_cte in zip(source_refs[1:], cte_refs[1:], strict=True):
        if source_cte.columns is None or set(source_cte.columns) != set(columns):
            msg = (
                f"{operation_name} requires identical CTE columns; {source_ref!r} declares {source_cte.columns!r}, expected {columns!r}."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return cte_refs, columns


def sql_flatten_relations_compiled_step(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    result_ref_id: str,
) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
    del result_ref_id

    cte_refs, columns = _validated_relation_ctes(
        source_refs,
        ctx=ctx,
        operation_name=ConnectionOperationName("Flatten relation reduction"),
        runtime_fallback_name="runtime flattening",
    )
    selects = [
        SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
            SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id),
            columns=[SqlColumnName(column) for column in columns],
        )
        for source_cte in cte_refs
    ]
    auxiliary_ctes = _merge_auxiliary_ctes(
        *(
            [(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else None
            for source_cte in cte_refs
        ),
    )
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in columns))
    column_type_hints = cte_refs[0].column_type_hints.filtered(set(columns)).require_complete(columns)
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=selects[0] if len(selects) == 1 else SqlSetOp(SetOpKind.UNION_ALL, selects),
        needs_returning=True,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
    )


def sql_collect_relations_compiled_step(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    result_ref_id: str,
    drop_none: bool = False,
) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
    del result_ref_id

    class _SqlOrderedCollectUnion(SqlRenderable):
        __slots__ = ("_columns", "_drop_none", "_source_cte_names")

        def __init__(
            self,
            source_cte_names: Sequence[SqlTableName],
            columns: Sequence[SqlColumnName],
            *,
            drop_none: bool,
        ) -> None:
            self._source_cte_names = tuple(source_cte_names)
            self._columns = tuple(columns)
            self._drop_none = drop_none

        def render(self, dialect: Any) -> SqlFragment:
            ordinal_name = SqlQuotedIdentifier("__collect_ordinal").render(dialect)
            collect_alias = SqlQuotedIdentifier("__collect").render(dialect)
            public_cols = SQL_EMPTY
            for index, column in enumerate(self._columns):
                if index > 0:
                    public_cols = public_cols + _SQL_COMMA_SPACE
                public_cols = public_cols + SqlQuotedIdentifier(column).render(dialect)
            body = SQL_EMPTY
            for index, source_cte_name in enumerate(self._source_cte_names):
                if index > 0:
                    body = body + _SQL_UNION_ALL_SPACE
                body = body + _SQL_SELECT_SPACE + SqlIntegerLiteral(index).render(dialect) + _SQL_AS_SPACE + ordinal_name
                for column in self._columns:
                    body = body + _SQL_COMMA_SPACE + SqlQuotedIdentifier(column).render(dialect)
                body = body + _SQL_FROM_SPACE + SqlQuotedIdentifier(source_cte_name).render(dialect)
                if self._drop_none and len(self._columns) == 1:
                    body = body + _SQL_WHERE_SPACE + SqlQuotedIdentifier(self._columns[0]).render(dialect) + _SQL_IS_NOT_NULL
            return (
                _SQL_SELECT_SPACE
                + public_cols
                + _SQL_COLLECT_FROM_OPEN
                + body
                + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN_AS
                + collect_alias
                + _SQL_ORDER_BY_SPACE
                + ordinal_name
            )

    cte_refs, columns = _validated_relation_ctes(
        source_refs,
        ctx=ctx,
        operation_name=ConnectionOperationName("Collect relation reduction"),
        runtime_fallback_name="runtime collection",
    )
    auxiliary_ctes = _merge_auxiliary_ctes(
        *(
            [(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else None
            for source_cte in cte_refs
        ),
    )
    source_cte_names = tuple(SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id) for source_cte in cte_refs)
    column_names = tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in columns)
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in columns))
    column_type_hints = cte_refs[0].column_type_hints.filtered(set(columns)).require_complete(columns)
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=_SqlOrderedCollectUnion(source_cte_names, column_names, drop_none=drop_none),
        needs_returning=True,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
    )


def sql_flatten_scalar_relations_compiled_step(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    result_ref_id: str,
    scalar_coercion: ScalarCoercionKind = ScalarCoercionKind.NONE,
) -> CompiledStep[list[object]]:
    compiled = sql_flatten_relations_compiled_step(
        source_refs,
        ctx=ctx,
        result_ref_id=result_ref_id,
    )
    assert compiled.output_shape is not None
    columns = compiled.output_shape.cte_output_columns
    output_column = _require_single_output_column(
        columns,
        operation_name=ConnectionOperationName("Flatten scalar relation reduction"),
    )
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=compiled.grammar,
        needs_returning=True,
        auxiliary_ctes=compiled.auxiliary_ctes,
        output_shape=compiled.output_shape,
        result_relation=compiled.result_relation,
        column_type_hints=compiled.column_type_hints,
        closed_post_op=scalar_column_list_post_op(
            output_column,
            scalar_coercion=scalar_coercion,
        ),
    )


def _require_single_column_scalar_subquery(
    source_ref: str,
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None]:
    source_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(source_ref)
    source_cte = ctx.scalar_projection_bindings.get(source_ref_id)
    if source_cte is None:
        source_cte = resolve_auxiliary_cte_binding(ctx, source_ref_id)
    if not isinstance(source_cte, CteReference):
        msg = (
            "Scalar reduction requires a SQL-visible ServerPlan relation for "
            f"{source_ref!r}; runtime-ref reduction is not an allowed fallback."
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    scalar_column = source_cte.scalar_value_column
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.requires_statement_local_merge_cte_ownership and source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None:
        if scalar_column is not None:
            column_name = scalar_column.to_row_key()
        elif source_cte.columns is not None and len(source_cte.columns) == 1:
            column_name = source_cte.columns[0]
        else:
            msg = f"Scalar reduction requires {source_ref!r} to declare a scalar value column."
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        source_alias = SqlAliasName("runtime_scalar_source")
        return (
            SqlScalarSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList(
                        (SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name), source_alias),),
                    ),
                    from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(
                        source_cte.auxiliary_query,
                        SqlTableName(str(source_alias)),
                    ),
                    limit=1,
                ),
            ),
            None,
        )
    if scalar_column is not None:
        column_name = scalar_column.to_row_key()
    elif source_cte.columns is not None and len(source_cte.columns) == 1:
        column_name = source_cte.columns[0]
    else:
        msg = f"Scalar reduction requires {source_ref!r} to declare a scalar value column."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    stmt = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
        SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id),
        columns=[SqlColumnName(column_name)],
        limit=1,
    )
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None = (
        [(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else None
    )
    return SqlScalarSubquery(stmt), auxiliary_ctes


def _declared_scalar_subquery(
    source_ref: str,
    value_column: SqlColumnName,
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None]:
    source_cte = resolve_auxiliary_cte_binding(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(source_ref))
    if not isinstance(source_cte, CteReference):
        msg = f"Scalar reduction requires a SQL-visible ServerPlan relation for {source_ref!r}."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if value_column not in source_cte.columns:
        msg = (
            f"Scalar reduction source {source_ref!r} does not publish its declared "
            f"value column {value_column!r}; columns are {source_cte.columns!r}."
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    stmt = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
        SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id),
        columns=[SqlColumnName(value_column)],
        limit=1,
    )
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None = (
        [(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else None
    )
    return SqlScalarSubquery(stmt), auxiliary_ctes


def _row_count_scalar_subquery(
    source_ref: str,
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None]:
    source_cte = resolve_auxiliary_cte_binding(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(source_ref))
    if not isinstance(source_cte, CteReference):
        msg = (
            "Row-count reduction requires a SQL-visible ServerPlan relation for "
            f"{source_ref!r}; runtime-ref reduction is not an allowed fallback."
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.requires_statement_local_merge_cte_ownership and source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None:
        return (
            SqlScalarSubquery(
                SqlSelectCountFromSubquery(source_cte.auxiliary_query),
            ),
            None,
        )
    count_stmt = SqlSelectCountFromSubquery(
        SqlDynamicSelectStmt(SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id)),
    )
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None = (
        [(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else None
    )
    return SqlScalarSubquery(count_stmt), auxiliary_ctes


def _scalar_reduction_compiled_step(
    expr: SqlRenderable,
    *,
    result_ref_id: str,
    column_type_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
    result_column: str = "__result",
    scalar_coercion: ScalarCoercionKind = ScalarCoercionKind.NONE,
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None = None,
) -> CompiledStep[object]:
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape((synthetic_output_field(result_column),))
    result_relation = DeclaredResultRelation(
        (
            DeclaredResultColumn(
                output_name=result_column,
                output_column=result_column,
                kind="scalar_ref",
                scalar_ref_id=result_ref_id,
                terminal_output_name=result_column,
            ),
        ),
        terminal_materialization_shape=(result_column,),
    )
    if scalar_coercion is ScalarCoercionKind.INT:
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({result_column}))
    elif scalar_coercion is ScalarCoercionKind.BOOL:
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({result_column}))
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=SqlSelectExpr(
            expr,
            SqlAliasName(result_column),
        ),
        needs_returning=True,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=result_relation,
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints.require_complete((result_column,)),
        closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
            result_column,
            scalar_coercion=scalar_coercion,
        ),
    )


def _merge_auxiliary_ctes(
    *items: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None:
    merged: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for item in items:
        if item is None:
            continue
        for name, query in item:
            if name in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(name)
            merged.append((name, query))
    return merged or None


def _renamed_single_column_hints(
    source_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
    *,
    source_column: str,
    output_column: str,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    return SqlColumnTypeHints(
        jsonb_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.jsonb_columns else frozenset(),
        uuid_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.uuid_columns else frozenset(),
        timestamptz_columns=(frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.timestamptz_columns else frozenset()),
        date_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.date_columns else frozenset(),
        time_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.time_columns else frozenset(),
        numeric_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.numeric_columns else frozenset(),
        bool_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.bool_columns else frozenset(),
        integer_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.integer_columns else frozenset(),
        bigint_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.bigint_columns else frozenset(),
        double_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.double_columns else frozenset(),
        text_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.text_columns else frozenset(),
        bytea_columns=frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.bytea_columns else frozenset(),
        postgres_bit_columns=(
            frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.postgres_bit_columns else frozenset()
        ),
        postgres_vector_columns=(
            frozenset({output_column}) if source_column in source_hints.postgres_vector_columns else frozenset()
        ),
    ).require_complete((output_column,))


def _single_column_result_hints(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_ref: str,
    *,
    output_column: str,
    operation_name: ConnectionOperationName,
    runtime_fallback_name: str,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    source_cte = _require_single_column_cte(
        ctx,
        source_ref,
        operation_name=operation_name,
        runtime_fallback_name=runtime_fallback_name,
    )
    if source_cte.column_type_hints is None:
        msg = f"{operation_name} source {source_ref!r} is missing SQL column type hints."
        raise TypeError(msg)
    source_column = str(source_cte.columns[0])
    return _renamed_single_column_hints(
        source_cte.column_type_hints,
        source_column=source_column,
        output_column=output_column,
    )


def _single_column_scalar_subqueries(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> tuple[list[SqlRenderable], list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None]:
    exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    aux_items: list[list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None] = []
    for source_ref in source_refs:
        expr, auxiliary_ctes = _require_single_column_scalar_subquery(source_ref, ctx=ctx)
        exprs.append(expr)
        aux_items.append(auxiliary_ctes)
    return exprs, _merge_auxiliary_ctes(*aux_items)


def _coalesce_int_zero(expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    return SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", [expr, SqlIntegerLiteral(0)])


def _add_expression(left: SqlRenderable, right: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    return SqlBinaryOp(left, BinaryOp.ADD, right)


def _subtract_expression(left: SqlRenderable, right: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    return SqlBinaryOp(left, BinaryOp.SUB, right)


def _truthy_count_expr(expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    return SqlCase(
        [(expr, SqlIntegerLiteral(1))],
        else_=SqlIntegerLiteral(0),
    )


def _sum_exprs(exprs: Sequence[SqlRenderable]) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not exprs:
        return SqlIntegerLiteral(0)
    current = exprs[0]
    for expr in exprs[1:]:
        current = _add_expression(current, expr)
    return current


def sql_sum_ints_compiled_step(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    result_ref_id: str,
) -> CompiledStep[int]:
    exprs, auxiliary_ctes = _single_column_scalar_subqueries(source_refs, ctx=ctx)
    summed_expr = _sum_exprs([_coalesce_int_zero(expr) for expr in exprs])
    return cast(
        "CompiledStep[int]",
        _scalar_reduction_compiled_step(
            summed_expr,
            result_ref_id=result_ref_id,
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({"__result"})),
            scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.INT,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        ),
    )


def sql_add_subtract_ints_compiled_step(
    add_source_refs: Sequence[str],
    subtract_source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    result_ref_id: str,
) -> CompiledStep[int]:
    add_exprs, add_auxiliary_ctes = _single_column_scalar_subqueries(add_source_refs, ctx=ctx)
    subtract_exprs, subtract_auxiliary_ctes = _single_column_scalar_subqueries(subtract_source_refs, ctx=ctx)
    result_expr = _sum_exprs([_coalesce_int_zero(expr) for expr in add_exprs])
    for expr in subtract_exprs:
        result_expr = _subtract_expression(result_expr, _coalesce_int_zero(expr))
    return cast(
        "CompiledStep[int]",
        _scalar_reduction_compiled_step(
            result_expr,
            result_ref_id=result_ref_id,
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({"__result"})),
            scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.INT,
            auxiliary_ctes=_merge_auxiliary_ctes(add_auxiliary_ctes, subtract_auxiliary_ctes),
        ),
    )

def sql_require_affected_count_compiled_step(
    source_ref: str,
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    expectation: str,
    error_message: str,
    error_cls: type[Exception] = ValueError,
    immediate_count_function: SqlFunctionName | None = None,
    source_is_count_value: bool = False,
    count_value_column: LockedColumnName | None = None,
) -> CompiledStep[None]:
    if immediate_count_function is not None:
        expr: SqlRenderable = SqlFuncCall(immediate_count_function, [])
        auxiliary_ctes = None
    elif source_is_count_value:
        if count_value_column is None:
            msg = "Affected-count scalar sources require an explicit count_value_column."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        expr, auxiliary_ctes = _declared_scalar_subquery(
            source_ref,
            count_value_column.to_sql_column_name(),
            ctx=ctx,
        )
    else:
        expr, auxiliary_ctes = _row_count_scalar_subquery(source_ref, ctx=ctx)
    count_expr = _coalesce_int_zero(expr)
    if expectation == "one":
        ok_expr = SqlBinaryOp(cast("Any", count_expr), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlIntegerLiteral(1))
    elif expectation in {"at_least_one", "true"}:
        ok_expr = SqlBinaryOp(cast("Any", count_expr), BinaryOp.GE, SqlIntegerLiteral(1))
    elif expectation == "zero_or_one":
        ok_expr = SqlBinaryOp(cast("Any", count_expr), BinaryOp.LE, SqlIntegerLiteral(1))
    else:
        msg = f"Unsupported affected-count expectation: {expectation!r}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
        tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in ("ok", "error_code", "message")),
    )
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=SqlSelectExpressions(
            [
                (ok_expr, "ok"),
                (SqlParam(AssertionResultCode.ERROR.value), "error_code"),
                (SqlParam(error_message), "message"),
            ],
            bool_columns=frozenset({"ok"}),
            text_columns=frozenset({"error_code", "message"}),
        ),
        needs_returning=True,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
            bool_columns=frozenset({"ok"}),
            text_columns=frozenset({"error_code", "message"}),
        ),
        closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(error_message, exc_type=error_cls),
    )

def _session_id_for_permission_sql(ctx: CompilationContext) -> SessionId | SqlRenderable | None:
    if ctx.session_id is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(ctx.session_id, SessionId):
        return ctx.session_id

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import session_id_expr

    return session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx)


def _object_write_denial_message(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> str:
    scheme = get_permission_scheme(model_cls)
    if scheme is not None:
        session_id = ctx.session_id if isinstance(ctx.session_id, SessionId) else None
        decision = scheme.get_table_write_permission_decision(model_cls, session_id)
        if not decision.allowed:
            return decision.denial_message
    return f"{model_cls.__name__} object write denied by SQL permission gate"


def _compile_permission_where(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    table_alias: str,
    action: str = "write",
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if ctx.system_authority is not None:
        return None
    session_id = _session_id_for_permission_sql(ctx)
    if session_id is None:
        return cast("SqlRenderable | None", compile_permission_deny_all())
    raw_session_id = ctx.session_id
    if not isinstance(raw_session_id, SessionId):
        permission_session_id = SessionId.unresolved()
    else:
        permission_session_id = raw_session_id
    if isinstance(session_id, SqlRenderable):
        session_id_sql = session_id
    else:
        session_id_sql = SqlParam(session_id.unwrap_to_sql())
    session_vars: Mapping[str | tuple[type, str], SqlRenderable] | None = None
    if permission_context_type is not None:
        if permission_context_ref is None:
            msg = "Typed object permission context requires its symbolic ref"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        context_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(permission_context_ref) if ctx.cte_refs is not None else None
        if not isinstance(context_cte, CteReference):
            msg = "Object permission compilation requires a SQL-visible context relation"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
            _sql_session_context_bindings,
        )

        session_vars = _sql_session_context_bindings(
            permission_context_type,
            ServerPlanRefId(context_cte.ref_id),
        )
    permission_user_id_sql, permission_session_id_sql = admitted_identity_sql_bindings(
        session_vars,
        default_user_id_sql=SqlSessionUserIdSubquery(session_id),
        default_session_id_sql=session_id_sql,
    )
    permission_filter: SqlRenderable | None = compile_permission_where_with_user_expr(
        model_cls,
        permission_session_id,
        permission_user_id_sql,
        table_alias=table_alias,
        action=action,
        domain=ctx.versioning_domain,
        session_id_sql=permission_session_id_sql,
        session_vars=session_vars,
        compilation_context=ctx,
    )
    return permission_filter


def _permission_context_auxiliary_ctes(
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]]:
    """Publish a split typed-context relation into the consuming statement."""
    if permission_context_ref is None:
        return []
    context_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(permission_context_ref) if ctx.cte_refs is not None else None
    if not isinstance(context_cte, CteReference):
        msg = "Object permission compilation requires a SQL-visible context relation"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if context_cte.auxiliary_query is None:
        return []
    return [(context_cte.ref_id, context_cte.auxiliary_query)]

    result_relation = DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape)

def runtime_object_write_permission_passthrough_assertion_compiled_step(
    source_ref: str,
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | str | None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    action: str = "write",
) -> CompiledStep[None]:
    context_ref = ServerPlanRefId(permission_context_ref) if isinstance(permission_context_ref, str) else permission_context_ref
    source_cte = _require_cte_ref(
        ctx,
        source_ref,
        operation_name=ConnectionOperationName("Object write permission assertion"),
        runtime_fallback_name="runtime-ref permission projection",
        require_columns=True,
    )
    where = _compile_permission_where(
        model_cls,
        ctx,
        table_alias="src",
        action=action,
        permission_context_ref=context_ref,
        permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
    )
    source_query = SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
        source_cte_name=source_cte.ref_id,
        source_columns=tuple(str(column) for column in source_cte.columns),
        overrides={},
        where_conditions=() if where is None else (where,),
    )
    error_message = _object_write_denial_message(model_cls, ctx)
    auxiliary_ctes = [
        *_permission_context_auxiliary_ctes(context_ref if permission_context_type is not None else None, ctx),
        *([(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else []),
    ]
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=rows_exist_assertion_query(
            source_query,
            error_message=error_message,
        ),
        needs_returning=True,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes or None,
        closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(
            error_message,
            exc_type=DbPermissionError,
        ),
        output_shape=sql_assertion_output_shape(),
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(sql_assertion_output_shape()),
        column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),

"""Read-through database connection implementation.

This module provides a composite connection that caches data locally while
reading from an upstream backend in read-only mode.

Version Consistency
===================

The read-through backend provides different consistency guarantees depending
on the table type:

**Versioned Tables (VersionedObjectRow)**:
    When a `snapshot_revision_id` is provided, all upstream reads for versioned
    tables use that revision. This guarantees a consistent point-in-time view
    regardless of concurrent upstream updates.

**Non-Versioned Tables (ApplicationObjectRow)**:
    Without native versioning, consistency depends on usage pattern:

    1. **Pre-fetch pattern** (recommended): Call `prefetch_tables()` at startup
       to bulk-load all tables before making any local changes. This captures
       a consistent snapshot.

    2. **Read-only pattern**: If you only read (never write locally), eventual
       consistency is usually acceptable.

    3. **Concurrent updates**: If the upstream is being actively updated during
       your session, non-versioned tables may show inconsistent views (object A
       from time T1, object B from time T2).

For testing/demo use cases, the pre-fetch pattern is recommended.

The cache-fill, authorization, and persistence invariants are specified in
``docs/design/READ_THROUGH_CLOSED_CACHE_FILL_ARCHITECTURE.rst``.
"""

def _remote_versioned_warm_queries[T: VersionedObjectRow[SysId]](
    txn: SyncVersionedReadTransaction | AsyncVersionedReadTransaction,
    model_classes: tuple[type[T], ...],
) -> Mapping[type[T], LazyResult[Sequence[T]]]:
    """Build one authorization-aware remote refresh plan for all requested models."""
    from impl.read_through.transaction import ReadThroughReadTransaction

    base_txn = txn.base_read_transaction
    if not isinstance(base_txn, ReadThroughReadTransaction):
        raise TypeError("remote versioned warming requires a read-through transaction")
    base_txn.configure_remote_versioned_warm_models(
        tuple(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", model_cls) for model_cls in model_classes),
    )
    return {model_cls: txn.query_lazy(model_cls).lazy() for model_cls in model_classes}


def _validated_remote_versioned_warm_rows[T: VersionedObjectRow[SysId]](
    model_cls: type[T],
    rows: Sequence[T],
) -> list[T]:
    """Validate one remote warm result at the shared sync and async boundary."""
    if isinstance(rows, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
        raise TypeError("remote versioned warming must return a row sequence")
    if not all(isinstance(row, model_cls) for row in rows):
        raise TypeError("remote versioned warming returned an invalid row type")
    return list(rows)


def _raise_public_prefetch_error(error: BaseException) -> Never:
    """Expose a stable database error instead of optimizer implementation detail."""
    from l1100_exceptions import TableNotFoundError

    cause = error
    while True:
        if isinstance(cause, TableNotFoundError):
            raise cause
        next_cause = cause.__cause__
        if next_cause is None:
            raise error
        cause = next_cause

)

    name="read_through:async_authority_locks",
    invalidation_policy=LocalMetadataInvalidationPolicy.MANUAL,
)


def _shared_authority_lock(cache: _DatabaseConnectionCore) -> threading.RLock:
    """Return the process-wide authority lock for one cache database."""
    return _AUTHORITY_LOCKS.get_or_compute(_cache_lock_identity(cache), threading.RLock)


def _shared_async_authority_binding(cache: _DatabaseConnectionCore) -> _AsyncAuthorityLockBinding:
    """Return the event-loop authority lock binding for one cache database."""
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    registry_key = f"{_cache_lock_identity(cache)}:{id(loop)}"
    binding = _ASYNC_AUTHORITY_LOCKS.get_or_compute(
        registry_key,
        lambda: _AsyncAuthorityLockBinding(loop=loop, lock=asyncio.Lock()),
    )
    if binding.loop is not loop:
        binding = _AsyncAuthorityLockBinding(loop=loop, lock=asyncio.Lock())
        _ASYNC_AUTHORITY_LOCKS.set(registry_key, binding)
    return binding


def _cache_lock_identity(cache: _DatabaseConnectionCore) -> str:
    """Return a process-wide lock key for one persistent cache database."""
    identity = cache.database_identity
    if ":memory:" in identity:
        return f"{identity}:{id(cache)}"
    return identity

@dataclass(slots=True)
class _ReadThroughSupportBootstrapPrimitiveContributor:
    """Contribute local support metadata derived from model registrations."""

    models: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...]
    key: BootstrapPrimitiveContributorKey = BootstrapPrimitiveContributorKey("read_through.support_metadata")
    version: SemanticVersionText = SemanticVersionText("1")
    contract_fingerprint = "ee4b8a1c41a7d877cd014ffaebca23c9a1d3ef25f0e0b7ba04ff2c8b14bcf226"

    def contribute(self, state: BootstrapPrimitiveState) -> None:
        support_models = self._support_models()
        if support_models:
            state.ensure_tables(cast("tuple[Any, ...]", support_models))
        for domain, versioned_models in self._versioning_domains().items():
            state.ensure_versioning_domain(
                bootstrap_versioning_domain_contract(domain, workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default()),
                branch_name=BranchName("main"),
                session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                versioned_models=tuple(versioned_models),
            )

    def _support_models(self) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]], ...]:
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            ReadThroughCoverageRecord,
            read_through_authority_metadata_models,
        )
        from l3200_metadata.schema_validation import _expected_graph_auxiliary_models

        support_models: list[type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]] = list(
            read_through_authority_metadata_models(),
        )
        for model_cls in self.models:
            if isinstance(model_cls, type) and issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
                support_models.append(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]", ReadThroughCoverageRecord))
            if get_fts_config(cast("type[Any]", model_cls)) is not None:
                support_models.append(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]", FTSIndexConfigRecord))
            if get_vector_indexes(cast("type[Any]", model_cls)):
                support_models.append(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]", VectorIndexConfigRecord))
            if _is_graph_model(model_cls):
                support_models.extend(
                    (cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]", GraphConfigMetadata),),
                )
            if isinstance(model_cls, type) and issubclass(model_cls, GraphNode) and model_cls is not GraphNode:
                support_models.append(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]", GraphNodePhysicalKeyRow))
        support_models.extend(_expected_graph_auxiliary_models(tuple(cast("Sequence[type[Any]]", self.models))))
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(support_models))

    def _versioning_domains(
        self,
    ) -> dict[type[VersioningDomain], list[type[VersionedObjectRow[Any]]]]:
        domains: dict[type[VersioningDomain], list[type[VersionedObjectRow[Any]]]] = {}
        for model_cls in self.models:
            if not isinstance(model_cls, type) or not issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
                continue
            domain = model_cls.__versioning_domain__
            domains.setdefault(domain, []).append(cast("type[VersionedObjectRow[Any]]", model_cls))
        return domains


def _is_graph_model(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]) -> bool:
    return isinstance(model_cls, type) and issubclass(model_cls, (Graph, GraphNode, GraphEdge))


def _resolve_registered_model_for_table(table_name: SqlTableName) -> type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]] | None:
    """Resolve a registered model by its physical table name."""
    from data_layer.model_registry import get_model, list_registered_models

    for model_name in list_registered_models():
        model_cls = get_model(model_name)
        if model_cls is not None and get_table_name(model_cls) == table_name:
            return cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", model_cls)
    return None

class _ReadThroughConnectionCore(_DatabaseConnectionCore):
    """A composite connection that caches locally and reads from upstream.

    This connection:
    - Services all WRITES to a local cache database
    - Services READS from local cache first, falling through to upstream on miss
    - Opens upstream in read-only mode to ensure no writes escape the cache

    Primary use cases:
    - Testing environments against production/staging data
    - Demo environments that can be cheaply thrown away

    Architecture::

        ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │          _ReadThroughConnectionCore          │
        │  (implements _DatabaseConnectionCore API)    │
        └──────────┬───────────────┬──────────────┘
                   │               │
                   ▼               ▼
        ┌─────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────┐
        │  Local Cache    │  │  Upstream Backend   │
        │  (R/W access)   │  │  (Read-only)        │
        └─────────────────┘  └─────────────────────┘

    Schema synchronization:
        User-session remote reads bootstrap cache tables from the local model
        registry through ``LazyBootstrapCoordinator`` before remote data execution.
        The schema bootstrap identity is local-cache-only and never hydrates
        missing schema or data from the upstream.

    Version Consistency:
        For versioned tables, provide a `snapshot_revision_id` to ensure all
        upstream reads return data from that specific revision. This prevents
        version skew when the upstream is being updated concurrently.

        For non-versioned tables, use `prefetch_tables()` at startup to bulk-load
        data before making local changes.

    Thread Safety:
        Like other connections, _ReadThroughConnectionCore is bound to the thread
        that created it and cannot be shared across threads.
    """

    _cache: _VersionedDatabaseConnectionCore
    _upstream: _DatabaseConnectionCore
    _cached_tables: set[str]
    _cache_schema_bootstrap_proofs: set[tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...]]
    _pending_schema_lock: threading.Lock
    _schema_generation_callback: SchemaGenerationCallback | None
    _allowed_connection_schema_methods = frozenset(
        {
            "add_column_if_missing",
            "add_column_if_missing_async",
            "column_exists",
            "column_exists_async",
            "list_tables",
            "list_tables_async",
            "table_exists",
            "table_exists_async",
        },
    )

    def __init__(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        cache: _VersionedDatabaseConnectionCore,
        upstream: _DatabaseConnectionCore | SyncRemoteIntentConnection | AsyncRemoteIntentConnection,
        *,
        read_only: bool = False,
        remote_mode: RemoteConnectionMode = RemoteConnectionMode.READ_THROUGH,
        authority_namespace: str | None = None,
        planning_models: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...] = (),
        offline_read_policy: OfflineReadPolicy = OfflineReadPolicy.AUTHORITY_SCOPED_CACHE,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize read-through connection with cache and upstream backends.

        Args:
            cache: Local cache connection (any _DatabaseConnectionCore, typically SQLite)
                   Must be connected and have full read/write access.
            upstream: Upstream data source connection (any _DatabaseConnectionCore)
                      Will be accessed in read-only mode only. The _ReadThroughConnectionCore
                      never writes to upstream - all writes go to cache.
            read_only: Reject application writes while allowing remote read
                       results to populate the local cache.
            planning_models: Exact models that remote plans can access.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If cache or upstream is None.
        """
        # The facade rejects application writes, but remote-read hydration owns a
        # writable cache. See docs/production_readthrough.rst.
        super().__init__(read_only=read_only)
        from impl.read_through.coverage import read_through_cache_metadata_models

        local_planning_models = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*planning_models, *read_through_cache_metadata_models())))
        self.bind_planning_models(*local_planning_models)
        if cache is None:
            msg = "cache connection cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if upstream is None:
            msg = "upstream connection cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if TYPE_CHECKING:
            assert isinstance(upstream, _DatabaseConnectionCore)
        cache.bind_planning_models(*local_planning_models)
        upstream.bind_planning_models(*planning_models)
        object.__setattr__(cache, "_read_transaction_uses_writable_handle", True)
        self._cache = cache
        self._upstream = upstream
        self._remote_mode = remote_mode
        self._offline_read_policy = offline_read_policy
        self._authority_namespace = authority_namespace or ":".join(
            (
                type(upstream).__module__,
                type(upstream).__qualname__,
                str(getattr(upstream, "_connection_id", "default")),
            ),
        )
        self._cached_tables: set[str] = set()
        self._cache_schema_bootstrap_proofs = set()
        self._verified_remote_compatibility: set[str] = set()
        self._suppress_remote_schema_proof = False
        shared_local_state = getattr(cache, "_readthrough_shared_local_state", None)
        if shared_local_state is None:
            shared_local_state = _ReadThroughSharedLocalState(
                tables_with_local_writes=set(),
                row_overlays={},
                complete_prefetched_tables=set(),
                authority_key=None,
            )
            object.__setattr__(cache, "_readthrough_shared_local_state", shared_local_state)
        if not isinstance(shared_local_state, _ReadThroughSharedLocalState):
            raise RuntimeError("Cache read-through local state has an invalid type")
        self._shared_local_state = shared_local_state
        self._tables_with_local_writes = shared_local_state.tables_with_local_writes
        self._local_row_overlays = shared_local_state.row_overlays
        self._complete_prefetched_tables = shared_local_state.complete_prefetched_tables
        self._pending_schema_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._backend_operations: BackendOperations | None = None
        self._schema_generation_callback: SchemaGenerationCallback | None = None
        from impl.remote.connection import AsyncRemoteIntentConnection, SyncRemoteIntentConnection

        self._authority_lease_key: _ReadThroughAuthorityKey | None = None
        self._authority_principal_user_id: UserId | None = (
            None
            if isinstance(upstream, SyncRemoteIntentConnection | AsyncRemoteIntentConnection)
            else UserId(str(uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, f"nera:readthrough:local-principal:{self._authority_namespace}")))
        )
        self._authenticated_cache_sessions: dict[SessionId, SessionId] = {}
        self._authority_lease_lock = _shared_authority_lock(cache)
        self._backend_schema_service = getattr(cache, "_backend_schema_service", None)

    def _uses_remote_system_authority(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, session_id: SessionId) -> bool:
        from impl.remote.connection import SyncRemoteIntentConnection

        return session_id.is_system_session() and isinstance(self._upstream, SyncRemoteIntentConnection)

    def __getattr__(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore, name: str) -> Any:
        """Delegate stable versioned connection APIs to the local cache facade."""
        if name in {
            "_db_path",
            "native_pipeline",
            "write_version_async",
            "write_version_lazy",
        }:
            return getattr(self._cache, name)
        raise AttributeError(name)

    @legacy_sync(lazy_name="write_version_lazy")
    def write_version[T](

    def _bind_operation_domain(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    ) -> None:
        """Register one operation domain without selecting a connection domain."""
        models = versioning_domain_planning_models(domain)
        self.bind_planning_models(*models)
        self._cache.bind_planning_models(*models)
        self._bind_upstream_planning_models(models)

    def _mark_domain_tables_locally_written(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    ) -> None:
        for model_cls in versioning_domain_planning_models(domain):
            table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
            self._tables_with_local_writes.update(
                {
                    table_name,
                    derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(table_name))).staged,
                    derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(table_name))).tip,
                },
            )

    def open_versioned_read_plan(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        *,
        session_id: SessionId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        revision: RevisionId | None = None,
        branch: BranchIdAnchor | None = None,
        branch_factory: BranchIdAnchorFactory | None = None,
        branch_name: BranchName | None = None,
        workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None = None,
        observe_staged_from: ConnectionId | None = None,
        context_resolver: SessionContextResolverInput = SESSION_CONTEXT_RESOLVER_UNSET,
        retry_policy: RetryPolicy | None = None,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> SyncVersionedPlanScope:
        """Open a versioned read scope on cache for sentinels, read-through for users."""
        self._bind_operation_domain(domain)
        if session_id.is_schema_session() or (session_id.is_system_session() and not self._uses_remote_system_authority(session_id)):
            assert isinstance(self._cache, SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection)
            return self._cache.open_versioned_read_plan(
                session_id=session_id,
                domain=domain,
                revision=revision,
                branch=branch,
                branch_factory=branch_factory,
                branch_name=branch_name,
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                observe_staged_from=observe_staged_from,
                retry_policy=retry_policy,
                timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
            )
        scope = cast(Any, SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection).open_versioned_read_plan(
            self,
            session_id=session_id,
            domain=domain,
            revision=revision,
            branch=branch,
            branch_factory=cast(Any, branch_factory),
            branch_name=branch_name,
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            observe_staged_from=observe_staged_from,
            context_resolver=context_resolver,
            retry_policy=retry_policy,
            timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
        )
        return cast("SyncVersionedPlanScope", scope)

    @direct_legacy_sync
    def read_version[T](
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        session_id: SessionId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        fn: Callable[[SyncVersionedReadTransaction], T],
        *,
        revision: RevisionId | None = None,
        branch: BranchIdAnchor | None = None,
        branch_name: BranchName | None = None,
        workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None = None,
        observe_staged_from: ConnectionId | None = None,
        retry_policy: RetryPolicy | None = None,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> T:
        """Run a versioned read callback through the read-through plan surface."""
        self._bind_operation_domain(domain)
        if session_id.is_schema_session() or (session_id.is_system_session() and not self._uses_remote_system_authority(session_id)):
            previous_cache_domain = getattr(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_domain", None)
            object.__setattr__(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_domain", domain)
            try:
                with cast(Any, self._cache).open_versioned_read_plan(
                    session_id=session_id,
                    domain=domain,
                    revision=revision,
                    branch=branch,
                    branch_name=branch_name,
                    workspace_id=workspace_id,
                    observe_staged_from=observe_staged_from,
                    retry_policy=retry_policy,
                    timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
                ) as scope:
                    return fn(scope.txn)
            finally:
                object.__setattr__(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_domain", previous_cache_domain)

        def _readthrough_versioned_callback(txn: Any) -> T:
            object.__setattr__(txn, "_versioning_domain", domain)
            base_txn_for_domain = getattr(txn, "_base_txn", None)
            if base_txn_for_domain is None:
                base_txn_for_domain = getattr(txn, "base_read_transaction", None)
            if base_txn_for_domain is not None:
                object.__setattr__(base_txn_for_domain, "_versioning_domain", domain)
                object.__setattr__(base_txn_for_domain, "domain", domain)
            effective_revision = revision
            resolved_branch_tip = revision is None and branch is not None
            if resolved_branch_tip:
                assert branch is not None
                object.__setattr__(txn, "_lazy_branch", LazyResult.of(branch))
                object.__setattr__(txn, "_branch_anchor", branch)
                if observe_staged_from is not None:
                    object.__setattr__(txn, "_observe_staged_from", observe_staged_from)
                    object.__setattr__(txn, "_prefer_tip_merged", True)
                base_txn = getattr(txn, "_base_txn", None)
                if base_txn is None:
                    base_txn = getattr(txn, "base_read_transaction", None)
                if base_txn is not None:
                    object.__setattr__(base_txn, "_lazy_branch", LazyResult.of(branch))
                    object.__setattr__(base_txn, "_branch_anchor", branch)
                    object.__setattr__(base_txn, "domain", domain)
                    if observe_staged_from is not None:
                        object.__setattr__(base_txn, "_observe_staged_from", observe_staged_from)
                        object.__setattr__(base_txn, "_prefer_tip_merged", True)
                if branch is None:
                    msg = "Resolved branch tip without a concrete branch id"
                    raise RuntimeError(msg)
            if effective_revision is not None:

                def bind_effective_revision_context(target: object) -> None:
                    context_refs = get_versioned_context_refs(target)
                    set_versioned_context_refs(
                        target,
                        VersionedContextRefs(
                            branch=UNSET if context_refs is None else context_refs.branch,
                            revision=effective_revision,
                            workspace=UNSET if context_refs is None else context_refs.workspace,
                        ),
                    )

                object.__setattr__(txn, "_revision_id", effective_revision)
                if not resolved_branch_tip:
                    object.__setattr__(txn, "_explicit_read_revision_id", effective_revision)
                object.__setattr__(txn, "_lazy_revision", LazyResult.of(effective_revision))
                bind_effective_revision_context(txn)
                base_txn = getattr(txn, "_base_txn", None)
                if base_txn is None:
                    base_txn = getattr(txn, "base_read_transaction", None)
                if base_txn is not None:
                    object.__setattr__(base_txn, "_revision_id", effective_revision)
                    if not resolved_branch_tip:
                        object.__setattr__(base_txn, "_explicit_read_revision_id", effective_revision)
                    object.__setattr__(base_txn, "_lazy_revision", LazyResult.of(effective_revision))
                    bind_effective_revision_context(base_txn)
                get_plan = getattr(txn, "_get_lazy_plan", None)
                if callable(get_plan):
                    plan = get_plan()
                    plan_owner = getattr(plan, "_txn", None)
                    if plan_owner is not None:
                        object.__setattr__(plan_owner, "_lazy_branch", LazyResult.of(branch))
                        object.__setattr__(plan_owner, "_branch_anchor", branch)
                        if observe_staged_from is not None:
                            object.__setattr__(plan_owner, "_observe_staged_from", observe_staged_from)
                            object.__setattr__(plan_owner, "_prefer_tip_merged", True)
                        object.__setattr__(plan_owner, "_revision_id", effective_revision)
                        if not resolved_branch_tip:
                            object.__setattr__(plan_owner, "_explicit_read_revision_id", effective_revision)
                        object.__setattr__(plan_owner, "_lazy_revision", LazyResult.of(effective_revision))
            previous_revision = getattr(self, "_active_readthrough_revision_id", None)
            previous_cache_revision = getattr(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_revision_id", None)
            previous_domain = getattr(self, "_active_readthrough_domain", None)
            previous_cache_domain = getattr(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_domain", None)
            previous_branch = getattr(self, "_active_readthrough_branch_id", None)
            previous_cache_branch = getattr(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_branch_id", None)
            object.__setattr__(self, "_active_readthrough_revision_id", effective_revision)
            object.__setattr__(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_revision_id", effective_revision)
            object.__setattr__(self, "_active_readthrough_domain", domain)
            object.__setattr__(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_domain", domain)
            object.__setattr__(self, "_active_readthrough_branch_id", branch)
            object.__setattr__(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_branch_id", branch)
            try:
                return fn(txn)
            finally:
                object.__setattr__(self, "_active_readthrough_revision_id", previous_revision)
                object.__setattr__(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_revision_id", previous_cache_revision)
                object.__setattr__(self, "_active_readthrough_domain", previous_domain)
                object.__setattr__(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_domain", previous_cache_domain)
                object.__setattr__(self, "_active_readthrough_branch_id", previous_branch)
                object.__setattr__(self._cache, "_active_readthrough_branch_id", previous_cache_branch)

        return cast(
            "T",
            cast(Any, SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection)._read_version_sync(
                self,
                session_id=session_id,
                domain=domain,
                fn=_readthrough_versioned_callback,
                revision=revision,
                branch=branch,
                branch_name=branch_name,
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                observe_staged_from=observe_staged_from,
                retry_policy=retry_policy,
                timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
            ),
        )

    def _apply_cache_branch_context(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch: BranchId,
        session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> None:
        """Apply cache branch-context hydration at the terminal boundary."""
        branch_model = domain.branch_model
        if not self._local_cache_has_model_schema(branch_model):
            self._ensure_model_cached(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", branch_model))

        def local_branch_row(txn: Any) -> Any | None:
            txn._allow_versioned_table_access = True
            return resolve_terminal_sync(
                txn,
                "_apply_cache_branch_context.local_branch_row",
                txn.select_one_lazy(branch_model, LazyResult.of(branch)),
            )

        existing_branch_row = cast(
            Any,
            self._cache.session(session_id).read_lazy(local_branch_row),
        )
        existing_branch_row = resolve_terminal_sync(
            self,
            "_apply_cache_branch_context.existing_branch_row",
            existing_branch_row,
        )

        branch_row = self._fetch_remote_branch_row_terminal(domain, branch, session_id)
        if not isinstance(branch_row, BaseModel):
            if isinstance(existing_branch_row, BaseModel) and isinstance(
                getattr(existing_branch_row, "tip_revision_sys_id", None),
                RevisionId,
            ):
                return
            branch_row = self._cache_branch_anchor_row(domain, branch)
        elif isinstance(branch_row, BaseModel) and getattr(branch_row, "sys_id", None) is None:
            branch_row = branch_row.model_copy(update={"sys_id": branch})
        revision_row = self._fetch_remote_branch_tip_revision_terminal(domain, branch_row, session_id)
        revision_branch_index_row = self._fetch_remote_revision_branch_index_terminal(
            domain,
            branch,
            revision_row,
            session_id,
        )
        branch_name_value = getattr(branch_row, "name", None)
        workspace_id_value = getattr(branch_row, "workspace_id", None)
        if branch_name_value is not None and workspace_id_value is not None:

            def read_branch_by_identity(txn: Any) -> Any | None:
                txn._allow_versioned_table_access = True
                query = txn.query_lazy(branch_model)._without_permission_filtering()
                rows = resolve_terminal_sync(
                    txn,
                    "_apply_cache_branch_context.read_branch_by_identity",
                    query.filter(
                        (field(branch_model.workspace_id) == workspace_id_value) & (field(branch_model.name) == branch_name_value),
                    )
                    .limit(1)
                    .execute_lazy(),
                )
                return rows[0] if rows else None

            existing_identity_lazy = self._cache.session(session_id).read_lazy(
                read_branch_by_identity,
            )
            assert isinstance(existing_identity_lazy, LazyResult)
            existing_identity_row = resolve_terminal_sync(
                self,
                "_apply_cache_branch_context.existing_identity_row",
                existing_identity_lazy,
            )
            if existing_identity_row is not None and getattr(existing_identity_row, "sys_id", None) != branch:
                cache_branch_name = BranchName(f"{branch_name_value}-{branch}")
                if isinstance(branch_row, BaseModel):
                    branch_row = branch_row.model_copy(update={"name": cache_branch_name})
                elif isinstance(branch_row, dict):
                    branch_row = {**branch_row, "name": cache_branch_name}

        def cache_bindable_metadata_row(row: object) -> object:
            if not isinstance(row, BaseModel):
                return row
            # Remote metadata is an external transport value. Preserve its
            # authoritative JSON values while avoiding revalidation back into
            # compact-ID wrappers that are not SQL bind values.
            return type(row).model_construct(**row.model_dump(mode="json"))

        cache_revision_row = None if revision_row is None else cache_bindable_metadata_row(revision_row)
        cache_branch_row = cache_bindable_metadata_row(branch_row)
        cache_index_row = None if revision_branch_index_row is None else cache_bindable_metadata_row(revision_branch_index_row)

        def write_branch(txn: Any) -> None:
            if cache_revision_row is not None:
                resolve_terminal_sync(
                    txn,
                    "_apply_cache_branch_context.write_revision",
                    txn.upsert_lazy(domain.revision_model, LazyResult.of(cache_revision_row)),
                )
            resolve_terminal_sync(
                txn,
                "_apply_cache_branch_context.write_branch",
                txn.upsert_lazy(branch_model, LazyResult.of(cache_branch_row)),
            )
            if cache_index_row is not None:
                resolve_terminal_sync(
                    txn,
                    "_apply_cache_branch_context.write_revision_branch_index",
                    txn.upsert_lazy(
                        domain.revision_branch_index_model,
                        LazyResult.of(cache_index_row),
                        conflict_columns=[
                            field(domain.revision_branch_index_model.revision_sys_id),
                            field(domain.revision_branch_index_model.branch_sys_id),
                        ],
                    ),
                )
            resolve_terminal_sync(
                txn,
                "_apply_cache_branch_context.commit",
                txn.commit_lazy(),
            )

        write_result = self._cache.session(session_id).write_lazy(write_branch)
        assert isinstance(write_result, LazyResult)
        resolve_terminal_sync(
            self,
            "_apply_cache_branch_context.write",
            write_result,
        )

    def _cache_branch_anchor_row(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch: BranchId,
    ) -> BaseBranch:
        branch_model = domain.branch_model
        return branch_model(
            sys_id=branch,
            name=BranchName(f"readthrough-cache-{branch}"),
            tip_revision_sys_id=None,
            workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default(),
            deleted=False,
        )

    @direct_legacy_module_sync
    def _load_cache_branch_row(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch: BranchId,
    ) -> Any | None:
        branch_model = domain.branch_model

        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import SyncReadPlanWorkflow, run_read_plan_workflow
        from l2050_transaction.transaction import SyncReadTransaction

        def read_branch(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> LazyResult[object | None]:
            txn._allow_versioned_table_access = True
            return cast("LazyResult[Any | None]", txn.select_one_lazy(branch_model, LazyResult.of(branch)))

        return run_read_plan_workflow(
            cast("Any", self._cache),
            SyncReadPlanWorkflow[object | None](
                session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                build=read_branch,
                result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("branch"),
            ),
        )

    def _fetch_remote_branch_row_terminal(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch: BranchId,
        session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> object | None:
        branch_model = domain.branch_model

        def read_branch(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> object | None:
            query = txn.query_lazy(branch_model)._without_permission_filtering()
            rows = resolve_terminal_sync(
                txn,
                "_fetch_remote_branch_row_terminal",
                query.filter(field(branch_model.sys_id) == branch).limit(1).execute_lazy(),
            )
            return cast("object | None", rows[0] if rows else None)

        try:
            with self._upstream.session(session_id).open_read_plan() as scope:
                remote_branch = read_branch(scope.transaction)
            if isinstance(remote_branch, list):
                return remote_branch[0] if remote_branch else None
            return remote_branch
        except Exception:
            logger.debug(
                "Could not mirror remote branch %s into read-through cache",
                branch,
                exc_info=True,
            )
            return None

    def _fetch_remote_branch_tip_revision_terminal(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_row: object,
        session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> object | None:
        revision_id = getattr(branch_row, "tip_revision_sys_id", None)
        if revision_id is None:
            return None
        revision_model = domain.revision_model
        if not self._local_cache_has_model_schema(revision_model):
            self._ensure_model_cached(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", revision_model))

        def read_revision(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> object | None:
            query = txn.query_lazy(revision_model)._without_permission_filtering()
            rows = resolve_terminal_sync(
                txn,
                "_fetch_remote_branch_tip_revision_terminal",
                query.filter(field(revision_model.sys_id) == revision_id).limit(1).execute_lazy(),
            )
            return cast("object | None", rows[0] if rows else None)

        try:
            with self._upstream.session(session_id).open_read_plan() as scope:
                return read_revision(scope.transaction)
        except Exception:
            logger.debug(
                "Could not mirror remote tip revision %s into read-through cache",
                revision_id,
                exc_info=True,
            )
            return None

    def _fetch_remote_revision_branch_index_terminal(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch: BranchId,
        revision_row: object | None,
        session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> object | None:
        revision_id = getattr(revision_row, "sys_id", None)
        if revision_id is None:
            return None
        index_model = domain.revision_branch_index_model

        def read_index(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> object | None:
            query = txn.query_lazy(index_model)._without_permission_filtering()
            rows = resolve_terminal_sync(
                txn,
                "_fetch_remote_revision_branch_index_terminal",
                query.filter(
                    (field(index_model.revision_sys_id) == revision_id) & (field(index_model.branch_sys_id) == branch),
                )
                .limit(1)
                .execute_lazy(),
            )
            return cast("object | None", rows[0] if rows else None)

        with self._upstream.session(session_id).open_read_plan() as scope:
            return read_index(scope.transaction)

    def bootstrap_cache_schema(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        model_classes: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...],
        *,
        manifest_key: BootstrapManifestKey | None = None,
        extra_model_classes: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...] = (),
    ) -> BootstrapEngineRunResult:
        """Bootstrap known cache tables locally as one coordinator batch."""
        models = tuple(
            sorted(
                dict.fromkeys((*model_classes, *extra_model_classes)),
                key=lambda model_cls: f"{model_cls.__module__}.{model_cls.__qualname__}",
            ),
        )
        table_names = tuple(sorted({get_table_name(model_cls) for model_cls in models}))
        model_identity = "|".join(sorted(f"{model_cls.__module__}.{model_cls.__qualname__}" for model_cls in models))
        model_digest = hashlib.sha256(model_identity.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        default_manifest_key = f"read-through-cache-v3:{','.join(table_names)}:{model_digest}"
        if len(default_manifest_key) > 256:
            digest = hashlib.sha256(default_manifest_key.encode()).hexdigest()
            default_manifest_key = f"{default_manifest_key[:191]}:{digest}"
        effective_manifest_key = manifest_key or default_manifest_key
        contributors: tuple[BootstrapPrimitiveContributor, ...] = (
            DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(),
            _ReadThroughCacheBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(models),
            _ReadThroughSupportBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(models),
        )
        if any(get_vector_indexes(model_cls) for model_cls in models):
            contributors = (*contributors, ContentAddressableEmbeddingBootstrapPrimitiveContributor())
        coordinator = BootstrapCoordinator()
        engine_plan = coordinator.build_engine_plan(
            manifest_key=effective_manifest_key,
            model_classes=models,
            contributors=contributors,
            dialect=cast("SyncDatabaseConnection", self._cache).get_dialect(),
        )
        result = coordinator.run(
            cast("SyncDatabaseConnection", self._cache),
            manifest_key=effective_manifest_key,
            model_classes=models,
            contributors=contributors,
            engine_plan=engine_plan,
        )
        bootstrap_table_names = (
            (
                *(str(table_name) for table_name in engine_plan.physical_contract.table_names),
                "sys_bootstrap_manifests",
                "sys_bootstrap_proof_scopes",
                "sys_bootstrap_seed_facts",
                "sys_ddl_lockdown",
                "sys_schema_state",
            )
            if engine_plan is not None
            else table_names
        )
        for table_name in bootstrap_table_names:
            self._cache._mark_table_created(SqlTableName(table_name))
        self._cached_tables.update((*bootstrap_table_names, *table_names))
        self._cache_schema_bootstrap_proofs.add(models)
        return result

    def _bootstrap_cache_schema_if_missing(
        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,
        model_classes: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...],
    ) -> None:
        """Bootstrap only when the requested models and tables remain ready."""
        table_names = {str(get_table_name(model_cls)) for model_cls in model_classes}
        if model_classes in self._cache_schema_bootstrap_proofs and table_names <= self._cached_tables:
            return
        self.bootstrap_cache_schema(model_classes)
        self._cache_schema_bootstrap_proofs.add(model_classes)

        self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore,

        table_names = {str(get_table_name(model_cls)) for model_cls in model_classes}
        if model_classes in self._cache_schema_bootstrap_proofs and table_names <= self._cached_tables:
            return
        await self.bootstrap_cache_schema_async(model_classes)
        self._cache_schema_bootstrap_proofs.add(model_classes)

        """Expose the local SQL cache for test-only wrapper unwrapping."""

    def connect(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """Connect both cache and upstream backends."""
        self._connect_impl_sync()

    def _connect_impl_sync(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """Connect cache/upstream through their sync lifecycle."""
        if not self._cache.is_connected():
            self._cache.connect()
        self._disable_cache_foreign_keys_for_readthrough()
        if not self._upstream.is_connected():
            self._upstream.connect()
        self._finish_connect_state()

    async def _connect_impl_async(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """Connect cache/upstream through their async lifecycle."""
        if not await self._cache.is_connected_async():
            await self._cache.connect_async()
        await self._disable_cache_foreign_keys_for_readthrough_async()
        upstream_connected = await self._upstream.is_connected_async()
        if not upstream_connected:
            await self._upstream.connect_async()
        self._finish_connect_state()

        """Allow local overlay rows to reference upstream rows not materialized in cache."""
        if self._cache.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
            return
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlGrammarKind, SqlGrammarValue
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_utility import SqlPragmaSet

        cast("_SqlConnectionCore", self._cache)._execute_direct_internal(
            SqlPragmaSet(SqlGrammarKind("foreign_keys"), SqlGrammarValue("OFF")),

        if self._cache.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:

        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlGrammarKind, SqlGrammarValue

    def _finish_connect_state(self: _ReadThroughConnectionCore) -> None:
        """Finalize shared state after either connect path succeeds."""
