class _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope:
    """Keep nested lazy read results symbolic until the read-through scope executes."""

    def __init__(self: _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope, inner: Any) -> None:
        self._inner = inner

    async def __aenter__(self: _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope) -> _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope:
        await self._inner.__aenter__()
        return self

    async def __aexit__(
        self: _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope,
        exc_type: type[BaseException] | None,
        exc_val: BaseException | None,
        exc_tb: Any,
    ) -> bool | None:
        result = await self._inner.__aexit__(exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb)
        assert result is None or isinstance(result, bool)
        return result

    def __getattr__(self: _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope, name: str) -> Any:
        return getattr(self._inner, name)

    @property
    def txn(self: _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope) -> Any:
        return self._inner.txn

    @property
    def plan(self: _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope) -> Any:
        return self._inner.plan

    def return_result(self: _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope, name: str, value: object) -> None:
        self._inner.return_result(name, value)

    async def execute_results(self: _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope) -> dict[str, object]:
        sync_shape = getattr(self._inner, "_sync_shape", None)
        named_returns = getattr(sync_shape, "_named_returns", None)
        templates: dict[str, object] = {}
        if isinstance(named_returns, dict):
            plan = self._inner.plan
            for name, value in tuple(named_returns.items()):
                template, has_lazy_leaves = await _nested_readthrough_fetch_template(
                    self._inner,
                    value,
                    (
                        PlanScopeFetchPathComponent("readthrough_versioned_return"),
                        PlanScopeFetchPathComponent(name),
                    ),
                    plan,
                )
                if not has_lazy_leaves:
                    continue
                named_returns[name] = template
                templates[name] = template
        results = await self._inner.execute_results()
        assert isinstance(results, dict)
        typed_results = PlanScopeFetchResults(results)
        if not templates:
            return {str(name): value for name, value in typed_results.items()}
        return {name: _resolve_plan_scope_fetch_template(template, typed_results) for name, template in templates.items()}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _NestedReadThroughReturn:
    name: str


async def _nested_readthrough_fetch_template(
    scope: BaseServerPlan,
    value: object,
    path: tuple[PlanScopeFetchPathComponent, ...],
    plan: object,
) -> tuple[object, bool]:
    if isinstance(value, LazyResult):
        if not _nested_lazy_owned_by_plan(value, plan):
            resolved = await _register_nested_readthrough_returns(
                ".".join(str(part) for part in path),
                value,
                {},
                plan,
            )
            return resolved, True
        return _plan_scope_fetch_template(scope, value, path), True
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        found_lazy = False
        template: dict[object, object] = {}
        for key, item in value.items():
            item_template, item_found_lazy = await _nested_readthrough_fetch_template(
                scope,
                item,
                (*path, PlanScopeFetchPathComponent(str(key))),
                plan,
            )
            template[key] = item_template
            found_lazy = found_lazy or item_found_lazy
        return template, found_lazy
    if isinstance(value, list):
        found_lazy = False
        template_items: list[object] = []
        for index, item in enumerate(value):
            item_template, item_found_lazy = await _nested_readthrough_fetch_template(
                scope,
                item,
                (*path, PlanScopeFetchPathComponent(str(index))),
                plan,
            )
            template_items.append(item_template)
            found_lazy = found_lazy or item_found_lazy
        return template_items, found_lazy
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        found_lazy = False
        template_items = []
        for index, item in enumerate(value):
            item_template, item_found_lazy = await _nested_readthrough_fetch_template(
                scope,
                item,
                (*path, PlanScopeFetchPathComponent(str(index))),
                plan,
            )
            template_items.append(item_template)
            found_lazy = found_lazy or item_found_lazy
        return tuple(template_items), found_lazy
    return value, False


def _nested_lazy_owned_by_plan[ValueT](value: LazyResult[ValueT], plan: object) -> bool:
    step_ref_ids = getattr(plan, "_step_ref_ids", None)
    if not isinstance(step_ref_ids, set):
        return True
    candidate_refs: set[str] = set()
    step_ref_id = object.__getattribute__(value, "_step_ref_id")
    if isinstance(step_ref_id, str):
        candidate_refs.add(step_ref_id.split(".", 1)[0])
    planning_ref_id = getattr(value, "_planning_ref_id", None)
    if isinstance(planning_ref_id, str):
        candidate_refs.add(planning_ref_id.split(".", 1)[0])
    dependency_refs = object.__getattribute__(value, "_dependency_refs")
    candidate_refs.update(str(ref_id).split(".", 1)[0] for ref_id in dependency_refs)
    return any(ref_id in step_ref_ids for ref_id in candidate_refs)


async def _register_nested_readthrough_returns(
    name: str,
    value: object,
    named_returns: dict[str, object],
    plan: object,
    *,
    top_level: bool = True,
) -> object:
    if isinstance(value, LazyResult):
        publication_contract = _nested_lazy_publication_contract(value)
        resolved = await value
        _register_nested_resolved_seed(value, resolved, publication_contract)
        return resolved
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {
            key: await _register_nested_readthrough_returns(
                f"{name}.{key}",
                item,
                named_returns,
                plan,
                top_level=False,
            )
            for key, item in value.items()
        }
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [
            await _register_nested_readthrough_returns(
                f"{name}.{index}",
                item,
                named_returns,
                plan,
                top_level=False,
            )
            for index, item in enumerate(value)
        ]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return tuple(
            [
                await _register_nested_readthrough_returns(
                    f"{name}.{index}",
                    item,
                    named_returns,
                    plan,
                    top_level=False,
                )
                for index, item in enumerate(value)
            ]
        )
    return value


def _nested_lazy_publication_contract[ValueT](value: LazyResult[ValueT]) -> CtePublicationContract | None:
    step_ref_id = _nested_lazy_step_ref_id(value)
    if step_ref_id is None:
        return None
    context = object.__getattribute__(value, "_context")
    source_plan = getattr(context, "_plan", None)
    if source_plan is None:
        txn = getattr(context, "_txn", None)
        flush_context_factory = getattr(txn, "_require_txn_flush_context_runtime", None)
        if not callable(flush_context_factory):
            return None
        flush_context = flush_context_factory()
        source_plan = getattr(flush_context, "_plan", None)
    for step in tuple(getattr(source_plan, "_steps", ()) or ()):
        if str(getattr(step, "ref_id", "")) != str(step_ref_id):
            continue
        contract_method = getattr(step, "cte_publication_contract", None)
        if not callable(contract_method):
            return None
        contract = contract_method()
        return contract if isinstance(contract, CtePublicationContract) else None
    return None


def _register_nested_resolved_seed[ValueT](
    value: LazyResult[ValueT],
    resolved: object,
    publication_contract: CtePublicationContract | None,
) -> None:
    if publication_contract is None:
        return
    step_ref_id = _nested_lazy_step_ref_id(value)
    if step_ref_id is None:
        return
    columns = publication_contract.columns
    rows = _nested_seed_rows(resolved, columns)
    if rows is None:
        return
    register_planless_seeded_constant_for_ref(ServerPlanRefId(step_ref_id), rows)
    for column in columns:
        column_values = [row[column] for row in rows if column in row]
        register_planless_seeded_constant_for_ref(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{step_ref_id}.{column}"),
            column_values,
            sql_hints=publication_contract.column_type_hints.filtered({column}),
        )


def _nested_seed_rows(
    resolved: object,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> list[dict[str, object]] | None:
    if not isinstance(resolved, Sequence) or isinstance(resolved, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
        return None
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for item in resolved:
        if isinstance(item, BaseModel):
            dumped = item.model_dump(mode="python")
            rows.append({column: dumped.get(column) for column in columns})
            continue
        if isinstance(item, Mapping):
            rows.append({column: item.get(column) for column in columns})
            continue
        if isinstance(item, Sequence) and not isinstance(item, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
            rows.append({column: item[index] for index, column in enumerate(columns) if index < len(item)})
            continue
        rows.append({column: getattr(item, column) for column in columns if hasattr(item, column)})
    return rows


def _nested_lazy_step_ref_id[ValueT](value: LazyResult[ValueT]) -> str | None:
    step_ref_id = object.__getattribute__(value, "_step_ref_id")
    if isinstance(step_ref_id, str):
        return step_ref_id
    dependency_refs = object.__getattribute__(value, "_dependency_refs")
    if len(dependency_refs) != 1:
        return None
    return str(next(iter(dependency_refs))).split(".", 1)[0]


def _restore_nested_readthrough_returns(template: object, results: dict[str, object]) -> object:
    if isinstance(template, _NestedReadThroughReturn):
        return results[template.name]
    if isinstance(template, dict):
        return {key: _restore_nested_readthrough_returns(value, results) for key, value in template.items()}
    if isinstance(template, list):
        return [_restore_nested_readthrough_returns(value, results) for value in template]
    if isinstance(template, tuple):
        return tuple(_restore_nested_readthrough_returns(value, results) for value in template)
    return template


class AsyncReadThroughConnection(_ReadThroughConnectionCore, AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection):
    """Async-only ReadThrough connection facade."""

    @legacy_async(lazy_name="write_version_lazy")
    async def write_version_async[T](
        self: AsyncReadThroughConnection,
        session_id: SessionId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        fn: Callable[[AsyncVersionedWriteTransaction], Awaitable[T]],
        *,
        branch: BranchIdAnchor | None = None,
        branch_name: BranchName | None = None,
        create_if_missing: bool = False,
        workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None = None,
        from_revision_id: RevisionId | None = None,
        new_branch_tip_materialization: BranchTipMaterialization | None = None,
        connection_id: ConnectionId | None = None,
        staged_commit_id: StagedCommitId | None = None,
        staged_visibility: StagedVisibility = StagedVisibility.TRANSACTION,
        concurrent_commit_behavior: ConcurrentBranchCommitBehavior = ConcurrentBranchCommitBehavior.FAIL_FAST,
        context_resolver: SessionContextResolverInput = SESSION_CONTEXT_RESOLVER_UNSET,
        retry_policy: RetryPolicy | None = None,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> T:
        """Run a versioned write through the inherited lazy entry plan."""
        _legacy_delegate_stub_async()

    @direct_legacy_module_async
    async def prefetch_tables_async(
        self: AsyncReadThroughConnection,
        model_classes: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...],
        session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> dict[str, int]:
        """Populate complete non-versioned snapshots through async workflows."""
        from impl.read_through.transaction import AsyncReadThroughReadTransaction
        from impl.remote.connection import AsyncRemoteIntentConnection
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import (
            AsyncReadPlanWorkflow,
            run_read_plan_workflow_async,
        )
        from l2070_batching.optimizer_diagnostics import OptimizerInternalError
        from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import VersionedObjectRow

        upstream = self._upstream
        if not isinstance(upstream, AsyncDatabaseConnection | AsyncRemoteIntentConnection):
            msg = f"async prefetch requires an async-capable upstream, got {type(upstream).__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        for model_cls in model_classes:
            if issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
                msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} is versioned; use warm_versioned_tables()"
                raise TypeError(msg)

        authority_lock = await self._acquire_async_authority_lock()
        try:
            snapshots: list[tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]] = []
            counts: dict[str, int] = {}
            for model_cls in model_classes:
                self.bind_planning_models(model_cls)
                self._bind_upstream_planning_models((model_cls,))
                self._cache.bind_planning_models(model_cls)
                await self._ensure_schema_prerequisites_async((model_cls,))
                prefetch_model_cls = model_cls

                if isinstance(upstream, AsyncRemoteIntentConnection):

                    async def build_remote_prefetch(
                        txn: AsyncReadTransaction,
                    ) -> LazyResult[int | Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]:
                        if not isinstance(txn, AsyncReadThroughReadTransaction):
                            msg = (
                                "async remote prefetch requires AsyncReadThroughReadTransaction, "
                                f"got {type(txn).__name__} for {prefetch_model_cls.__name__}"
                            )
                            raise TypeError(msg)
                        return cast(
                            "LazyResult[int | Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]",
                            txn.build_remote_prefetch_query(prefetch_model_cls),
                        )

                    try:
                        remote_result = await run_read_plan_workflow_async(
                            self,
                            AsyncReadPlanWorkflow[int | Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]](
                                session_id=session_id,
                                build=build_remote_prefetch,
                                result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("prefetch_result"),
                            ),
                        )
                    except OptimizerInternalError as error:
                        _raise_public_prefetch_error(error)
                    if (
                        isinstance(remote_result, Sequence)
                        and not isinstance(remote_result, (str, bytes, bytearray))
                        and len(remote_result) == 1
                        and isinstance(remote_result[0], int)
                    ):
                        remote_result = remote_result[0]
                    if isinstance(remote_result, int):
                        self._record_prefetched_table(model_cls, remote_result, counts)
                        await self._mark_cached_table_async(SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_cls)))
                        continue
                    if not isinstance(remote_result, Sequence) or isinstance(
                        remote_result,
                        (str, bytes, bytearray),
                    ):
                        msg = (
                            f"async remote prefetch for {model_cls.__name__} ({get_table_name(model_cls)}) "
                            f"expected a row count or row sequence, got {type(remote_result).__name__}"
                        )
                        raise TypeError(msg)
                    snapshots.append((model_cls, remote_result))
                    continue

                async def build_local_prefetch(
                    txn: AsyncReadTransaction,
                ) -> LazyResult[Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]:
                    return txn.query_lazy(prefetch_model_cls).execute_lazy()

                try:
                    rows_result = await run_read_plan_workflow_async(
                        upstream,
                        AsyncReadPlanWorkflow[Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]](
                            session_id=session_id,
                            build=build_local_prefetch,
                            result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("rows"),
                        ),
                    )
                except OptimizerInternalError as error:
                    _raise_public_prefetch_error(error)
                if not isinstance(rows_result, Sequence) or isinstance(rows_result, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
                    msg = (
                        f"async prefetch for {model_cls.__name__} ({get_table_name(model_cls)}) expected "
                        f"a row sequence, got {type(rows_result).__name__}"
                    )
                    raise TypeError(msg)
                typed_rows = list(rows_result)
                incompatible = [type(row).__name__ for row in typed_rows if not isinstance(row, model_cls)]
                if incompatible:
                    msg = f"async prefetch for {model_cls.__name__} ({get_table_name(model_cls)}) returned incompatible {incompatible[0]}"
                    raise TypeError(msg)
                snapshots.append((model_cls, typed_rows))

            if snapshots:
                await self._replace_prefetched_snapshots_async(snapshots, session_id)
                for snapshot_model_cls, snapshot_rows in snapshots:
                    self._record_prefetched_table(snapshot_model_cls, len(snapshot_rows), counts)
                    await self._mark_cached_table_async(SqlTableName(get_table_name(snapshot_model_cls)))
            return counts
        finally:
            self._release_async_authority_lock(authority_lock)

    async def _replace_prefetched_snapshots_async(
        self: AsyncReadThroughConnection,
        snapshots: Sequence[tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]],
        session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> None:
        """Atomically publish async-collected snapshots and durable coverage."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord,
            ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord,
            ReadThroughCachedTableRecord,
            ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord,
            ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord,
        )
        from impl.read_through.snapshot_policy import merge_snapshot_with_local_overlay
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import (
            AsyncReadPlanWorkflow,
            AsyncWritePlanWorkflow,
            run_read_plan_workflow_async,
            run_write_plan_workflow_async,
        )

        if not snapshots:
            return
        await self._bootstrap_cache_schema_if_missing_async(
            (ReadThroughCachedTableRecord, *(model_cls for model_cls, _rows in snapshots)),
        )
        cache = self._cache
        if not isinstance(cache, AsyncDatabaseConnection):
            msg = f"async snapshot replacement requires AsyncDatabaseConnection, got {type(cache).__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        cache_session_id = SessionId.schema()
        prepared: list[tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]] = []
        upstream_namespace, authority_namespace, catalog_fingerprint = self._local_overlay_authority()
        for model_cls, remote_rows in snapshots:
            table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_cls))

            async def read_overlays(
                txn: AsyncReadTransaction,
            ) -> LazyResult[Sequence[ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord]]:
                return (
                    txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord)
                    .filter(field(ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord.table_name) == str(table_name))
                    .execute_lazy()
                )

            records = await run_read_plan_workflow_async(
                cache,
                AsyncReadPlanWorkflow[Sequence[ReadThroughLocalOverlayRecord]](
                    session_id=cache_session_id,
                    build=read_overlays,
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("local_overlay_evidence"),
                ),
            )
            overlay: dict[SysId, DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] | None] = dict(
                self._local_row_overlays.get(table_name, {}),
            )
            for record in records:
                if (
                    record.upstream_namespace != upstream_namespace
                    or record.authority_namespace != authority_namespace
                    or record.catalog_fingerprint != catalog_fingerprint
                ):
                    continue
                object_id = SysId(record.object_id)
                overlay[object_id] = None if record.deleted else model_cls.model_validate_json(record.row_json)
            prepared.append((model_cls, merge_snapshot_with_local_overlay(model_cls, remote_rows, overlay)))

        key = self._authority_lease_key
        coverage_records: list[ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord] = []
        if key is not None:

            async def read_lease(
                txn: AsyncReadTransaction,
            ) -> LazyResult[ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord | None]:
                return txn.select_one_lazy(
                    ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord,
                    LazyResult.of(ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord.singleton_id()),
                )

            lease = await run_read_plan_workflow_async(
                cache,
                AsyncReadPlanWorkflow[ReadThroughAuthorityLeaseRecord | None](
                    session_id=cache_session_id,
                    build=read_lease,
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("prefetch_authority_lease"),
                ),
            )
            if lease is None:
                raise RuntimeError("async prefetch publication requires persisted authority evidence")
            coverage_records = [
                ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord(
                    sys_id=ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord.deterministic_id(
                        session_id,
                        str(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                    ),
                    requested_session_id=session_id,
                    table_name=str(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                    upstream_namespace=key.upstream_namespace,
                    authority_namespace=key.authority_namespace,
                    authorization_epoch=key.authorization_epoch,
                    catalog_fingerprint=key.catalog_fingerprint,
                    lease_established_at=lease.established_at,
                )
                for model_cls, _rows in prepared
            ]

        ownership_records = [
            ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord.for_table(
                SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_cls)),
            )
            for model_cls, _rows in prepared
        ]

        async def replace_snapshots(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[int]:
            for model_cls, rows in prepared:
                sql_effect_result(
                    txn,
                    SqlDelete(SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_cls)))),
                )
                if rows:
                    txn.insert_many_lazy(model_cls, rows)
            txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughAuthorityOwnedTableRecord, ownership_records)
            if coverage_records:
                txn.upsert_many_lazy(ReadThroughTableCoverageRecord, coverage_records)
            return txn.query_lazy(prepared[-1][0]).count_lazy()

        await run_write_plan_workflow_async(
            cache,
            AsyncWritePlanWorkflow[int](
                session_id=cache_session_id,
                build=replace_snapshots,
                result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("rows"),
                commit=True,
            ),
        )

    async def _establish_current_remote_cache_authority_native(
        self: AsyncReadThroughConnection,
        session_id: SessionId,
    ) -> None:
        """Authenticate before an async cache-only coverage read."""
        from impl.remote.connection import AsyncRemoteIntentConnection

        upstream = self._upstream
        if not isinstance(upstream, AsyncRemoteIntentConnection):
            return
        from l1300_session.session import UserSession

        from impl.remote.errors import RemoteAuthenticationRejectedError, RemoteTransportUnavailableError

        try:
            async with upstream._create_read_transaction_async(session_id) as admission_txn:
                await resolve_terminal_async(
                    admission_txn,
                    "AsyncReadThroughConnection.cache_authority_admission",
                    admission_txn.select_one_lazy(UserSession, LazyResult.of(session_id)),
                )
        except RemoteAuthenticationRejectedError:
            await self._invalidate_offline_cache_session_async(session_id)
            raise
        except RemoteTransportUnavailableError:
            admitted = await self._offline_cache_session_async(session_id)
            if admitted is None:
                raise
            await self._record_authenticated_cache_session_native(session_id, admitted)
            return
        await self._bind_cache_to_current_authority_native()
        admitted = upstream.authenticated_session_id
        if admitted is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Remote authentication did not establish a cache session")
        await self._record_authenticated_cache_session_native(session_id, admitted)

    async def has_versioned_snapshot_coverage_async[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: AsyncReadThroughConnection,
        model_cls: type[T],
        *,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        session_id: SessionId,
        branch_id: BranchId,
        revision_id: RevisionId,
        object_id: SysId | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """Async counterpart of exact authorization-scoped coverage lookup."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import ReadThroughCoverageRecord
        from impl.remote.connection import AsyncRemoteIntentConnection
        from impl.remote.snapshot_coverage import (
            COVERAGE_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
            authorization_context_fingerprint,
            coverage_safe_permission_scheme_name,
            model_symbol,
            versioning_domain_symbol,
        )
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import (
            AsyncReadPlanWorkflow,
            run_read_plan_workflow_async,
        )

        upstream = self._upstream
        if not isinstance(upstream, AsyncRemoteIntentConnection):
            return False
        authority_key = self._authority_lease_key
        authorization_session_id = self._authenticated_cache_sessions.get(session_id)
        scheme_name = coverage_safe_permission_scheme_name(model_cls)
        if authority_key is None or authorization_session_id is None or scheme_name is None:
            return False
        symbol = model_symbol(model_cls)
        domain_symbol = versioning_domain_symbol(domain)
        auth_fingerprint = authorization_context_fingerprint(
            session_id=authorization_session_id,
            authority_namespace=authority_key.authority_namespace,
            authorization_epoch=authority_key.authorization_epoch,
            domain_symbol=domain_symbol,
            model_symbol=symbol,
            scheme_name=scheme_name,
            catalog_fingerprint=authority_key.catalog_fingerprint,
        )
        await self._bootstrap_cache_schema_if_missing_async(
            (model_cls, ReadThroughCoverageRecord),
        )

        async def build_marker_read(txn: AsyncReadTransaction) -> LazyResult[Sequence[ReadThroughCoverageRecord]]:
            return (
                txn.query_lazy(ReadThroughCoverageRecord)
                .filter(field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.authority_namespace) == self._authority_namespace)
                .filter(field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.requested_session_id) == session_id)
                .filter(field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.domain_symbol) == domain_symbol)
                .filter(field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.model_symbol) == symbol)
                .filter(field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.branch_id) == branch_id)
                .filter(field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.revision_id) == revision_id)
                .filter(
                    field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.authorization_context_fingerprint) == auth_fingerprint,
                )
                .filter(
                    field(ReadThroughCoverageRecord.evidence_protocol_version) == COVERAGE_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                )
                .execute_lazy()
            )

        markers = cast(
            "list[ReadThroughCoverageRecord]",
            await run_read_plan_workflow_async(
                cast("Any", self._cache),
                AsyncReadPlanWorkflow(
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=build_marker_read,
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("coverage"),
                ),
            ),
        )
        if object_id is None:
            return any(marker.scope_key == "*" for marker in markers)
        object_key = str(object_id)
        return any(marker.scope_key in {"*", object_key} for marker in markers)

    @direct_legacy_module_async
    async def select_versioned_identity_from_cache_async[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
        self: AsyncReadThroughConnection,
        model_cls: type[T],
        object_id: SysId,
        *,
        session_id: SessionId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_id: BranchId,
        revision_id: RevisionId,
    ) -> T | None:
        """Answer an async cache-only identity read only under exact coverage."""
        from impl.read_through.transaction import ReadThroughLocalStateIncompleteError

        if not await self.has_versioned_snapshot_coverage_async(
            model_cls,
            domain=domain,
            session_id=session_id,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            revision_id=revision_id,
            object_id=object_id,
        ):
            msg = "Cache-only versioned identity read lacks matching authorization-scoped coverage"
            raise ReadThroughLocalStateIncompleteError(msg)
        cache = self._cache
        if not isinstance(cache, AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection):
            raise TypeError("async versioned identity lookup requires an asynchronous versioned cache")
        cache_session_id = self._authenticated_cache_sessions.get(session_id)
        assert cache_session_id is not None
        async with cache.open_versioned_read_plan(
            session_id=cache_session_id,
            domain=domain,
            revision=revision_id,
        ) as scope:
            scope.return_result(
                "result",
                scope.txn.select_one_lazy(model_cls, LazyResult.of(object_id)),
            )
            result = (await scope.execute_results())["result"]
        if result is not None and not isinstance(result, model_cls):
            raise TypeError("async cache identity lookup returned an invalid row type")
        return result

    @direct_legacy_module_async
    async def query_versioned_snapshot_from_cache_async[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
        self: AsyncReadThroughConnection,
        model_cls: type[T],
        *,
        session_id: SessionId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_id: BranchId,
        revision_id: RevisionId,
    ) -> list[T]:
        """Return an async complete cache snapshot only under exact coverage."""
        from impl.read_through.transaction import ReadThroughLocalStateIncompleteError

        await self._establish_current_remote_cache_authority_native(session_id)
        if not await self.has_versioned_snapshot_coverage_async(
            model_cls,
            domain=domain,
            session_id=session_id,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            revision_id=revision_id,
        ):
            msg = "Cache-only versioned model query lacks matching complete-model coverage"
            raise ReadThroughLocalStateIncompleteError(msg)
        cache = self._cache
        if not isinstance(cache, AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection):
            raise TypeError("async versioned snapshot lookup requires an asynchronous versioned cache")
        cache_session_id = self._authenticated_cache_sessions.get(session_id)
        assert cache_session_id is not None
        async with cache.open_versioned_read_plan(
            session_id=cache_session_id,
            domain=domain,
            revision=revision_id,
        ) as scope:
            scope.return_result("result", scope.txn.query_lazy(model_cls).execute_lazy())
            result = (await scope.execute_results())["result"]
        if not isinstance(result, Sequence) or isinstance(result, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
            raise TypeError("async cache snapshot lookup did not return a row sequence")
        rows = list(result)
        if not all(isinstance(row, model_cls) for row in rows):
            raise TypeError("async cache snapshot lookup returned an invalid row type")
        return rows

    @direct_legacy_module_async
    async def synchronize_versioned_identity_set_async[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
        self: AsyncReadThroughConnection,
        model_cls: type[T],
        object_ids: tuple[SysId, ...],
        *,
        session_id: SessionId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_id: BranchId,
        revision_id: RevisionId,
    ) -> VersionedIdentitySetSyncResult[T]:
        """Synchronize one bounded identity set through an async owning scope."""
        from impl.read_through.coverage import (
            MAX_VERSIONED_IDENTITY_SYNC_SIZE,
            VersionedIdentitySetSyncResult,
        )
        from impl.read_through.transaction import ReadThroughLocalStateIncompleteError
        from impl.remote.snapshot_coverage import (
            coverage_safe_permission_scheme_name,
            model_symbol,
        )

        identities = tuple(dict.fromkeys(object_ids))
        if not identities:
            raise ValueError("Versioned identity synchronization requires at least one object ID")
        if len(identities) > MAX_VERSIONED_IDENTITY_SYNC_SIZE:
            msg = f"Versioned identity synchronization exceeds maximum size {MAX_VERSIONED_IDENTITY_SYNC_SIZE}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if coverage_safe_permission_scheme_name(model_cls) is None:
            msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} permission scheme has no stable coverage context"
            raise ReadThroughLocalStateIncompleteError(msg)
        async with self.open_versioned_read_plan(
            session_id=session_id,
            domain=domain,
            revision=revision_id,
        ) as scope:
            for object_id in identities:
                scope.return_result(
                    str(object_id),
                    scope.txn.select_one_lazy(model_cls, LazyResult.of(object_id)),
                )
            raw_rows = await scope.execute_results()
        rows: dict[SysId, T | None] = {}
        for object_id in identities:
            value = raw_rows[str(object_id)]
            if value is not None and not isinstance(value, model_cls):
                raise TypeError("async versioned identity synchronization returned an invalid row type")
            rows[object_id] = value
        for object_id in identities:
            if not await self.has_versioned_snapshot_coverage_async(
                model_cls,
                domain=domain,
                session_id=session_id,
                branch_id=branch_id,
                revision_id=revision_id,
                object_id=object_id,
            ):
                msg = "Versioned identity synchronization completed without final coverage"
                raise ReadThroughLocalStateIncompleteError(msg)
        return VersionedIdentitySetSyncResult(
            model_symbol=model_symbol(model_cls),
            branch_id=branch_id,
            revision_id=revision_id,
            rows=rows,
            covered_object_ids=identities,
        )

    def open_versioned_read_plan(
        self: AsyncReadThroughConnection,
        *,
        session_id: SessionId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        revision: RevisionId | None = None,
        branch: BranchIdAnchor | None = None,
        branch_factory: BranchIdAnchorFactory | None = None,
        branch_name: BranchName | None = None,
        workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None = None,
        observe_staged_from: ConnectionId | None = None,
        context_resolver: SessionContextResolverInput = SESSION_CONTEXT_RESOLVER_UNSET,
        retry_policy: RetryPolicy | None = None,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        """Open an async versioned read scope for read-through connections."""
        self._bind_operation_domain(domain)
        if session_id.is_schema_session() or (session_id.is_system_session() and not self._uses_remote_system_authority(session_id)):
            return cast(Any, self._cache).open_versioned_read_plan(
                session_id=session_id,
                domain=domain,
                revision=revision,
                branch=branch,
                branch_factory=branch_factory,
                branch_name=branch_name,
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                observe_staged_from=observe_staged_from,
                context_resolver=context_resolver,
                retry_policy=retry_policy,
                timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
            )
        return _AsyncReadThroughVersionedReadScope(
            AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection.open_versioned_read_plan(
                self,
                session_id=session_id,
                domain=domain,
                revision=revision,
                branch=branch,
                branch_factory=branch_factory,
                branch_name=branch_name,
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                observe_staged_from=observe_staged_from,
                context_resolver=context_resolver,
                retry_policy=retry_policy,
                timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
            ),
        )

def build_sync_read_through_connection(
    cache: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    upstream: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    *,
    read_only: bool,
) -> SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection:
    """Build a domain-neutral sync read-through implementation."""
    if not isinstance(cache, _VersionedDatabaseConnectionCore):
        raise TypeError("read-through cache must use the internal versioned connection contract")
    if not isinstance(upstream, _DatabaseConnectionCore):
        raise TypeError("read-through upstream must use the internal connection contract")
    return SyncReadThroughConnection(cache=cache, upstream=upstream, read_only=read_only)


def build_async_read_through_connection(
    cache: AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    upstream: AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    *,
    read_only: bool,
) -> AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection:
    """Build a domain-neutral async read-through implementation."""
    if not isinstance(cache, _VersionedDatabaseConnectionCore):
        raise TypeError("read-through cache must use the internal versioned connection contract")
    if not isinstance(upstream, _DatabaseConnectionCore):
        raise TypeError("read-through upstream must use the internal connection contract")
    return AsyncReadThroughConnection(cache=cache, upstream=upstream, read_only=read_only)
